articles.title: BendPak Launches Ranger DST30PX Balancer
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Ranger Division of BendPak has introduced the next-generation DST Series wheel balancer, the DST30PX. As shops face larger OEM wheel assemblies and heavy aftermarket truck tires, older balancing platforms can slow production. The DST30PX is built to handle oversized wheels and prevent bottlenecks with a new hood design, larger shaft and overhauled structural chassis.

The hood accommodates a wider range of tire shapes and sizes, including oversized off-road and fleet tires, without repositioning. An open-side design allows wider tires, aggressive offsets and bulky sidewalls to slide in more easily, reducing setup time and enabling operators to position wheel assemblies up to 43 inches in diameter.

Ranger reinforced the chassis and hood assembly to handle the added mass of larger assemblies without flexing, compromising alignment or generating excess vibration. The added rigidity helps maintain consistent measurements for accuracy. A 40 mm shaft increases stiffness and accuracy for heavier wheels while supporting standard cones and accessories.

“The Ranger DST30PX represents a fundamental shift in how modern shops handle today’s radically heavier, oversized wheel configurations,” said Sean Price, director of product development for BendPak Inc. “By optimizing the physical layout and integrating a high-precision sensor array, we ensure technicians can mount, spin and perfectly balance oversized assemblies without a single second of wasted motion — turning massive wheel packages into a rapid, routine six-second floor-to-floor operation.”

The DST30PX features a 64-tooth magnetic transducer encoder with precision-cut square teeth to convert rotary position into a digital electronic signal, helping achieve accurate profile readings and top-dead-center positioning for precise weight placement. The extra encoder resolution supports cleaner correction, smaller weight changes and better placement accuracy for performance wheels, larger tiresand customers sensitive to vibration.
User-friendly Design for Fast Turnarounds

The DST30PX streamlines repetitive wheel service by reducing unnecessary motion. Simple wheel data entry, precise rolling weight readings, automatic braking, manual or automatic hood-start operation, and a rapid cycle time help technicians balance more wheels with fewer errors.

A quick-release hub nut, side-position brake, top-dead-center weight indicator, and tiered placement indicators accelerate setup and correction. Onboard storage includes a high-volume top tray, side cone pegs, and a side shelf designed to accommodate Ranger Quick-Peel adhesive tape weight rolls.
- 145-lb. capacity, 30-in. wheel diameter range, and 43-in. max tire diameter
- Low-RPM balancing operation and six-second cycle time
- Dynamic, Static and Performance Alloy settings
- 16-bit processor and multi-directional quartz piezoelectric sensors
- Ergonomic controls and full-tilt LED display control panel
- Automatic braking and self-calibration

The DST30PX is positioned as an upgrade for shops seeking higher precision, faster workflow and an advanced measuring system for modern wheels without moving to a larger machine. It is ETL-certified to meet applicable UL and CSA safety standards in the U.S. and Canada. It comes with a starter kit of adhesive and clip-on steel wheel weights. Ranger Select setup and training is available.
For more information, click here or call (800) 253-2363.

articles.title: ADAS Assist Launches Calibration Verification Platform
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: ADAS Assist has announced the launch of its calibration verification and business management platform for collision repair shops and ADAS calibration providers.
Built by collision and calibration professionals, ADAS Assist is designed to close the accuracy gap when required calibrations are missed after a repair.

Modern vehicles rely on cameras, radars and sensors often located where collisions occur. Determining which calibrations a repair requires means matching each line of a collision estimate to the correct OEM procedure. A single miss can lead to a safety failure, liability claim or comeback. The ADAS Assist team said they experienced that risk firsthand and relied on a third-party scrubbing tool with real-world accuracy around 70%. After finding similar shortcomings in other tools, they decided to build their own.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: “In ADAS calibration, accuracy is not a ‘nice to have’, it’s a ‘got to have,’” said James Rodis of ADAS Assist. “A 30% margin for error was not something we could keep living with. We are not programmers. We are collision professionals who have run shops, managed technicians and answered for a missed calibration. We built ADAS Assist because we needed it ourselves first.”

- ADAS Verification System (AVS): A quoting and scrubbing engine that reads a body shop estimate and identifies the required calibrations and related operations. AVS releases nothing until it clears well over 90% confidence, ties each operation to the estimate line that triggered it, and links directly to the governing OEM procedure so technicians and estimators can see exactly what is required and why.

- Customer Management System (CMS): Built to run the calibration operation for body shops and calibration centers from one place, including custom pricing, technician management, a daily technician calendar, job scheduling and invoicing.

Shops submit requests by uploading an estimate and answering questions about the vehicle’s damage. They receive a documented quote for the vehicle’s VIN, along with direct access to the supporting OEM documentation.

“AVS and CMS were built to work together, not as two separate tools stapled to one login,” Rodis said. “That is how the work actually flows in a real shop, and it is what sets ADAS Assist apart from tools designed by people who have never stood in a bay.
“Today, this AVS and CMS system is functioning in a real-world environment handling the calibration quoting needs and workflows for hundreds of body shops across the country.”
ADAS Assist is available now to collision repair shops and calibration. For more information or to request an account, call (402) 315-5800 or visit ADASAssist.net.

articles.title: Fix Auto USA Announces Opening of Fix Auto South Salt Lake
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Fix Auto USA has announced the opening of Fix Auto South Salt Lake, located at 3218 S W Temple Street in South Salt Lake, Utah.

Owned and operated by Efrain Perez, Fix Auto South Salt Lake is Perez’s third Fix Auto USA location and further expands his commitment to delivering high-quality collision repair services while maintaining a strong focus on family values, customer care and community involvement.

The approximately 14,000-square-foot facility is staffed by a team of five professionals and is equipped to provide full-service collision repair with room to support future growth. Services include body and structural repairs, estimating, refinishing and paint matching, parts replacement, vehicle diagnostics, glass replacement and post-repair calibrations. The shop works with all insurance carriers and assists customers throughout the claims and repair process to ensure a seamless repair experience.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: For Perez, the collision repair industry is more than a profession. It’s a lifelong passion rooted in family and tradition.

“I grew up in my father’s body shop in Colombia, surrounded by the sounds of tools, welding sparks, bodywork and fresh paint,” said Perez. “Although my father hoped I would choose an easier career, I was drawn to the industry and learned by watching him and helping wherever I could. He taught me honesty, responsibility, hard work and the importance of being proud of anything that carries your name. Today, owning three body shops is something I am incredibly grateful for, and the values my father instilled in me continue to guide how we serve our customers and community every day.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Perez added that the business has become a true family endeavor.

“What makes this journey especially meaningful is that Fix Auto USA has become a family business in every sense. My wife, Rebeca, serves as co-owner and general manager, and my brother, my son, several close friends and even my father are actively involved in the business. Seeing everything come full circle, from growing up in my father’s shop in Colombia to building this business together as a family, is incredibly special.”
As the South Salt Lake location grows, the team looks forward to supporting local families, schools, youth programs and community events while building lasting relationships throughout the region.

“We joined Fix Auto because its values align with our commitment to quality, integrity and customer service,” said Perez. “The franchise provides strong operational support, industry resources, national brand recognition and access to a trusted network, while still allowing us to remain locally owned and actively involved in our community.”

“Efrain’s story is a powerful example of entrepreneurship, perseverance and dedication to the collision repair industry,” said Damien Reyna, COO, Driven Brand Collision Group. “From learning the trade in his father’s shop in Colombia to building a successful multi-location business in the U.S., Efrain has remained committed to quality repairs, exceptional customer service and investing in the communities he serves. We are proud to celebrate the opening of Fix Auto South Salt Lake and welcome this location to the growing Fix Auto USA network.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: For more information on Fix Auto USA, visit FixAutoUSA.com.

articles.title: GM, Ford active safety engineers to speak during SCRS OEM Summit at SEMA Show
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: At the SEMA Show next month, active safety engineers from General Motors and Ford will provide a look behind the engineering decisions that influence vehicle safety before, during, and after a collision.

They’ll speak during the second session of the Society of Collision Repair Specialists’ (SCRS) 2026 OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit, titled “Engineering the Safety Benefit: From Requirements to Real-World Performance,” Thursday, Nov. 5, from 2–3 p.m.

It will follow an earlier session featuring National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) Deputy Administrator Lee White from 12:30–1:30 p.m. White will examine vehicle safety priorities and the agency’s role in advancing safety on U.S. roadways.
To register for all three OEM Summit sessions, visit here.
An SCRS RDE Full Series Pass provides access to Tuesday and Wednesday RDE sessions, the IDEAS Collide Showcase, Thursday’s OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit, and the SCRS Afterparty.

“This second session will move from those broader safety objectives into the vehicle itself, examining how automakers translate requirements and safety goals into technologies designed to produce measurable real-world benefits,” an SCRS press release states. “The afternoon will then progress to the collision repair environment, exploring how those engineered capabilities are preserved and restored after a vehicle has been damaged.”

The second session will bring together engineers who are responsible for developing, evaluating, and measuring advanced vehicle safety systems. Attendees will learn about the engineering decisions that influence vehicle safety.

Panelists include Michael Carpenter, General Motors Active Safety and Global Vehicle Performance owner; Jameson Collins, General Motors Active Safety and staff product manager; and Jeremy Nelson, Ford Motor Co. ADAS application systems engineer.

Carpenter works within GM Global Product Safety, Systems, and Certification on ADAS technology and performance strategies, new technology development, implementation of regulatory and consumer metric requirements, ADAS field effectiveness and safety benefits, and industry collaboration on standards and test-method development.

Collins leads product strategy, roadmap development, and delivery for GM’s Active Safety features, translating customer needs, competitive insights, and regulatory requirements into technologies intended to improve safety and the driving experience.

Nelson focuses on the development, release, integration, and servicing of advanced driver assistance system domain controllers. He supports vehicle production and development milestones while troubleshooting ADAS components and working across engineering, quality, and product development teams to ensure systems perform safely and as intended.

The discussion will be moderated by Jake Rodenroth, automotive industry executive, and will move beyond what ADAS features do to examine why they exist, how their intended performance is established, and how their effectiveness is evaluated. This will include what it means when a safety system is absent, disabled, damaged, or operating outside its intended parameters.

The release states: “That progression leads directly to a fundamental question for collision repair professionals: If a vehicle entered a collision with a measurable safety capability, how can the repairer know that capability has been restored?”

The panel will also explore ADAS feature development, real-world effectiveness, crash avoidance and mitigation, implications of inoperable systems, verification of safety performance, and the potential for system degradation.
The 2026 OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit is part of SCRS’ Repairer Driven Education (RDE) program at the SEMA Show.

“The Summit brings collision repair professionals together with automakers, engineers, regulators, and other subject-matter experts to examine emerging technologies and their implications for safe and complete vehicle repair,” the release states.

During the first session, White will present on the agency’s current vehicle and roadway safety priorities, emerging transportation technologies, data-driven research, and the federal government’s work with the industry to reduce fatalities and serious injuries, an SCRS release states.

Following White’s presentation, he will sit down with Aaron Schulenburg, SCRS executive director, for a one-on-one conversation exploring the intersection between federal safety objectives, automotive innovation, and the collision repair industry’s role in preserving vehicle safety throughout its service life.
NHTSA sits at the center of many discussions that impact the collision repair industry.

During a July Collision Industry Conference meeting, Schulenburg discussed NHTSA’s investigation into counterfeit airbags with Teena Bohi, an Automotive Anti-Counterfeiting Council (A2C2) Board member.

In April, NHTSA announced a ban on one type of counterfeit airbag part. Before the ban, it also issued an “urgent” industry alert specifically asking the auto repair industry to look for dangerous airbag inflators.
Repair procedures are impacted by NHTSA-mandated vehicle safety technology. This includes mandated backup cameras in all new vehicles under 10,000 pounds as of May 2018.
NHTSA also has a final rule that mandates automatic emergency braking (AEB) in pedestrian vehicles by September 2029.
However, NHTSA also announced it paused the rule to give the Trump administration time to review it following pushback and a lawsuit filed by the Alliance of Automotive Innovation (Auto Innovators).
Additional information about SCRS and RDE can be found at www.scrs.come/rde
For more information about SCRS or to join as a member, visit www.scrs.com, call 877-841-0660, or email [email protected]

articles.title: Class action lawsuit filed against CCC alleging consumer personal information misuse
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: A class action lawsuit filed Oct. 8 in California against CCC Intelligent Solutions and CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings alleges that CCC stores personally identifiable information (PII) from collision repair estimates created in CCC ONE to inform its artificial intelligence products and analytics.
paras.zh: 10月8日在加利福尼亚州针对CCC Intelligent Solutions和CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings提起的集体诉讼称， CCC存储了CCC ONE中创建的碰撞修复估计中的个人身份信息(PII) ，以告知其人工智能产品和分析。

paras.en: The PII in question includes customer names, home addresses, phone numbers, insurance claim numbers, vehicle identification numbers, license plate numbers, and vehicle mileage. CCC also stores photos of damaged vehicles, according to the suit.
paras.zh: 相关PII包括客户姓名、家庭住址、电话号码、保险索赔号码、车辆识别号码、车牌号和车辆里程。根据诉讼， CCC还存储受损车辆的照片。

paras.en: Plaintiffs LaTrenda Zekenya Burries, Gloribel Lissbeth Garcia, and Katleen Saturné were all involved in vehicle collisions and sought repairs at California collision repair facilities.
paras.zh: 原告LaTrenda Zekenya Burries、Gloribel Lissbeth Garcia和Katleen Saturné都参与了车辆碰撞，并寻求在加利福尼亚州的碰撞维修设施进行维修。

paras.en: The suit alleges intrusion upon seclusion, invasion of privacy under the California Constitution, unjust enrichment, and violation of California’s unfair competition law.
paras.zh: 该诉讼指控隔离入侵、侵犯加利福尼亚州宪法规定的隐私、不正当致富和违反加利福尼亚州不正当竞争法。

paras.en: The Law Offices of Maro Burunsuzyan, on behalf of the plaintiffs, says the alleged harm is the loss of privacy and control over personal information, including the ability to decide whether it could be repurposed and commercially exploited, as well as being deprived of resulting economic value.
paras.zh: Maro Burunsuzyan律师事务所代表原告表示，所谓的损害是失去对个人信息的隐私和控制，包括决定是否可以重新利用和商业利用的能力，以及被剥夺由此产生的经济价值。

paras.en: CCC allegedly combines stored PII with data across its network to build AI products and analytics that it licenses to other customers without notice, consent, or compensation to the consumers who own the information, according to the complaint.
paras.zh: 据投诉称， CCC据称将存储的PII与其网络上的数据相结合，构建人工智能产品和分析，并授权给其他客户，而无需通知、同意或赔偿拥有该信息的消费者。

paras.en: When Repairer Driven News asked CCC for comment on the suit, CCC replied that it “doesn’t comment on pending litigation.”
paras.zh: 当维修商Driven News要求CCC对诉讼发表评论时， CCC回答说，它“不对未决诉讼发表评论”。

paras.en: “Its contract with insurers provides that ‘CCC may use data to train AI Services,'” the complaint states. “Its contract with repair facilities reserves to CCC the use of the facility’s data for CCC’s own ‘product improvement, and research and development,’ a use that ‘may continue after the expiration or termination of this agreement.’ CCC tells consumers none of this. No page of the estimate describes CCC’s retention, aggregation, or commercial use of the personal information, or gives the consumer any way to opt out of it, see it, or delete it.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The suit adds that a repair facility’s contract with CCC doesn’t equal consumers’ consent for CCC to collect and use their data.
paras.zh: 该诉讼补充说，维修机构与CCC签订的合同并不等于消费者同意CCC收集和使用他们的数据。

paras.en: “CCC’s own contract anticipates as much by requiring the repair facility to indemnify CCC ‘for failure to obtain the requisite authorizations,'” the suit states.
paras.zh: “CCC自己的合同通过要求维修机构赔偿CCC ‘未能获得必要的授权‘来达到同样的预期，”该诉讼称。

paras.en: The agreements noted in the suit are CCC’s Repair Facility License Agreement, effective in 2018; form Independent Appraiser Master License Agreement, reflected in a product schedule executed in 2024; the Insurer MSA, CCC’s public Master Services Agreement for insurers, last updated Nov. 7, 2025; and CCC’s companion Data Processing Addendum (DPA), last updated Nov. 4, 2025.
paras.zh: 诉讼中提到的协议有： CCC的维修设施许可协议，于2018年生效；形成独立评估师主许可协议，反映在2024年执行的产品进度表中；保险公司MSA ， CCC为保险公司签订的公共主服务协议，最后更新日期为2025年11月7日；以及CCC的配套数据处理附录（ DPA ） ，最后更新日期为2025年11月4日。

paras.en: According to the suit, the Repair Facility License Agreement “authorizes CCC to provide the repair ‘content’ to insurers whose direct repair programs the shop participates in, or with whom the shop configures CCC ONE UpdatePlus to share information, and separately authorizes CCC to provide the Content to CCC’s vendor, Flash of Genius, Inc. (d/b/a UpdatePromise) (“Flash”), granting the identified insurers, CCC, and that vendor ‘perpetual, royalty-free licenses to use the content.'”
The agreement also “forbids the repair facility itself to ‘compile estimate data for the purpose of creating a database,’ a use that CCC reserves to itself…”

The Appraiser License Agreement also forbids the appraiser to “‘compile estimate data for the purpose of creating a database'” and “‘aggregate or co-mingle data in the programs and/or services or provide reports or analysis based on data in the programs and/or services to anyone.'”

It notes as well that a section of the Insurer MSA, titled “License by Customer to CCC,” “contemplates the development or testing of artificial intelligence tools or models on Customer Data that has not been de-identified, subject only to the customer’s prior written approval, which the provision states CCC may accept by e-mail from a vice-president-level or higher employee of the customer.”
The plaintiffs contend that consumers aren’t parties or signatories to the aforementioned agreements despite CCC’s collection, movement, and licensing of their personal information.

“The Repair Facility License Agreement runs between CCC and a collision repair facility, the Appraiser License Agreement runs between CCC and an independent appraiser, and the Insurer MSA and DPA run between CCC and an insurer,” the suit states.

“The only authorization CCC obtains to take and use consumers’ personal information under these agreements is the business’s own promise: under the Repair Facility License Agreement, customer ‘represents and warrants that it has full right and authority to provide the authorization and licenses contained herein,’ and indemnifies CCC ‘for failure to obtain the requisite authorizations;’ and under the Appraiser License Agreement, customer ‘represents and warrants that it has the right to provide the data to CCC.'”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The suit also states that CCC has patented training AI models on identifiable consumer data and harvesting vehicle event data recorder information, including U.S. Patent No. 10,922,726; U.S. Patent No. 11,727,551; and U.S. Patent No. 9,500,545.

“Taken together, these patents describe CCC’s designs for systems that ingest, store, retrain on, and reuse identifiable consumer and vehicle data of the kinds that populate CCC ONE, including names, home addresses, VINs, license plates, policy and claim identifiers, and event-data-recorder data,” the suit states. “On information and belief, CCC has implemented these designs in the CCC ONE platform and in the artificial-intelligence products and analytics it licenses to insurers and other customers.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The proposed nationwide class includes more than 15 million U.S. vehicle owners or customers named on repair estimates that a U.S. collision repair facility prepared on CCC ONE in the four years before the complaint was filed. It also proposes a nationwide intrusion subclass and a California subclass.

Relief sought includes nominal and punitive damages, restitution and disgorgement of the value CCC obtained from consumers’ information, barring CCC from using consumer information for AI training or other purposes beyond the estimate without consent, and requiring CCC to delete consumer PII.

An injunction on behalf of the California subclass would require CCC to inform California consumers before or when their personal information is entered into CCC ONE at a collision repair facility of its identity, the categories of PII it collects, and the purposes of use for the PII. It would also require CCC to obtain consumer consent before using PII for any purpose beyond preparing or transmitting vehicle estimates or valuations.
CCC hadn’t filed a response to the suit in court as of Monday afternoon.

“Artificial intelligence is reshaping the economy, and the question of what these systems are built on has never mattered more,” said Maro Burunsuzyan, attorney for the plaintiffs and founder of the Law Offices of Maro Burunsuzyan, in a press release.

“The complaint alleges that, in CCC’s case, part of the answer is the personal information of ordinary people who simply needed a car repaired. Those drivers were never told, never asked, and never paid. This case is about restoring a basic principle: a company that wants to profit from your information should have to ask you first.”
Featured image credit: Just_Super/iStock

articles.title: Volvo research shows automaker has decreased injury for men and women by 79%
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: A new report from Volvo finds that equal protection for men and women can be achieved through data-driven safety development grounded in real-world crash research, the release states.
paras.zh: 沃尔沃的一份新报告发现，通过基于现实世界碰撞研究的数据驱动安全开发，可以实现男女平等保护。

paras.en: The research found that overall injury for drivers has decreased by 79% for Volvo models from 2010 to 2019 compared to models from 1970 to 1979.
paras.zh: 研究发现，与1970年至1979年的车型相比， 2010年至2019年，沃尔沃车型驾驶员的整体伤害减少了79%。

paras.en: Volvo saw an 88% decrease for women, bringing the injury risk to the same level as men, the release states.
paras.zh: 沃尔沃表示，女性受伤风险下降了88% ，与男性受伤风险持平。

paras.en: “The results also show substantial advances in occupant protection across all seating positions,” the release adds. “Restrained rear-seat occupants in Volvo cars benefit from protection levels comparable to, and in some cases exceeding, those of front-seat occupants.”
paras.zh: “结果还显示，所有座位位置的乘员保护都取得了重大进展，”该发布补充道。“沃尔沃汽车中受限制的后座乘员受益于与前座乘员相当的防护等级，在某些情况下甚至超过前座乘员的防护等级。”

paras.en: Volvo says the data underscores the effectiveness of decades of rear-seat safety innovation in Volvo cars. This happened with the lack of regulatory requirements and standardized testing, the release states.
paras.zh: 沃尔沃表示，这些数据凸显了沃尔沃汽车数十年来后座安全创新的有效性。这发生在缺乏监管要求和标准化测试的情况下，发布状态。

paras.en: “For too long, safety in the automotive industry has not worked equally well for everyone,” says Åsa Haglund, Volvo head of Cars Safety Centre, in the release. “At Volvo Cars, we’ve taken a different approach. By studying real-world crashes and designing with the needs of women, men and children of all body types in mind, we’ve worked for decades to provide a high level of protection regardless of who you are or where you sit in the car. Our latest research confirms that equal protection is not just an ambition, but something we have been able to achieve in Volvo cars for many years.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Volvo has collected data since 1970 from more than 50,000 real-world crashes involving more than 80,000 occupants, the release notes. It adds that the insights are translated into safety requirements, testing, vehicle development, verification, and production.
paras.zh: 发布说明称，自1970年以来，沃尔沃已经从涉及8万多名乘客的5万多起真实世界碰撞事故中收集了数据。它补充说，这些见解被转化为安全要求、测试、车辆开发、验证和生产。

paras.en: “The result is a continuous cycle of learning that helps drive innovations and improve protection for everyone,” according to the release.
paras.zh: “结果是持续的学习循环，有助于推动创新并改善对每个人的保护。”

paras.en: The study also reviewed different crash types. It found that frontal impact injuries were reduced by 79% for all drivers. Side impacts saw a larger reduction in injuries at 89%.
paras.zh: 该研究还审查了不同的碰撞类型。研究发现，所有驾驶员的额部撞击伤害减少了79%。副作用造成的伤害减少幅度更大，为89%。

paras.en: The approach also laid the foundation for pioneering Volvo Cars Safety Standard, according to the release. Through the standard, Volvo sets its own benchmark for real-world safety, going beyond regulation or safety ratings, Volvo says.
paras.zh: 根据该新闻稿，这种方法也为开创沃尔沃汽车安全标准奠定了基础。沃尔沃表示，通过该标准，沃尔沃为现实世界的安全设定了自己的基准，超越了监管或安全评级。

paras.en: “And because real-world crashes don’t involve standardized crash test dummies, Volvo Cars’ research involves considering a diverse range of occupant characteristics, including gender, height, body shape and weight,” the release states. “As a result, the company’s safety innovations are designed with the same diversity in mind.”
paras.zh: “由于真实世界的碰撞事故不涉及标准化的碰撞测试假人，沃尔沃汽车的研究涉及考虑各种乘员特征，包括性别、身高、体型和体重。” “因此，公司的安全创新在设计时考虑到了相同的多样性。”

paras.en: Volvo notes it has openly shared its safety research to help raise safety standards across the industry through the Equal Vehicles for All (E.V.A.) initiative launched in 2019. It adds that more than 50 years of safety research is freely accessible in a digital library. Carmakers, researchers and policyholders can use the data to build on Volvo’s insights.
paras.zh: 沃尔沃指出，它已公开分享其安全研究，通过2019年启动的“人人享有平等车辆” （ EVA ）计划，帮助提高整个行业的安全标准。它补充说，在数字图书馆中可以免费访问50多年的安全研究。汽车制造商、研究人员和保单持有人可以利用这些数据来建立沃尔沃的见解。

paras.en: The recent study focuses on a broad range of real-world crash scenarios, including frontal, side, and rear-end impacts; run-off-road collisions; rollovers; side-swipe collisions; large animal impacts; and multi-collision crashes.
paras.zh: 最近的研究侧重于广泛的真实世界碰撞场景，包括正面、侧面和后端碰撞；径流道路碰撞；翻车；侧滑碰撞；大型动物碰撞；以及多次碰撞碰撞。

paras.en: It also focuses on belted occupants aged 13 or older and examines injuries with moderate potential to threaten life, such as fractures and concussions, while excluding minor injuries such as bruises and pain.
paras.zh: 它还侧重于13岁或以上的系带乘客，并检查可能危及生命的中度伤害，如骨折和脑震荡，同时不包括轻微伤害，如瘀伤和疼痛。

paras.en: Earlier this year, Volvo introduced a new seatbelt that adapts to traffic variations and the person wearing it via real-time data.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，沃尔沃推出了一种新的安全带，可以通过实时数据适应交通变化和佩戴者。

paras.en: The Volvo EX60 was the first vehicle equipped with the multi-adaptive seatbelt.
paras.zh: 沃尔沃EX60是第一款配备多自适应安全带的车辆。

paras.en: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) released research in January that found women are at higher risk of injury than men in collisions. The research followed details released by the U.S. Department of Transportation on an advanced female crash test dummy.
paras.zh: 美国国家公路交通安全管理局（ NHTSA ）在1月份发布的研究发现，女性在碰撞中受伤的风险高于男性。该研究遵循了美国交通部发布的关于高级女性碰撞测试假人的细节。

articles.title: The Penny Test to Measure Tire Tread is Outdated
articles.author: Christian Hinton

paras.en: The quarter tire test can provide an earlier warning of tire wear than the traditional penny test. The penny test checks for about 2/32˝ of tread, while a quarter checks closer to 4/32˝.
paras.zh: 四分之一轮胎测试可以提供比传统便士测试更早的轮胎磨损警告。便士测试检查胎面约为2/32英寸，而四分之一检查接近4/32英寸。

paras.en: The 2/32˝ measurement represents the minimum replacement point. Checking at 4/32˝ gives drivers more time to plan for tire replacement.
paras.zh: 2/32 *表示最小替换点。检查时间为4/32 ，让合作车主有更多时间计划更换轮胎。

paras.en: Insert a quarter into the tire tread with Washington’s head facing down. If the top of Washington’s head disappears, the tire has at least 4/32˝ of tread. If the top of his head remains visible, drivers can begin planning for replacement.
paras.zh: 将四分之一插入轮胎胎面，华盛顿的头朝下。如果华盛顿的头顶消失，轮胎的胎面至少有4/32英寸。如果他的头顶仍然可见，司机可以开始计划更换。

paras.en: In wet-weather testing, tires worn to 4/32˝ took an average of 87 feet longer to stop than new tires. Wet performance can therefore decline before tread reaches the level measured by the penny test. The quarter test provides an earlier indication of tread wear.
paras.zh: 在潮湿天气测试中，磨损到4/32的轮胎比新轮胎平均需要87英尺的时间才能停止。因此，在胎面达到便士测试测量的水平之前，潮湿性能可能会下降。四分之一测试提供了胎面磨损的早期迹象。

articles.title: Alignment Spec: Toyota RAV4 2006-2013
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: The third generation of the Toyota RAV4 shares all of the same infrastructure with the Corolla and many other Toyota vehicles. The front suspension is easy to adjust, while the rear needs a little more attention.
paras.zh: 第三代丰田RAV4与卡罗拉和许多其他丰田汽车共享所有相同的基础设施。前悬架易于调整，而后悬架需要更多的注意。

paras.en: If you get one in your shop, it’s what you do after you adjust the angles that can make or break the alignment. The RAV4 has electric power steering and the stability control is a very common option. These systems need to know the correct steering angle to operate. If it is not reset, it could result in the customer coming back with the VSA or steering malfunction indicator light on.
paras.zh: 如果你在商店里买了一个，那就是你在调整角度后所做的事情，这可以使对齐或破坏对齐。RAV4配备电动助力转向，稳定性控制是一种非常常见的选择。这些系统需要知道正确的转向角度才能运行。如果未重置，可能会导致客户带着VSA或转向故障指示灯回来。

paras.en: Always pay attention to the ride height. If the springs are weak, it can change the camber and caster in the front. In the rear, weak springs can change the camber and toe and cause the inner edges of the tires to wear prematurely. Often many of the alignment angles can be corrected with new springs or loaded struts.
paras.zh: 始终注意乘坐高度。如果弹簧较弱，则可以更换前面的弯曲和脚轮。在后部，弱弹簧会改变弯曲和脚趾，导致轮胎内边缘过早磨损。通常可以使用新的弹簧或加载的支柱来校正许多对中角度。

paras.en: The front suspension on the RAV4 uses a MacPherson strut design. Caster is not adjustable from the factory. Camber can be adjusted using additional parts. Toyota uses coded bolts with dots on the heads that indicate a fixed range of camber. But, the aftermarket has a better solution, with cam bolts that can adjust ±1.75 degrees.
paras.zh: RAV4的前悬架采用MacPherson支柱设计。脚轮不能从工厂调节。可以使用其他部件调整弧度。丰田使用编码螺栓，头部带有圆点，表示固定的弯曲范围。但是，售后市场有更好的解决方案，凸轮螺栓可以调节± 1.75度。

paras.en: The most common wear points for the RAV4 are the lower control arms. The bushings on the arm can degrade and cause changes in the caster, camber and toe. Changing the control arm involves removing the lower crossmember.
paras.zh: RAV4最常见的磨损点是下控制臂。臂上的衬套可能会降级并导致脚轮、弧面和脚趾发生变化。更换控制臂涉及拆下下横梁。

paras.en: The rear suspension is a multilink design. On high-mileage vehicles, inspect the lower knuckle bushing for play and deflection. Another sign of a worn bushing is premature tire wear on the inside edge of the rear tires.
paras.zh: 后悬架采用多链路设计。在高里程车辆上，检查下关节衬套是否有间隙和偏转。衬套磨损的另一个迹象是后轮胎内边缘的轮胎过早磨损。

paras.en: The rear toe links use a sleeve that connects the two portions of the rod. The sleeves are problematic. The sleeves and jam nuts can come loose if you don’t take your time using the correct procedures. Don’t try to tighten both jam nuts at the same time. Instead, grab the sleeve with a crow’s foot and torque wrench and put an open-end wrench on the jam nuts. Tighten the sleeve to 15 ft/lbs.
paras.zh: 后脚趾连杆使用连接杆两部分的套管。袖子有问题。如果您不使用正确的程序，套筒和果酱螺母可能会松动。不要试图同时拧紧两个果酱螺母。相反，用乌鸦脚和扭矩扳手抓住套筒，然后将开口扳手放在果酱螺母上。将套管拧紧至15英尺/磅。

paras.en: If you get a 2005-2011 Toyota RAV4 in your shop for an alignment with a complaint of either rear tire wear or a knocking noise, you need to be aware of a recall and inspection campaign Toyota issued in 2012. Toyota Safety Recall COJ involved inspecting the right and left toe links for looseness. Based upon this inspection, it may have been necessary to replace the arm(s).
paras.zh: 如果您在您的商店中购买了2005-2011丰田RAV4 ，以应对后轮胎磨损或敲门声的投诉，您需要了解丰田在2012年发布的召回和检查活动。丰田安全召回CoJ涉及检查左右脚趾连杆是否松动。根据这次检查，可能需要更换机械臂。

paras.en: Toyota received reports from dealers indicating that some vehicles experienced symptoms of the recalled condition after being inspected or repaired. Toyota discovered that some inspections were not up to standards.
paras.zh: 丰田收到经销商的报告，表明一些车辆在检查或维修后出现了召回状况的症状。丰田发现一些检查不符合标准。

paras.en: If a lower toe link was inspected and has passed, it will have an epoxy and plastic covering indicating that it passed the inspection. The bad news is that if the cover is there, the toe can’t be adjusted and must be replaced. There are aftermarket toe links that utilize a better design than the original Toyota part.
paras.zh: 如果下脚趾连接件经过检查并通过，它将具有环氧树脂和塑料覆盖物，表明它通过了检查。坏消息是，如果盖子在那里，脚趾不能调整，必须更换。有一些售后市场的脚趾链节采用了比最初的丰田零件更好的设计。

paras.en: Camber can be adjusted with an adjustable upper arm. These arms can give an additional three degrees of adjustment. These components can give adjustments for the rest of the life of the vehicle and allow for fine-tuning of the rear camber angles to maximize tire life.
paras.zh: 弧度可通过可调节的上臂进行调整。这些臂可以提供额外的三度调整。这些部件可以为车辆的剩余寿命进行调整，并允许微调后弧角，以最大限度地延长轮胎寿命。

paras.en: Most 2006-2013 RAV4 models are equipped with an optional Vehicle Stability Control (VSC) system that requires a scan tool and special procedures to perform a zero-point calibration of the steering angle sensor. It is highly recommended to do this through the OBD-II port with a scan tool. Yes, it is possible to reset the system by jumping two pins in the diagnostic connector and disconnecting the battery. But, there is no way to confirm or document the calibration was properly performed.
paras.zh: 大多数2006-2013 RAV4型号都配备了可选的车辆稳定控制（ VSC ）系统，该系统需要扫描工具和特殊程序来执行转向角传感器的零点校准。强烈建议使用扫描工具通过OBD-II端口执行此操作。是的，可以通过跳过诊断接头中的两个引脚并断开电池连接来重置系统。但是，无法确认或记录校准是否正确进行。

paras.en: The steering position sensor’s basic function is to monitor the driver’s steering inputs. This includes the angle of the steering wheel and/or the rate at which the driver is turning the wheel. The steering position sensor on the RAV4 is located behind the steering wheel and is a high-resolution sensor.
paras.zh: 转向位置传感器的基本功能是监控驾驶员的转向输入。这包括方向盘的角度和/或驾驶员转动方向盘的速度。RAV4上的转向位置传感器位于方向盘后面，是一种高分辨率传感器。

paras.en: The VSC system relies on accurate steering input from the steering angle sensor to analyze a situation and apply appropriate measures to help direct the vehicle on the intended path. If the system is not calibrated after a toe adjustment, the system will not operate properly and may illuminate the VSC malfunction light after the driver has picked up their RAV4.
paras.zh: VSC系统依靠来自转向角传感器的精确转向输入来分析情况并应用适当的措施来帮助引导车辆沿着预期路径行驶。如果在脚趾调整后系统未校准，系统将无法正常运行，并且可能在驾驶员拿起RAV4后点亮VSC故障指示灯。

paras.en: The Toyota VSC system uses the information from the steering position sensor and compares the information to the yaw rate sensor to determine what the car is doing.
paras.zh: 丰田VSC系统使用来自转向位置传感器的信息，并将信息与偏航率传感器进行比较，以确定汽车在做什么。

paras.en: When a vehicle is aligned and the toe in the front or rear is altered, it changes the thrust angle of the vehicle. The thrust angle is directly connected with the slip angle and the measurements taken by the yaw position sensor. Even if you adjust only the rear toe, you are altering the thrust angle, and the steering position sensor must be recalibrated.
paras.zh: 当车辆对齐并且前部或后部的脚趾发生变化时，它会改变车辆的推力角。推力角与滑动角和偏航位置传感器进行的测量直接相关。即使您只调整后脚趾，您也在改变推力角，转向位置传感器必须重新校准。

paras.en: After the sensor is reset, it is necessary to drive the vehicle and turn the steering wheel to the right and left at the speed of 22 mph (35 km/h) for at least five seconds to calibrate the sensors and complete the reset. If this is not performed, the VSC may set a code and the sensor may read 1150 degrees. This is not an indication the sensor is faulty, only that it has not been properly reset.
paras.zh: 传感器复位后，需要驾驶车辆，以22英里/小时（ 35公里/小时）的速度向左右转动方向盘至少五秒钟，以校准传感器并完成复位。如果未执行此操作， VSC可以设置代码，传感器可以读取1150度。这并不表示传感器有故障，只是表示传感器未正确复位。

articles.title: Where Steering and Suspension Problems Come From
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: Ever drive a vehicle that just doesn’t feel right anymore? Maybe it wanders down the highway. Maybe there’s a clunk every time you hit a pothole. Maybe the steering wheel isn’t centered, the tires are wearing unevenly, or it just doesn’t inspire the confidence it used to.
paras.zh: 曾经驾驶过感觉不舒服的车辆吗？也许它在高速公路上徘徊。也许每次你撞到坑洞时都有一个叮当声。也许方向盘没有居中，轮胎磨损不均匀，或者它只是没有激发它过去的信心。

paras.en: The truth is, steering and suspension problems rarely come from a single worn out part. Every control arm, ball joint, tie rod, sway bar link, and bushing work together as one connected system. When one connection starts to wear, it puts added stress on the rest of the system, and before long, that small problem becomes several bigger ones.
paras.zh: 事实是，转向和悬架问题很少来自单个磨损的部件。每个控制臂、球接头、拉杆、摇杆连杆和衬套作为一个连接系统一起工作。当一个连接开始磨损时，它会给系统的其余部分带来额外的压力，不久，这个小问题就会变成几个更大的问题。

paras.en: That system level approach is exactly how TrakMotive has positioned its Suspensia brand chassis program. Learn more about it in this video, sponsored by TrakMotive.
paras.zh: 这种系统级方法正是TrakMotive定位其Suspensia品牌底盘计划的方式。在此视频中了解更多信息，该视频由TrakMotive赞助。

articles.title: Hunter Updates HawkEye XL Commercial Alignment System
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Hunter Engineering announced four new enhancements to its HawkEye XL Commercial Alignment System.
paras.zh: Hunter Engineering宣布对其HawkEye XL商业对中系统进行四项新的增强功能。

paras.en: The new enhancements include (with descriptions by the company):
paras.zh: 新的增强功能包括（公司的描述） ：

paras.en: 1) Magnetic wheel adapters – These adapters provide increased wheel protection, with no metal spades to get between the rim and tire, the company says. The adapters are available as an option for new and existing HawkEyeXL aligners.
paras.zh: 1 ）磁性车轮适配器–该公司表示，这些适配器提供了更强的车轮保护，轮辋和轮胎之间没有金属黑桃。这些适配器可选用于新的和现有的HawkEyeXL矫正器。

paras.en: 2) Drive-through sensor configuration – The new configuration will allow drive-through shops and OEM production to skip repositioning their equipment for each alignment. The sensors offer the same long-range vision and field of view, with up to 16-foot-wide tower spacing to accommodate commercial vehicles.
paras.zh: 2 ）直通传感器配置–新配置将允许直通车间和原始设备制造商生产跳过每次校准的设备重新定位。这些传感器提供相同的远程视野和视野，塔架间距高达16英尺，可容纳商用车。

paras.en: 3) New WinAlign software – Hunter’s latest WinAlign 18.3 software offers new target placement guidance to help the technician, aligner placement guidance so the cameras can easily see all the wheel targets, and the flexibility to perform thrustline and frame-reference alignments as desired.
paras.zh: 3 ）新的WinAlign软件– Hunter最新的WinAlign 18.3软件提供新的目标放置指导，以帮助技术人员，对准器放置指导，以便摄像头可以轻松查看所有车轮目标，并灵活地根据需要执行推力线和帧基准对准。

paras.en: 4) Latest-generation alignment cart – Technicians can store adapters and control the alignment system from the rear of the vehicles. The cart is completely untethered with a battery backup, allowing a full day’s work without carrying a cable around the shop, the company says.
paras.zh: 4 ）最新一代对中推车–技术人员可以从车辆后部存储适配器并控制对中系统。该公司表示，购物车完全不受电池备份的束缚，无需在商店周围携带电缆即可进行一整天的工作。

paras.en: The XL handles heavy-duty, medium-duty, light-duty and passenger vehicles.
paras.zh: XL可处理重型、中型、轻型和乘用车。

articles.title: MotoRad CEO Matt Buchholz on Aligning Values
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Matt Buchholz, CEO of MotoRad. In this interview, Buchholz described how the company’s D.R.I.V.E. core values — Dedication, Relationship, Innovation, Value Driven and Expertise — provide the cultural foundation for how its team operates internally and engages with customers and channel partners.
paras.zh: 本期 DriveTime 的主角是 MotoRad 首席执行官 Matt Buchholz。在这次采访中，Buchholz 描述了该公司的 D.R.I.V.E.核心价值观——奉献、关系、创新、价值驱动和专业知识——为其团队内部运作以及与客户和渠道合作伙伴互动的方式提供了文化基础。

paras.en: Buchholz emphasized that culture and strategy are closely connected. By aligning teams around common values and empowering employees to live them every day, he said MotoRad creates a foundation for continuous improvement — reflecting his philosophy that when an organization gets better, it gets bigger.
paras.zh: 布赫霍尔茨强调，文化与战略紧密相连。他表示，MotoRad 通过让团队围绕共同价值观进行调整，并赋予员工践行这些价值观的权力，为持续改进奠定了基础，这反映了他的理念：当组织变得更好时，它就会变得更大。

paras.en: As MotoRad expands across thermal management, emissions and powertrain controls, Buchholz said investment decisions begin with market intelligence and listening directly to customers. The company looks for opportunities that fit its existing capabilities and strategy while addressing clear market needs. Buchholz said it also evaluates adjacent categories for “low friction” opportunities where it can create value quickly. In many cases, some of MotoRad’s strongest product ideas have originated with technicians, counter professionals and other customers who identify ways the company can improve a product or make a repair easier.
paras.zh: Buchholz 表示，随着 MotoRad 在热管理、排放和动力系统控制方面的扩展，投资决策始于市场情报和直接倾听客户的意见。该公司寻找适合其现有能力和战略的机会，同时满足明确的市场需求。布赫霍尔茨表示，它还会评估相邻类别的“低摩擦”机会，以便快速创造价值。在许多情况下，MotoRad 的一些最强大的产品创意源自技术人员、柜台专业人员和其他客户，他们确定了公司改进产品或简化维修的方法。

paras.en: Looking ahead, Buchholz said MotoRad’s growth strategy centers on three areas: commercial execution, operational agility and technology. Commercially, the company plans to continue listening to the market, responding faster and creating greater value through areas such as coverage, service, business intelligence and quality. Operationally, MotoRad is focused on diversifying its global supply chain to maintain continuity of supply and become nimbler. Technology supports both priorities by improving efficiency, reducing waste and helping the company respond to rapidly increasing expectations for speed.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Buchholz also sees continued opportunity for the broader aftermarket as vehicle miles traveled and vehicle age increase and vehicle technologies across thermal management, emissions and powertrain controls become more complex. “We get to support this incredibly essential business that people enjoy,” he said.
paras.zh: 布赫霍尔茨还认为，随着车辆行驶里程和车龄的增加，以及热管理、排放和动力总成控制方面的车辆技术变得更加复杂，更广泛的售后市场将继续面临机遇。 “我们可以支持人们喜欢的这项极其重要的业务，”他说。

paras.en: • MotoRad’s D.R.I.V.E. core values and how they shape its culture, partnerships and approach to continuous improvement. (5:50)
paras.zh: • MotoRad的D.R.I.V.E.核心价值观以及它们如何塑造其文化、合作伙伴关系和持续改进的方法。(5:50)

paras.en: • MotoRad identifies its next growth opportunities by listening to customers, analyzing the market and exploring adjacent categories. (10:40)
paras.zh: • MotoRad 通过倾听客户意见、分析市场和探索相邻类别来确定下一个增长机会。 （10:40）

paras.en: • How MotoRad is positioning for the next two years around commercial execution, supply chain agility and technology. (13:46)
paras.zh: • MotoRad在未来两年如何围绕商业执行、供应链灵活性和技术进行定位。(13:46)

paras.en: • How Buchholz sees technology and AI helping MotoRad increase efficiency, create customer value and meet rising expectations for speed. (17:39)
paras.zh: • Buchholz如何看待技术和人工智能帮助MotoRad提高效率、创造客户价值并满足不断上升的速度期望。(17:39)

paras.en: • Lightning Round: Buchholz shares some personal insights. (20:27)
paras.zh: •闪电般的回合： Buchholz分享了一些个人见解。（ 20:27 ）

articles.title: AACF Appoints Gary MacCausland to Board of Trustees
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The Automotive Aftermarket Charitable Foundation (AACF) announced the appointment of Gary MacCausland to its board of trustees. MacCausland serves as chief operating officer of VIP Tires & Service. He joins the AACF board as he assumes the presidency of the Tire Industry Association (TIA). MacCausland replaces Debra Hamlin on the foundation’s board.
paras.zh: 汽车售后市场慈善基金会 (AACF) 宣布任命 Gary MacCausland 为其董事会成员。 MacCausland 担任 VIP Tires & Service 的首席运营官。他在担任轮胎工业协会 (TIA) 主席期间加入了 AACF 董事会。麦考斯兰接替黛布拉·哈姆林担任基金会董事会成员。

paras.en: AACF Welcomes Experienced Industry Leader
paras.zh: AACF 欢迎经验丰富的行业领袖

paras.en: MacCausland brings more than 35 years of experience in the automotive tire and service industry, primarily in leadership roles. Raised in an automotive family, he developed an early appreciation for the business and its people. Throughout his career, he has focused on investing in teams, developing talent and helping employees advance into leadership positions.
paras.zh: MacCausland 在汽车轮胎和服务行业拥有超过 35 年的经验，主要担任领导职务。他在汽车世家长大，很早就对企业及其员工产生了欣赏。在他的整个职业生涯中，他一直专注于投资团队、培养人才和帮助员工晋升领导职位。

paras.en: For the past 15 years, MacCausland has helped guide the growth of VIP Tires & Service. The 100-year-old, family-owned company operates under its third generation of leadership.
paras.zh: 在过去的 15 年里，MacCausland 帮助引导了 VIP Tires & Service 的发展。这家拥有 100 年历史的家族企业由第三代领导层运营。

paras.en: His experience and longstanding support of AACF will provide perspective as the foundation seeks to reach more aftermarket families facing hardship.
paras.zh: 他的经验和对AACF的长期支持将为该基金会寻求接触更多面临困境的售后市场家庭提供视角。

paras.en: “I am excited and honored to be part of an organization that is committed to taking care of the members of the automotive community and their families,” said MacCausland.
paras.zh: “我很高兴也很荣幸成为这个致力于照顾汽车社区成员及其家人的组织的一员，”MacCausland 说道。

paras.en: Foundation Recognizes MacCausland’s Industry Connections
paras.zh: 基金会认可 MacCausland 的行业联系

paras.en: “Gary has great familiarity with the AACF, and we’re pleased to welcome him to the board,” said John Kairys, executive director of AACF. “He understands this industry and cares about the people who work in it. His experience and relationships will help us reach more families who need assistance. We also thank Debra Hamlin for her service and the time and care she has given to our mission.”
paras.zh: “Gary 对 AACF 非常熟悉，我们很高兴欢迎他加入董事会，”AACF 执行董事 John Kairys 说道。 “他了解这个行业并关心在这个行业工作的人们。他的经验和关系将帮助我们接触到更多需要帮助的家庭。我们还要感谢黛布拉·哈姆林的服务以及她为我们的使命所付出的时间和关心。”

paras.en: The foundation plans to work with MacCausland to strengthen industry connections and expand awareness of available assistance. AACF also aims to help more families identify available resources when they need support.
paras.zh: 该基金会计划与 MacCausland 合作，加强行业联系并提高对可用援助的认识。 AACF 还旨在帮助更多家庭在需要支持时找到可用资源。

articles.title: Automotive Parts Headquarters Raises $513K for WACOSA
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Automotive Parts Headquarters Inc. (APH), together with its supplier partners and the Bartlett family, raised $513,000 through its annual fundraiser benefiting WACOSA, a central Minnesota nonprofit serving adults with disabilities. The 2026 event brings the fundraiser’s 14-year total to $3.7 million.
paras.zh: Automotive Parts Headhead Inc. (APH) 与其供应商合作伙伴和 Bartlett 家族一起，通过其年度筹款活动筹集了 513,000 美元，惠及 WACOSA，这是一家为残疾人服务的明尼苏达州中部非营利组织。 2026 年的活动使该活动 14 年来的筹款总额达到 370 万美元。

paras.en: Proceeds support WACOSA programs that provide meaningful employment, day services and opportunities for more than 650 adults with disabilities across central Minnesota.
paras.zh: 收益将用于支持 WACOSA 项目，为明尼苏达州中部地区 650 多名残疾成年人提供有意义的就业、日间服务和机会。

paras.en: The event began with a walleye shore lunch and guided tours of WACOSA before attendees gathered at APH’s newest facility (a bulk storage warehouse) in St. Cloud for a pie and ice cream social celebrating its grand opening and APH’s “Building Our Future Together” initiative.
paras.zh: 活动以白眼鱼岸边午餐和 WCOSA 导游带领开始，然后与会者聚集在 APH 位于圣克劳德的最新设施（散装仓储仓库），参加馅饼和冰淇淋社交活动，庆祝其盛大开业和 APH 的“共创未来”倡议。

paras.en: Attendees also participated in a hands-on art experience led by WACOSA artist-in-residence Dan Mondloch. The individual pieces created during the event will be incorporated into a collaborative collage inspired by the northern lights above a Minnesota lake.

articles.title: EKPO Advances Fuel Cell Technology Through HyFleet Project
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Drawing on its experience developing and industrializing fuel cell technology, EKPO is advancing hydrogen use across various mobility applications. The HyFleet project illustrates how this technology can support demanding specialty vehicle applications. BRP-Rotax developed the side-by-side vehicle in collaboration with industry and research partners. The vehicle offers a range of up to 400 kilometers and a refueling time of approximately five minutes.
paras.zh: EKPO 凭借其开发和工业化燃料电池技术的经验，正在推进氢在各种移动应用中的使用。 HyFleet 项目展示了该技术如何支持要求苛刻的特种车辆应用。 BRP-Rotax 与行业和研究合作伙伴合作开发了并排车辆。该车的续航里程可达 400 公里，加油时间约为 5 分钟。

paras.en: Fuel Cell Technology Powers HyFleet Vehicle
paras.zh: 燃料电池技术为 HyFleet 车辆提供动力

paras.en: EKPO’s high-performance NM12 stack forms the heart of the fuel cell system. The stack delivers high power density and supports the 90-kW fuel cell system. The system achieves an efficiency of up to 60% and responds rapidly to changes in load.
paras.zh: EKPO 的高性能 NM12 电堆构成了燃料电池系统的核心。该电堆提供高功率密度并支持 90 kW 燃料电池系统。系统效率高达60%，对负载变化响应迅速。

paras.en: Extensive on- and off-road testing under real-world conditions demonstrates the system’s suitability for practical use.
paras.zh: 在现实条件下进行的广泛的公路和越野测试证明了该系统的实际使用能力。

paras.en: EKPO collaborated with HyCentA to develop a passive hydrogen recirculation system that provides additional robustness and efficiency. An innovative two-step needle ejector reduces mechanical complexity.
paras.zh: EKPO 与 HyCentA 合作开发了一种被动氢气再循环系统，可提供额外的稳健性和效率。创新的两步针喷射器降低了机械复杂性。

paras.en: The system also supports cold starts and freeze starts at temperatures as low as minus 20 degrees Celsius. These capabilities allow operation in winter and alpine conditions.
paras.zh: 该系统还支持低至-20摄氏度的冷启动和冷冻启动。这些功能允许在冬季和高山条件下运行。

paras.en: “HyFleet shows how we are applying our many years of fuel cell expertise to new mobility applications,” said Dr. Stefan Dwenger, managing director of EKPO Fuel Cell Technologies GmbH. “Hydrogen is particularly well suited to demanding on- and off-road applications that require long operating hours and high availability. Our NM12 fuel cell stack, backed by our expertise in development and industrialization, helps our partners put this potential to work.”
paras.zh: “HyFleet 展示了我们如何将多年的燃料电池专业知识应用到新的移动应用中，”EKPO 燃料电池技术有限公司董事总经理 Stefan Dwenger 博士说道。 “氢气特别适合需要长时间运行和高可用性的高要求公路和越野应用。我们的 NM12 燃料电池堆以我们在开发和工业化方面的专业知识为后盾，可帮助我们的合作伙伴发挥这一潜力。”

paras.en: HyFleet Tests Hydrogen Applications Under Real-World Conditions
paras.zh: HyFleet 在现实条件下测试氢气应用

paras.en: The HyFleet initiative tests this technology under real-world operating conditions. The project generates insights into hydrogen-powered specialty vehicles for agriculture, forestry, tourism, municipal services and industry, among other sectors.
paras.zh: HyFleet 计划在实际操作条件下测试了这项技术。该项目为农业、林业、旅游、市政服务和工业等领域的氢动力特种车辆提供了深入的见解。

paras.en: HyFleet takes an integrated approach to operating hydrogen-powered vehicle fleets. The project considers every stage, from local green hydrogen production to the powertrain, vehicle and scalable refueling infrastructure. The results also help guide further development and the technology’s use in additional applications.
paras.zh: HyFleet 采用综合方法来运营氢动力车队。该项目考虑了从当地绿色氢生产到动力总成、车辆和可扩展的加氢基础设施的每个阶段。研究结果还有助于指导进一步的开发以及该技术在其他应用中的使用。

paras.en: “HyFleet has demonstrated that a hydrogen fuel cell powertrain can also work successfully in a compact special-purpose vehicle designed for off-road use,” said Stefan Arndt, general manager BRP-Rotax, VP R&D Powertrain. “In EKPO, we have a partner that brought extensive experience in developing and industrializing fuel cell stacks to the project, along with technology tailored to our needs. EKPO thus played a key role in turning our vehicle concept into reality.”
paras.zh: BRP-Rotax 总经理、动力总成研发副总裁 Stefan Arndt 表示：“HyFleet 已经证明，氢燃料电池动力总成也可以在专为越野用途设计的紧凑型专用车辆中成功运行。” “在 EKPO，我们的合作伙伴为该项目带来了燃料电池堆开发和工业化方面的丰富经验，以及根据我们的需求量身定制的技术。因此，EKPO 在将我们的车辆概念变为现实的过程中发挥了关键作用。”

paras.en: EKPO to Showcase Fuel Cell Portfolio at Hydrogen Technology World Expo 2026
paras.zh: EKPO 将在 2026 年氢能技术世界博览会上展示燃料电池产品组合

paras.en: EKPO brings more than 20 years of fuel cell technology experience to its development and industrialization capabilities. The company draws on its automotive industry experience to develop fuel cell solutions. Alongside HyFleet, EKPO will showcase fuel cell stacks and components for mobile and stationary applications at the event in Hamburg.
paras.zh: EKPO将20多年的燃料电池技术经验融入到其开发和产业化能力中。该公司利用其汽车行业经验来开发燃料电池解决方案。 EKPO 将与 HyFleet 一起在汉堡的活动中展示用于移动和固定应用的燃料电池堆和组件。

paras.en: The modular platforms offer power outputs ranging from 16 kW to more than 400 kW. Their designs emphasize high power density, efficiency and reliable operation. EKPO also develops customized stack solutions that meet each customer’s system architecture and specific requirements.
paras.zh: 模块化平台提供的功率输出范围为 16 kW 至 400 kW 以上。他们的设计强调高功率密度、效率和可靠运行。 EKPO 还开发定制的堆栈解决方案，以满足每个客户的系统架构和特定要求。

paras.en: EKPO Develops Components for Green Hydrogen Production
paras.zh: EKPO 开发绿色制氢组件

paras.en: EKPO’s portfolio extends to green hydrogen production. The company develops and manufactures metal bipolar plates for proton exchange membrane (PEM) electrolyzers. EKPO applies its expertise in precision forming, coating and sealing technologies to meet the specific demands of electrolysis. The company designs the bipolar plates to withstand demanding operating conditions and support scalable industrial manufacturing.
paras.zh: EKPO 的产品组合扩展到绿色氢气生产。该公司开发和制造用于质子交换膜（PEM）电解槽的金属双极板。 EKPO 应用其在精密成型、涂层和密封技术方面的专业知识来满足电解的特定需求。该公司设计的双极板能够承受苛刻的操作条件并支持可扩展的工业制造。
