articles.title: Value Added: Creating a Culture Beyond Cost
articles.author: Thomas Dayton

paras.en: In case you haven’t noticed, the parts business is a pretty crowded marketplace. In my own little hometown of less than 30,000 people, we have EIGHT parts stores! There are also eight OEM dealer franchises, so there is certainly no lack of options for purchasing auto parts and supplies in our area… and that doesn’t even include online options. With 16 places offering parts in the immediate area, if we want to make a sale we have to make our offerings more attractive than everyone else.
paras.zh: 如果您没有注意到，零部件业务是一个非常拥挤的市场。在我自己不到 30,000 人的小家乡，我们有八家零件店！还有八家 OEM 经销商特许经营权，因此在我们地区当然不乏购买汽车零部件和用品的选择……而且这甚至不包括在线选项。附近地区有 16 个地方提供零件，如果我们想进行销售，我们必须使我们的产品比其他地方更具吸引力。

paras.en: In order to stand out in a crowded market, your operation needs to add value to your products beyond whatever your competitors are offering. That “value” may take the form of different things to different consumers, but this sort of “it factor” is integral to making you stand out in a crowd. Since there are so many kinds of added value, identifying those things your customers value can be challenging.
paras.zh: 为了在拥挤的市场中脱颖而出，您的运营需要为您的产品增加超出竞争对手所提供的价值。对于不同的消费者来说，这种“价值”可能会采取不同的形式，但这种“it因素”对于让你在人群中脱颖而出至关重要。由于附加值的种类繁多，因此确定客户看重的东西可能具有挑战性。

paras.en: The Value Stick may sound like some off-brand deodorant, but it’s a concept endorsed by Harvard Business School to visualize the four factors that help build a value-based business strategy. At the top of the stick is a customer’s “willingness to purchase” (WTP), and at the bottom lies your own “willingness to sell” (WTS). In between the two are your cost and the selling price of a product. These four markers are all, to some degree, moveable up or down The Value Stick. WTS primarily concerns the vendors who supply your parts and employees who provide labor for your store. It is the lowest price at which you can purchase your stock and pay someone to sell and distribute it to your customers. WTP, on the other hand, depends solely on a customer’s estimation of your product’s value, and represents the maximum amount of money they will hand over for your product at the point of sale.
paras.zh: Value Stick 可能听起来像是一些非品牌除臭剂，但这是哈佛商学院认可的一个概念，旨在可视化有助于建立基于价值的商业战略的四个因素。棒的顶部是客户的“购买意愿”（WTP），底部是您自己的“销售意愿”（WTS）。两者之间是您的成本和产品的售价。在某种程度上，这四个标记都可以在价值棒上上下移动。 WTS 主要涉及为您提供零件的供应商以及为您的商店提供劳动力的员工。这是您购买股票并付款给某人将其出售并分销给您的客户的最低价格。另一方面，WTP 完全取决于客户对您产品价值的估计，代表他们在销售点为您的产品支付的最高金额。

paras.en: Price can be a funny thing. For some, a higher price signals an increase in quality over a less-expensive product (brand name vs. generics, for example), or the cache of luxury (they’d pay $50 more for a Tommy Hilfiger shirt than a similar garment from Wal-Mart). For others, a higher price only means your business is making excessive profits… at their expense. (“I can buy the same thing on Amazon for $20 less than your price, why are you so high?”)
paras.zh: 价格可能是一件有趣的事情。对于一些人来说，较高的价格意味着相对于较便宜的产品（例如品牌产品与非专利产品）的质量提高，或者奢侈品的储备（他们愿意为一件 Tommy Hilfiger 衬衫比沃尔玛的类似服装多花 50 美元）。对于其他人来说，更高的价格只意味着您的企业正在赚取超额利润……而代价是他们的损失。 （“我可以在亚马逊上以比你的价格便宜 20 美元的价格买到同样的东西，为什么你的价格这么高？”）

paras.en: I believe that many of our customers (professional and amateur alike) still view the products we sell daily as interchangeable commodities. As parts professionals, we know better, but when we are faced with those customers for whom “any old thing will do,” we have to use other means to attract them to spend their money with us. Of the four variables along the Value Stick, WTP is the one we have the most influence over. Short of renegotiating supplier prices or reducing staffing costs, we don’t have much control over the cost of our inputs. We must maintain a reasonable margin in order to pay our overhead and keep ourselves in business, so deeply discounting prices is not a long-term solution. The only remaining way to move the needle is to increase the value of our product. Not the individual gasket, chassis part, or alternator, but rather through the experience of purchasing it from us.
paras.zh: 我相信我们的许多客户（专业和业余）仍然将我们日常销售的产品视为可互换的商品。作为零部件专业人士，我们更清楚，但当我们面对那些“老东西都行”的客户时，我们必须通过其他方式来吸引他们在我们这里花钱。在价值棒的四个变量中，WTP 是我们影响最大的一个。如果不重新协商供应商价格或降低员工成本，我们对投入成本没有太多控制权。我们必须保持合理的利润，才能支付管理费用并维持业务，因此大幅折扣并不是长久之计。剩下的唯一方法就是增加我们产品的价值。不是单个垫圈、底盘部件或交流发电机，而是通过从我们这里购买的经验。

paras.en: All else being equal, people buy from the people and places they know and trust. It is easier to build these kinds of relationships with commercial customers simply because of the volume of their business. We have more opportunities to show them that we are an important partner in their success, and that we value that partnership. Prompt delivery, complete and accurate order fulfillment and ease of doing business are all value-added services that help justify a premium price tag. For the more occasional customer (professional or retail), we have a shorter window of opportunity to make a lasting impression. Superior customer service is still our greatest advantage with this sort of customer. Employing a knowledgeable and friendly staff, or even utilizing online lookup and ordering platforms can streamline the buying process for customers who value convenience.
paras.zh: 在其他条件相同的情况下，人们会从他们认识和信任的人和地方购买商品。仅仅因为商业客户的业务量，就更容易与他们建立这种关系。我们有更多机会向他们表明我们是他们成功的重要合作伙伴，并且我们重视这种伙伴关系。及时交货、完整准确的订单履行以及轻松开展业务都是增值服务，有助于证明高价标签的合理性。对于偶尔的客户（专业或零售），我们留下持久印象的机会窗口较短。优质的客户服务仍然是我们对此类客户的最大优势。雇用知识渊博、友善的员工，甚至利用在线查找和订购平台，都可以为重视便利的客户简化购买流程。

paras.en: Many retailers also build value into their product offering by providing additional services like code-reading, battery testing and installation, or loaner tool programs. Geared toward the non-professional segment of their customer base, these services also position the retailer as a trusted partner in maintaining personal vehicles. Adding value beyond the cost and quality of your parts increases retention and creates a scenario in which satisfied customers become advocates for your business. Give them something no one else can, and they have no reason to go anywhere else.
paras.zh: 许多零售商还通过提供代码读取、电池测试和安装或借用工具程序等附加服务来为其产品创造价值。这些服务面向非专业客户群，也使零售商成为维护个人车辆方面值得信赖的合作伙伴。除了零件的成本和质量之外，还可以增加附加值，从而提高保留率，并创造一个让满意的客户成为您业务的拥护者的场景。给他们一些其他人无法提供的东西，他们就没有理由去其他地方。

articles.title: Get Smart: Processes for Continuous Improvement
articles.author: Thomas Dayton

paras.en: Continuous improvement is a business strategy aimed at providing superior customer service through the implementation of a series of small changes in your operations and policies. These individual improvements may be centered around efficiency, productivity, employee happiness, or a multitude of other factors, but, ultimately, their purpose is to make your operation better at attracting, serving and retaining customers.
paras.zh: 持续改进是一种业务策略，旨在通过对运营和政策进行一系列小的改变来提供卓越的客户服务。这些单独的改进可能以效率、生产力、员工幸福感或许多其他因素为中心，但最终的目的是让您的运营更好地吸引、服务和留住客户。

paras.en: Continuous improvement is most closely associated with the Japanese word Kaizen. The post-World War II rebuilding of the Japanese industry led to several advances in manufacturing efficiency and quality control, many of which were the basis for “modern” manufacturing and business concepts like “lean” or “just-in-time” manufacturing, Six-Sigma quality control and improvement, and “The Toyota Way.” Each of these concepts has its own variation on identifying potential roadblocks to success, proposing solutions, implementing the means to those solutions, and analyzing the success or failure of any changes made.
paras.zh: 持续改进与日语中的“Kaizen”一词密切相关。二战后日本工业的重建带来了制造效率和质量控制方面的多项进步，其中许多是“现代”制造和商业概念的基础，例如“精益”或“准时化”制造、六西格码质量控制和改进以及“丰田方式”。这些概念中的每一个在识别成功的潜在障碍、提出解决方案、实施这些解决方案的方法以及分析所做的任何变革的成功或失败方面都有自己的变化。

paras.en: Know your customer: by understanding the customer’s needs and wants, you can implement improvements that matter to them.
paras.zh: 了解您的客户：通过了解客户的需求和愿望，您可以实施对他们重要的改进。

paras.en: Let it flow: removing barriers to efficiency and reducing waste creates a smooth workflow.
paras.zh: 让它流动：消除效率障碍并减少浪费，打造顺畅的工作流程。

paras.en: Go to where the work happens: don’t manage from an office, see the problem firsthand.
paras.zh: 前往工作地点：不要在办公室进行管理，直接查看问题。

paras.en: Empower people: improvements and the resulting success require input from the “bottom up.”
paras.zh: 赋予人们权力：改进和由此产生的成功需要“自下而上”的投入。

paras.en: Transparency: share plans, goals, and results with the entire team.
paras.zh: 透明度：与整个团队分享计划、目标和结果。

paras.en: These principles can be applied to any problem in your operation, but continuous improvement is often used initially in smaller, incremental stages. These small changes are easier to implement, as they do not require a complete overhaul of company culture or the involvement of the entire staff. These can be “experimental” changes on a small scale, to test their effectiveness in specific situations or with a particular department. Breakthrough continuous improvements are larger in scale, and are most effective when a process or operation is in need of a complete overhaul. In either situation, proposed improvements should align with these five principles.
paras.zh: 这些原则可以应用于您运营中的任何问题，但持续改进通常最初用于较小的渐进阶段。这些小的改变更容易实施，因为它们不需要对公司文化进行彻底改革或全体员工的参与。这些可以是小规模的“实验性”改变，以测试其在特定情况下或特定部门的有效性。突破性的持续改进规模更大，并且当流程或操作需要彻底检修时最有效。无论哪种情况，拟议的改进都应符合这五个原则。

paras.en: In order to transform the vague idea of a potential improvement into a clear plan of action with defined results, continuous improvement plans often rely on setting “SMART” goals. SMART is an acronym for “Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Timely.” SMART goals are a litmus test for determining if what you want to achieve is realistic and worthwhile to spend the time, energy, and money pursuing. Have you set a specific goal that accurately reflects the improvement(s) which you are hoping to implement? Can you measure the progress in a clear and meaningful way, so you know where you are in the process and know when you have achieved the goal? Is the improvement achievable with your current staff and resources? Are the changes relevant to your operation’s mission, values, and culture? And finally, is the goal time-sensitive? A goal without a deadline is more of a dream.
paras.zh: 为了将潜在改进的模糊想法转化为具有明确结果的明确行动计划，持续改进计划通常依赖于设定“SMART”目标。 SMART 是“具体、可衡量、可实现、相关、及时”的缩写。 SMART 目标是一个试金石，用于确定您想要实现的目标是否现实且值得花费时间、精力和金钱来追求。您是否设定了准确反映您希望实现的改进的具体目标？您能否以清晰且有意义的方式衡量进度，以便了解自己在此过程中所处的位置以及何时实现目标？以您现有的员工和资源可以实现改进吗？这些变化与您的运营使命、价值观和文化相关吗？最后，目标是否具有时间敏感性？没有最后期限的目标更像是一个梦想。

paras.en: Once your organization has committed to continuous improvement and SMART goals have been set, the next step is to create and standardize the processes you want to use in working toward those goals. Staff must be given the tools (and the training) to implement any intended changes, and also an opportunity to express constructive opinions concerning the “real-world” effectiveness of the improvements. Project leaders should monitor the progress of each improvement project throughout the process and measure the results using key performance indicators (KPIs) tied to the results you hope to achieve through the planned changes.
paras.zh: 一旦您的组织致力于持续改进并设定了 SMART 目标，下一步就是创建并标准化您在实现这些目标时要使用的流程。必须为员工提供工具（和培训）来实施任何预期的变革，并有机会表达有关改进的“现实”有效性的建设性意见。项目负责人应在整个过程中监控每个改进项目的进度，并使用与您希望通过计划变更实现的结果相关的关键绩效指标 (KPI) 来衡量结果。

paras.en: If the process yields positive results, you are (as an organization) one step closer to achieving your goal of serving your customers more effectively. Share your successes with those who helped create them, with others in the organization who may benefit from the discovery, and, most importantly, with the customers whom you are doing this for in the first place!
paras.zh: 如果该过程产生积极的结果，您（作为一个组织）距离实现更有效地为客户提供服务的目标又近了一步。与那些帮助创造这些成功的人、组织中可能从这一发现中受益的其他人，以及最重要的是，与您首先为之服务的客户分享您的成功！

articles.title: 'The back of her head had been removed by a single blow from a sharp blade': Archaeological clues are revealing the horrific lives and deaths of the people enslaved by Vikings
articles.author: Neil Price

paras.en: Slavery has existed for thousands of years, permeating ancient and modern societies across the world. The Vikings were no different. Enslaved people were valuable commodities, being captured and then traded across the Vikings' vast networks. Legal texts and written sources show how enslaved people were sold at trading centers in the same vein as cattle.
paras.zh: 奴隶制已经存在了数千年，渗透到世界各地的古代和现代社会。维京人也不例外。奴隶是有价值的商品，被俘虏然后通过维京人庞大的网络进行交易。法律文本和书面资料表明，奴隶是如何像牛一样在交易中心被出售的。

paras.en: In this excerpt from "The Sea-King and the Sorceress: Life and Death in the Viking Age" (Basic Books, 2026), author and archaeologist Neil Price looks at the horrific lives of the "thralls" — the Viking term for the enslaved. In it, he highlights the inhumane treatment of enslaved people, from the raids to kidnap people into the slave trade to a woman who appears to have been killed as a tribute to a high-status man.
paras.zh: 在《海王与女巫：维京时代的生与死》（Basic Books，2026 年）的摘录中，作家兼考古学家尼尔·普莱斯 (Neil Price) 审视了“奴隶”（维京人对奴隶的称呼）的可怕生活。在其中，他强调了对奴隶的不人道待遇，从袭击绑架人进行奴隶贸易，到一名妇女被杀，以纪念一位地位高的男人。

paras.en: Neil Price interview: 'It gives us a glimpse of a different kind of Viking life': Archaeologist Neil Price on the sea-kings, sorcerers and Sámi who lived during the Viking Age
paras.zh: 尼尔·普莱斯采访：“它让我们一睹不同的维京生活”：考古学家尼尔·普莱斯谈维京时代的海王、巫师和萨米人

paras.en: The vast majority of the Norse population were farmers, but there is another group of people who were almost as numerous, though very hard to find in the archaeological record: the enslaved. They have only recently begun to be properly acknowledged in our histories, partly because of the long-standing neglect of the marginalized and vulnerable in many cultures, but in the Viking world also due to a particular coincidence of terminology. For the Norse, the unfree were þrælar, translated into English as "thralls," which is too mild a word to convey its true meaning.
paras.zh: 绝大多数挪威人都是农民，但还有另一群人的数量几乎与他们一样多，尽管在考古记录中很难找到：奴隶。它们直到最近才开始在我们的历史中得到适当的承认，部分原因是许多文化中长期忽视边缘化和弱势群体，但在维京世界中也由于术语的特殊巧合。对于挪威人来说，不自由的人是“þrælar”，翻译成英语是“奴隶”，这个词太温和，无法表达其真正含义。

paras.en: Today, we can be enthralled by a work of art or even a person, but we do not say that we're enslaved by them. Norse thraldom took many forms, some less severe or permanent than others, but all involved the loss of liberty and rights, and the subjugation of one person to another through servitude. A chapter here, even with tangential references in a few others, is nowhere near enough to do justice to this side of the Norse experience (or rather, often the non-Norse experience, since many of them were kidnapped abroad during raids and other campaigns). Archaeological recognition can at least restore some measure of individual dignity, though more comforting to us than to them.
paras.zh: 今天，我们可以被一件艺术品甚至一个人所吸引，但我们并不说我们被它们所奴役。北欧奴隶制有多种形式，有些形式不如其他形式严重或持久，但所有形式都涉及自由和权利的丧失，以及一个人通过奴役对另一个人的征服。这里的一章，即使在其他一些章节中有一些切题的参考，也远远不足以公正地描述挪威人经历的这一方面（或者更确切地说，通常是非挪威人的经历，因为他们中的许多人在突袭和其他战役中在国外被绑架）。考古学的认可至少可以在一定程度上恢复个人尊严，尽管对我们来说比对他们来说更令人安慰。

paras.en: Slavery, as both a practice and an integrated economic system, was an indivisible part of Viking-Age Norse society and had probably already become established in Scandinavia centuries or even millennia earlier. People could be born into slavery, or be forced into it through kidnap or war, and then find themselves sold on, sometimes through many hands and over great distances. Some free people might even temporarily sell themselves in a form of indenture, as a means of paying off debts or other obligations.
paras.zh: 奴隶制作为一种实践和一个综合的经济体系，是维京时代的挪威社会不可分割的一部分，并且可能早在几个世纪甚至几千年前就已经在斯堪的纳维亚半岛确立了。人们可能生来就是奴隶，或者通过绑架或战争被迫成为奴隶，然后发现自己被出卖，有时是经过很多人的手，甚至是远距离的出卖。一些自由人甚至可能以契约的形式暂时出卖自己，作为偿还债务或其他义务的手段。

paras.en: Thralls on Norse settlements were ranked in a hierarchical and quite specific nomenclature of service categories and forced to undertake all the tasks of the farm and household. In a few, rare cases, thralls could take on senior responsibilities of estate management, with a special title — bryti — to match. One such man ran the royal estate at Hovgården opposite the island town of Birka, and was allowed to raise a runestone to himself and his wife, though one wonders who paid for it. Nonetheless, the vast majority of thralls endured lives of drudgery.
paras.zh: 挪威定居点的奴隶按照等级制度和相当具体的服务类别命名法进行排名，并被迫承担农场和家庭的所有任务。在极少数情况下，奴隶可以承担庄园管理的高级职责，并有一个特殊的头衔——bryti——与之相匹配。其中一位男子经营着比尔卡岛小镇对面的 Hovgården 的皇家庄园，并被允许为自己和他的妻子建造一块符文石，尽管有人想知道是谁付钱的。尽管如此，绝大多数奴隶还是过着苦役的生活。

paras.en: The grim reality is summarized with derogatory terminology in the poem Rígsþula, the "List of Rígr" (another name for the god Heimdall, or perhaps for Odin): "They fixed fences, dunged fields, worked at the pigs, watched over the goats, dug the peat." Even their names are shaming, mocking their appearance or hygiene: they translate as Badbreath, Stumpy, Fatty, Bedmate, Craneshanks, Dumpy, and many more. Thralls were extremely vulnerable to sexual exploitation. The textual records of viking raids, coming from every culture that was attacked, emphasize that women were particularly targeted for kidnapping and enslavement.
paras.zh: 诗歌《Rígsþula》（海姆达尔神的另一个名字，也可能是奥丁的名字）中用贬义的术语概括了严峻的现实：“他们修理栅栏，给田地施粪，在猪身上干活，看管山羊，挖泥炭。”甚至他们的名字也令人羞愧，嘲笑他们的外表或卫生：他们被翻译为“Badbreath”、“Stumpy”、“Fatty”、“Bedmate”、“Craneshanks”、“Dumpy”等等。奴隶极易遭受性剥削。来自每种受攻击文化的维京袭击的文字记录都强调，妇女尤其成为绑架和奴役的目标。

paras.en: In the ninth century, as the viking attacks escalated both in Western Europe and on the rivers of the east, the taking of captives came to be one of their prime objectives, feeding the lethal trinity of raiding, trading and slaving. In the words of Ibn Miskawayh, a Persian official who described a viking attack on the city of Bardha'a in what is now Azerbaijan in 943: "They kept the women and boys, whom they raped and enslaved [ . . . ] They dragged the women, boys and girls they wanted with them."
paras.zh: 九世纪，随着维京人对西欧和东部河流的袭击不断升级，俘虏成为他们的首要目标之一，助长了掠夺、贸易和奴隶制的致命三位一体。用波斯官员伊本·米斯卡瓦赫 (Ibn Miskawayh) 的话来说，他描述了 943 年维京人对巴尔达 (Bardha'a) 市（位于现在的阿塞拜疆）的袭击：“他们保留了妇女和男孩，他们强奸并奴役了他们……他们拖走了他们想要的妇女、男孩和女孩。”

paras.en: The repetition drives home the point, and little imagination is required to sense the undiluted horror. Some of these raids were informed by advance intelligence gathering and directed against high-profile targets for whom ransom could be demanded, but many were destined for sex trafficking, especially to the Arab world. Enslaved humans, particularly from the Baltic region, were among the main commodities exchanged eastwards along the Silk Roads.
paras.zh: 重复的内容让我们明白了要点，几乎不需要想象力就能感受到纯粹的恐怖。其中一些袭击是通过预先情报收集获得的，针对的是可以索要赎金的知名目标，但许多袭击的目的是进行性贩运，特别是针对阿拉伯世界。奴隶，特别是来自波罗的海地区的奴隶，是沿着丝绸之路向东交换的主要商品之一。

paras.en: In late ninth-century Scandinavia, the logistical needs of the escalating raids brought new demands on the workforce at an ever-larger scale, especially in all the many industries connected with shipbuilding (including textile production, timber management, tar manufacture, ironworking, and much more). This in turn drove the need for unfree labor to still greater levels.
paras.zh: 在九世纪末的斯堪的纳维亚半岛，不断升级的袭击的后勤需求给劳动力带来了更大规模的新需求，特别是在与造船相关的所有行业（包括纺织生产、木材管理、焦油制造、钢铁加工等）。这反过来又将对不自由劳动力的需求推向更高的水平。

paras.en: As economic expansion enlarged the capacity for ship-borne aggression and released the agricultural workforce to crew these expeditions, the increased flow of human victims enabled its continuance in a vicious circle. Enslavement was one of the primary characteristics of the Viking Age: the raids were a key component of it and of the Norse diaspora that resulted.
paras.zh: 随着经济扩张扩大了船载侵略的能力，并释放了农业劳动力来参加这些探险活动，人类受害者的增加使其继续陷入恶性循环。奴役是维京时代的主要特征之一：袭击是其中的一个关键组成部分，也是由此产生的北欧侨民的一个关键组成部分。

paras.en: To what degree these people are visible in the funerary record is hard to know. There were probably no diagnostic items that were used exclusively by thralls, so we cannot perceive them through specific objects in the graves. It also seems unlikely that those without rights and with few possessions, indeed with hardly any legal identity as individuals rather than chattel, would be accorded conventional burials. Ibn Faḍlān says that thralls who died while traveling were simply discarded, but this is unlikely to have been the case in settlements. When we do encounter them, it is often because they were killed as part of funerary rituals and their bodies deposited in burials. One example that we can explore here comes from an excavation at the site of Ballateare, in Jurby parish on the northwestern coast of the Isle of Man — the best preserved of all the Viking-Age graves on the island.
paras.zh: 这些人在丧葬记录中的可见程度很难得知。可能没有奴隶专用的诊断物品，所以我们无法通过坟墓中的特定物体来感知它们。那些没有权利、财产很少的人，实际上除了动产之外几乎没有任何合法身份的个人，似乎也不太可能获得传统的埋葬方式。伊本·法兰说，在旅行中死亡的奴隶会被简单地丢弃，但在定居点中情况不太可能如此。当我们确实遇到他们时，通常是因为他们在丧葬仪式中被杀，尸体被埋葬。我们可以在这里探索的一个例子来自马恩岛西北海岸朱比教区巴拉泰尔遗址的一次发掘，这是岛上所有维京时代坟墓中保存最完好的。

paras.en: At Ballateare, it is instructive to see just how normal the initial funeral, and its circumstances, appear to have been, albeit for a high-status individual. By Viking-Age standards he was in his prime when he died in the early tenth century, somewhere between eighteen and thirty years old. He may have been among the early Norse settlers on Man. We have no reason to believe that the clothes he was buried in, and the things laid in the grave, are not reflections of his life and the international milieu he came from.
paras.zh: 在巴拉泰尔，看看最初的葬礼及其环境看起来是多么正常，尽管对于一个地位很高的人来说，是有启发性的。按照维京时代的标准，他于十世纪初去世时正值壮年，年龄在十八岁到三十岁之间。他可能是早期在曼岛定居的挪威人之一。我们没有理由相信他下葬时穿的衣服和坟墓里放的东西不能反映他的生活和他来自的国际环境。

paras.en: He had been interred in a wooden coffin, dug down quite deep into the ground. A sheathed knife was suspended on a lanyard round his neck and he wore a cloak held by an Irish ringed pin. Inside the coffin was a sword — probably from Norway, but with a belt from the British Isles — that had been cut into pieces before being sheathed in the scabbard; the hilt lay broken off beside it. A spearhead also lay in the coffin by the man's feet, snapped off because there was no room for the shaft. A shield, also deliberately damaged with two heavy blows to the boss, had been slid vertically down the outer side of the coffin; the shield board itself may have been smashed too. This was not battle damage; all his weapons were made unusable for reasons we can only guess. Fragments of the shield also revealed traces of paint: it had been decorated with white gesso, banded with black, with rows of red dots along the stripes. Two more spears had been laid across the top of the coffin.
paras.zh: 他被埋在一个木棺材里，棺材被挖到地下很深的地方。他脖子上的挂绳上挂着一把入鞘的刀，他穿着一件用爱尔兰环别针固定的斗篷。棺材里有一把剑——可能来自挪威，但有一条来自不列颠群岛的腰带——在装进剑鞘之前被切成碎片；剑柄断在旁边。棺材里还放着一根矛头，就在该人的脚边，由于没有足够的空间容纳矛杆，矛头被折断了。一面盾牌也因对老板的两次重击而被故意损坏，已经从棺材的外侧垂直滑落；屏蔽板本身也可能被砸碎。这不是战斗造成的伤害，而是战斗造成的伤害。他的所有武器都无法使用，原因我们只能猜测。盾牌的碎片还显示出油漆的痕迹：它被白色石膏装饰，带有黑色条纹，条纹上有一排红点。棺材顶上还放着两根长矛。

paras.en: - 'If it was a man, we would say that's a warrior's grave': Weapon-filled burials are shaking up what we know about women's role in Viking society
paras.zh: -“如果是一个男人，我们会说那是一个战士的坟墓”：充满武器的墓葬正在动摇我们对维京社会中女性角色的了解

paras.en: - 'Call it Genghis Khan's final victory': Why the tomb of the 'Disturber of the Universe' remains hidden after 800 years
paras.zh: - “称其为成吉思汗的最终胜利”：为什么“宇宙扰乱者”的坟墓在 800 年后仍然被隐藏

paras.en: - He looked like Ramses the Great': How experimental archaeologists used ancient techniques to mummify a modern-day person
paras.zh: - 他看起来像拉美西斯大帝：实验考古学家如何使用古代技术将现代人制成木乃伊

paras.en: The burial pit was then filled with fine white sand, and a mound was built on top — about 3 metres [10 feet] high and 22 metres [72 feet] in diameter. It was made of thick-cut turfs, which had been brought to the mound from a wide area rather than simply dug up in the vicinity. The earth of the mound seems to be an offering of the land itself, a territorial tribute to the dead man.
paras.zh: 然后用细白沙填满墓坑，并在顶部筑起一座土丘，高约 3 米（10 英尺），直径 22 米（72 英尺）。它是由厚切的草皮制成的，这些草皮是从广阔的区域运到土丘上的，而不是简单地在附近挖出来的。土丘上的泥土似乎是土地本身的祭品，是对死者的领土贡品。

paras.en: I do not wish to relate what happened next in terms of dramatized reconstruction; archaeological description must suffice. On top of the mound lay the body of a woman aged between twenty and thirty, who had been deliberately killed: the back of her head had been removed by a single blow from a sharp blade, probably a sword. Rigor mortis had set in, and some twelve to seventy-two hours had elapsed between her death and the time when her body was covered. She had either lain exposed on the mound for some time after her death, or been killed elsewhere (perhaps more likely, as the missing part of her skull was not present with the body). The woman seems to have died while kneeling, and had fallen forwards with her hands raised. A post was raised on top of the mound beside her body, presumably a grave marker.
paras.zh: 我不想用戏剧化的重建来讲述接下来发生的事情；考古学的描述就足够了。土丘顶上躺着一具二十岁到三十岁之间的女人的尸体，她是被故意杀害的：她的后脑勺被锋利的刀片（可能是一把剑）一击砍掉。尸僵开始出现，从她死亡到她的尸体被盖上，已经过去了大约十二到七十二个小时。她死后要么在土堆上裸露了一段时间，要么在其他地方被杀（也许更有可能，因为她头骨的缺失部分并不存在于尸体中）。这名女子似乎是跪着死去的，双手举起，向前倒下。她尸体旁边的土堆顶上竖起了一根柱子，大概是一个墓碑。

paras.en: A paragraph is not enough to convey what actually occurred, let alone to extrapolate the life that the woman had led before her death — possibly decades of servitude and enslavement, with all that this implies. Her corpse was covered by a very thick layer of cremated animal bone, including considerable numbers of oxen, horses, sheep and dogs. (Somewhere nearby must have been a truly massive cremation pyre.) The mound was finally sealed with turf, covering her body and the ashes of the animals.
paras.zh: 一段话不足以传达实际发生的事情，更不用说推断该妇女生前的生活了——可能是几十年的奴役和奴役，以及这一切所暗示的一切。她的尸体上覆盖着一层很厚的火化动物骨头，其中包括相当数量的牛、马、羊和狗。 （附近的某个地方肯定有一个真正巨大的火葬柴堆。）土堆最终用草皮密封，覆盖了她的尸体和动物的骨灰。

paras.en: Help us improve Live Science Pro: We're always trying to make our content better. Leave us feedback about Pro here.
paras.zh: 帮助我们改进 Live Science Pro：我们一直在努力让我们的内容变得更好。请在此处给我们留下有关 Pro 的反馈。

paras.en: Drawing on the latest archaeological research and scientific analysis, The Sea-King and the Sorceress brings us closer to understanding the lives and times of the Vikings. The era that bears their name will never seem so simple again.
paras.zh: 《海王与女巫》借鉴了最新的考古研究和科学分析，让我们更加了解维京人的生活和时代。以他们的名字命名的时代将不再显得如此简单。

paras.en: Neil Price is distinguished professor and chair of archaeology at Uppsala University, Sweden. He has been researching, teaching and writing on the Vikings for nearly 40 years and is the author of several books on the history of the Viking Age, including "Children of Ash and Elm" (Basic Books, 2020). He lives in Sweden.
paras.zh: 尼尔·普莱斯（Neil Price）是瑞典乌普萨拉大学的杰出教授兼考古学系主任。他从事维京人研究、教学和写作近 40 年，是多本有关维京时代历史的书籍的作者，其中包括《灰与榆树之子》（Basic Books，2020 年）。他住在瑞典。

articles.title: Multicolored 'mosaic' of mini farms surrounds Taiwan's largest river — Earth from space
articles.author: Harry Baker

paras.en: Where is it? Yunlin County, Chianan Plain, Taiwan [23.78563273, 120.44373747]
What's in the photo? A multicolored 'mosaic' of small, tightly compacted farms
paras.zh: 照片里有什么？小而紧凑的农场组成的五彩“马赛克”

paras.en: Which satellite took the photo? Landsat 9
paras.zh: 哪颗卫星拍到了这张照片？陆地卫星 9

paras.en: This recent satellite snap shows off a multicolored "mosaic" of tightly packed mini farms covering part of Taiwan in the western Pacific Ocean. The sea of fields and shade nets demonstrates the scale of the agricultural challenges facing the densely populated island.
paras.zh: 最近的这张卫星照片展示了西太平洋台湾部分地区密密麻麻的迷你农场的五彩“马赛克”。田野和遮阳网的海洋展示了这个人口稠密的岛屿所面临的农业挑战的规模。

paras.en: Taiwan is 14,000 square miles (36,000 square kilometers) — about the same size as Maryland — but has a population around four times as large, with approximately 23 million people living there, according to NASA's Earth Observatory. This places a heavy burden on the island's agricultural industry to provide enough food for everyone on the island, especially as large parts of the landmass are covered by mountains and rainforest.
paras.zh: 根据 NASA 地球观测站的数据，台湾面积 14,000 平方英里（36,000 平方公里），与马里兰州差不多，但人口却是马里兰州的四倍，约有 2,300 万人居住在那里。这给岛上的农业带来了沉重的负担，无法为岛上的每个人提供足够的食物，特别是因为该岛大部分土地被山脉和雨林覆盖。

paras.en: Researchers estimate that there is only around 3,200 square feet (300 square meters) of Taiwanese farmland per citizen, which is around two-thirds the size of a basketball court, according to the Earth Observatory. This is around 10 times less than the equivalent for U.S. citizens.
paras.zh: 根据地球观测站的数据，研究人员估计台湾人均拥有约 3,200 平方英尺（300 平方米）的农田，大约是篮球场大小的三分之二。这比美国公民的同等水平低约 10 倍。

paras.en: The majority of the island's food is produced within Yunlin County, which is situated around halfway along the Chianan Plain, a lengthy strip of flat terrain that hugs Taiwan's west coast. Just under half of the county is visible in the satellite image, which spans roughly 15 miles (24 kilometers) across.
paras.zh: 岛上的大部分食物产自云林县，该县位于嘉南平原的中间位置，嘉南平原是一条狭长的平坦地形，环绕着台湾的西海岸。卫星图像中可以看到该县不到一半的面积，其宽度约为 15 英里（24 公里）。

paras.en: The flat ground in Yunlin County, as well as access to water from the island's largest river, the Zhuoshui (visible across the top of the image), makes it an ideal place to grow a variety of different crops, including "rice, sweet potatoes, peanuts, corn, sugarcane, garlic, scallions, coffee, fruit, and leafy greens," Earth Observatory representatives wrote.
paras.zh: 地球观测站的代表写道，云林县地势平坦，并且可以从岛上最大的河流浊水（图像顶部可见）获取水源，使其成为种植各种不同作物的理想场所，包括“水稻、红薯、花生、玉米、甘蔗、大蒜、葱、咖啡、水果和绿叶蔬菜”。

paras.en: The average size of a farm in Yunlin County is under 100,000 square feet (10,000 square m), which is around 90 times smaller than the average U.S. farm. As a result, the region looks like a giant patchwork of tens of thousands of irregular cuboids when viewed from above.
paras.zh: 云林县农场的平均面积不到 100,000 平方英尺（10,000 平方米），比美国农场的平均面积小约 90 倍。因此，从上方看去，该区域就像是由数以万计的不规则长方体拼凑而成的巨大物体。

paras.en: The sizes of Taiwanese farms are restricted by longstanding legislation that limits the amount of land any individual can own, according to the Earth Observatory. Most of the farms are passed down from generation to generation.
paras.zh: 据地球观测站称，台湾农场的规模受到长期立法的限制，该立法限制了个人可以拥有的土地数量。大多数农场都是代代相传的。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: While Yunlin County's agricultural mosaic is fairly consistent across this image, two main areas stand out from the rest (see below).
paras.zh: 虽然云林县的农业马赛克在整个图像中相当一致，但有两个主要区域脱颖而出（见下文）。

paras.en: The first outlying region is a swarm of blue and turquoise rectangles surrounding the town of Xiluo in the upper right of the image (just below the river). These farms are covered with plastic shade nets, which shelter them from harsh sunlight in the summer and monsoon-like rains in the wet season
paras.zh: 第一个外围区域是图像右上方（位于河流下方）西洛镇周围的一群蓝色和绿松石色矩形。这些农场覆盖着塑料遮阳网，可以在夏季遮挡强烈的阳光，在雨季遮挡季风般的降雨

paras.en: The second and perhaps most noticeable anomaly is a cluster of much larger, lightly colored farms near the town of Baozhong (bottom left of the photo). These are sugarcane fields, left over from when Japan controlled Taiwan between 1895 and 1945.
paras.zh: 第二个也许是最引人注目的异常现象是保中镇附近的一群更大、浅色的农场（照片左下角）。这些是1895年至1945年间日本统治台湾时留下的甘蔗田。

paras.en: A large portion of the Chianan Plain was used to grow sugarcane by the Japanese, who also constructed railway lines to move the crop across the island. However, most of these fields have since been repurposed, and all but one of the railway lines have fallen out of use.
paras.zh: 日本人利用嘉南平原的大部分地区种植甘蔗，他们还​​修建了铁路线将农作物运送到岛上。然而，大多数这些土地已被重新利用，除了一条铁路线外，所有铁路线都已不再使用。

paras.en: In addition to growing crops, these small farms are used to rear livestock, including chickens, cattle and "millions of pigs," according to the Earth Observatory.
paras.zh: 据地球观测站称，除了种植农作物外，这些小农场还用来饲养牲畜，包括鸡、牛和“数百万头猪”。

paras.en: A 2016 astronaut photo mosaic highlights a "sunglint" phenomenon that transformed Lake Powell into a winding metallic "river." The artificial reservoir, which is the second largest in the country, is home to many visible and long-lost geological wonders.
paras.zh: 2016 年宇航员的马赛克照片突出显示了一种“sunglint”现象，该现象将鲍威尔湖变成了一条蜿蜒的金属“河流”。该人工水库是该国第二大人工水库，拥有许多可见和久违的地质奇观。

paras.en: A 2025 satellite photo shows the Caldas Novas dome, a 12-mile-long monolith that towers above the Brazilian state of Goiás. The structure acts as a giant sponge, soaking up water that helps fuel nearby hot springs.
paras.zh: 一张 2025 年的卫星照片显示了新卡尔达斯圆顶，这是一块 12 英里长的巨石，高耸于巴西戈亚斯州上空。该结构就像一块巨大的海绵，吸收水为附近的温泉提供燃料。

paras.en: Salt slab lurks on Sahara's tallest peak
paras.zh: 盐板潜伏在撒哈拉最高峰

paras.en: A 2024 astronaut photo captured an unusual salt patch shining like snow on top of northern Chad's imposing Emi Koussi volcano, which is covered with ancient lava, hidden vents and shadowy waterways.
paras.zh: 一张 2024 年宇航员的照片捕捉到了乍得北部雄伟的埃米库西火山顶部一片不寻常的盐斑，像雪一样闪闪发光，火山上覆盖着古老的熔岩、隐藏的喷口和阴暗的水道。

paras.en: Harry is a U.K.-based senior staff writer at Live Science. He studied marine biology at the University of Exeter before training to become a journalist. He covers a wide range of topics including space exploration, planetary science, space weather, climate change, animal behavior and paleontology. His recent work on the solar maximum won "best space submission" at the 2024 Aerospace Media Awards and was shortlisted in the "top scoop" category at the NCTJ Awards for Excellence in 2023. He also writes Live Science's weekly Earth from space series.
paras.zh: 哈里是《Live Science》驻英国的高级撰稿人。在接受记者培训之前，他在埃克塞特大学学习海洋生物学。他涵盖的主题广泛，包括太空探索、行星科学、太空天气、气候变化、动物行为和古生物学。他最近关于太阳活动极大期的工作赢得了 2024 年航空航天媒体奖的“最佳太空作品”，并入围了 2023 年 NCTJ 卓越奖的“顶级独家报道”类别。他还撰写了《Live Science》的每周地球从太空系列文章。

articles.title: Flu season is kicking off early — are you getting a vaccine?
articles.author: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry

paras.en: Flu season in the U.S. typically starts around late October or early November and peaks between December and February. But new data reveals that the current flu season is starting slightly earlier than normal.
paras.zh: 美国的流感季节通常在 10 月底或 11 月初左右开始，并在 12 月至 2 月之间达到高峰。但新数据显示，当前的流感季节比正常情况稍早开始。

paras.en: According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), around 3.4% of respiratory samples tested for flu came back positive for the week of Sept. 26. That's around seven times the rate compared with the same week in 2025.
paras.zh: 根据美国疾病控制与预防中心 (CDC) 的数据，9 月 26 日这一周，约 3.4% 的流感呼吸道样本呈阳性。这一比例是 2025 年同周的约 7 倍。

paras.en: The positive tests are coming mainly from Western states, including California, Washington and Arizona. Regardless of where you're located in the U.S., though, most people are recommended to get their annual flu shot in September or October, and the same goes for this flu season.
paras.zh: 阳性检测主要来自西部各州，包括加利福尼亚州、华盛顿州和亚利桑那州。不过，无论您身在美国何处，大多数人都建议在九月或十月接种年度流感疫苗，今年的流感季节也是如此。

paras.en: The annual flu shot is the best way to prevent hospitalization and death from seasonal influenza. Nearly everyone ages 6 months and older is recommended to get a flu vaccine, and older adults have several special options, including a high-dose shot, a vaccine containing an extra immune-stimulating ingredient called an adjuvant, and a brand-new mRNA vaccine.
paras.zh: 每年注射流感疫苗是预防季节性流感住院和死亡的最佳方法。几乎每个 6 个月及以上的人都被建议接种流感疫苗，老年人有几种特殊的选择，包括高剂量注射、含有称为佐剂的额外免疫刺激成分的疫苗，以及全新的 mRNA 疫苗。

paras.en: Given that flu season is off to an earlier start this year, our latest poll asks whether you plan to get vaccinated or have gotten vaccinated already. Tell us your thoughts in the comments below.
paras.zh: 鉴于今年流感季节提前开始，我们最新的民意调查询问您是否计划接种疫苗或已经接种疫苗。请在下面的评论中告诉我们您的想法。

paras.en: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry is the Content Manager at Live Science. Formerly, she was the Content Manager at Space.com and before that the Science Communicator at JILA, a physics research institute. Kenna is also a book author, with her upcoming book 'Octopus X' scheduled for release in spring of 2027. Her beats include physics, health, environmental science, technology, AI, animal intelligence, corvids, and cephalopods.
paras.zh: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry 是 Live Science 的内容经理。此前，她曾担任 Space.com 的内容经理，此前曾担任物理研究所 JILA 的科学传播员。肯纳还是一名书籍作者，她即将出版的新书《章鱼 X》计划于 2027 年春季发行。她的研究领域包括物理、健康、环境科学、技术、人工智能、动物智能、鸦科动物和头足类动物。

articles.title: After an American Bomber Crashed Into an English Moor During World War II, a Corporal Was Declared Missing in Action. Archaeologists Have Now Revived the Search for His Remains

paras.en: On a foggy October day in 1944, a small crew of American airmen stationed in England began preparations for a test flight of a B-24H Liberator nicknamed “Sack Time!”
paras.zh: 1944 年 10 月的一个大雾天，一小群驻扎在英国的美国飞行员开始为绰号为“Sack Time！”的 B-24H 解放者试飞做准备。

paras.en: As the plane was readied for its cross-country training exercise, Corporal Clarence Watson, a 21-year-old from California who worked on the plane’s ground crew, finally got his chance to sit in on a flight.
paras.zh: 当飞机准备进行越野训练演习时，来自加利福尼亚州、担任飞机地勤人员的 21 岁下士克拉伦斯·沃森 (Clarence Watson) 终于有机会坐在飞机上。

paras.en: The crew he joined was part of the top-secret Operation Carpetbagger. Launched in 1943 by the Office of Strategic Services, Operation Carpetbagger consisted of high-risk clandestine missions to supply partisan fighters deep in Nazi-occupied Europe. Usually flying at night or in inclement weather, the crews piloted black planes at abnormally low altitudes to airdrop supplies and parachutists to aid resistance fighters. Most of these flights departed from England and sent deliveries to France in advance of the D-Day invasion.
paras.zh: 他加入的船员是绝密行动“Carpetbagger”的一部分。 “地毯袋行动”于 1943 年由战略服务办公室发起，由高风险的秘密任务组成，为纳粹占领的欧洲深处的游击队战士提供补给。机组人员通常在夜间或恶劣天气下飞行，驾驶黑色飞机在异常低的高度空投物资和伞兵来援助抵抗战士。这些航班大部分从英国起飞，在诺曼底登陆之前将货物运送到法国。

paras.en: But even test runs for Operation Carpetbagger were dangerous. Visibility was exceptionally poor over West Yorkshire when “Sack Time!” crashed into an obscured hill in England’s Peak District. Seven crew members died on impact. An eighth died later that night. The crash’s sole survivor, Staff Sergeant Curtis Anderson, used hunks of wet peat to extinguish the fire enveloping him, according to the Yorkshire Post’s Ruby Kitchen.
paras.zh: 但即使是地毯袋行动的试运行也是危险的。当“解雇时间！”时，西约克郡的能见度特别差。坠入英格兰峰区一座不起眼的小山上。七名机组人员因撞击而死亡。当晚晚些时候，第八人死亡。据约克郡邮报的红宝石厨房报道，事故中唯一的幸存者柯蒂斯·安德森中士使用大块湿泥炭扑灭了包围他的大火。

paras.en: One mystery lingered from that tragedy: Watson’s body was never found, and he has officially remained missing in action ever since.
paras.zh: 这场悲剧留下了一个谜团：沃森的尸体从未被发现，从那以后他就一直在行动中失踪。

paras.en: Now, 82 years later, the search for Watson’s remains has been revived. Geoscope, a U.K.-based forensic archaeology firm, in partnership with the U.S. government, is reopening the search in hopes of bringing closure to Watson’s family.
paras.zh: 82 年后的今天，对沃森遗体的搜寻工作又重新启动。总部位于英国的法医考古公司 Gescope 正在与美国政府合作，重新启动搜寻工作，希望为沃森的家人画上句号。

paras.en: “We are here to try and find evidence to really confirm that Clarence was actually killed here,” Tim Fletcher, the lead archaeologist, tells the Yorkshire Post. “We are essentially following breadcrumbs.”
paras.zh: 首席考古学家蒂姆·弗莱彻告诉《约克郡邮报》：“我们来这里是为了试图找到证据，真正证实克拉伦斯确实在这里被杀。” “我们本质上是在追踪面包屑。”

paras.en: While the other servicemen’s bodies were recovered in the immediate aftermath of the crash at Twizle Head Moss, a moor near the town of Holmfirth, the military concluded that Watson’s remains were unrecoverable.
paras.zh: 事故发生后，其他军人的尸体在霍姆弗斯镇附近的特威兹尔海德莫斯沼泽地被找到，但军方得出的结论是，沃森的遗体无法找到。

paras.en: Recently, however, members of Wilson’s family learned that the military may have found some evidence at the crash site during initial recovery efforts: a piece of a parachute, the back of a watch and a hip bone that may have belonged to Wilson.
paras.zh: 然而，最近，威尔逊的家人得知，军方在最初的救援工作中可能在坠机现场发现了一些证据：一块降落伞、一块手表的背面和一根可能属于威尔逊的髋骨。

paras.en: “They somehow fell off the face of the earth and were lost,” Vicky Weatherby, Wilson’s niece, tells the Yorkshire Post. She explains that, without confirmation of Wilson’s demise, her family continued to hold out hope. “Maybe they would have come to terms with his death and not always waited for a letter, or the door to open with Uncle Clarence walking in,” she adds.
paras.zh: 威尔逊的侄女维姬·韦瑟比 (Vicky Weatherby) 告诉《约克郡邮报》，“不知怎么的，他们从地球表面掉了下来，然后就迷失了。”她解释说，在威尔逊去世的消息尚未得到证实的情况下，她的家人仍然抱有希望。 “也许他们会接受他的死亡，而不是总是等待一封信，或者克拉伦斯叔叔走进来的门，”她补充道。

paras.en: In 2023, a cursory survey of the crash site and surrounding areas identified several nearby locations where more evidence related to Watson was likely to be found.
paras.zh: 2023 年，对坠机地点及周边地区进行的粗略调查确定了附近的几个地点，可能会发现更多与沃森相关的证据。

paras.en: Archaeological research teams are now excavating those sites, hoping that the moor’s unique ecology may have preserved evidence of Wilson’s body. “The wet, acidic properties of peat act as a natural preservative, meaning it is possible that objects from the aircraft may have been preserved within the peat,” per a statement.
paras.zh: 考古研究小组现在正在挖掘这些遗址，希望荒原独特的生态可能保存了威尔逊尸体的证据。一份声明称：“泥炭的潮湿、酸性特性起到了天然防腐剂的作用，这意味着飞机上的物体可能保存在泥炭中。”

paras.en: Weatherby recently visited the excavation site. “She and her wider family are still so invested in trying to find out what happened to Clarence. It was a very moving experience,” Fletcher tells the BBC’s Tom Ingall.
paras.zh: 韦瑟比最近参观了挖掘现场。 “她和她的家人仍然如此投入地试图找出克拉伦斯发生了什么事。这是一次非常感人的经历，”弗莱彻告诉英国广播公司的汤姆·英格尔。

paras.en: So far, the excavations have unearthed some material of interest, but archaeologists are sending their finds back to labs in the United States before making any pronouncements.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，挖掘工作已经发现了一些有趣的材料，但考古学家正在将他们的发现送回美国的实验室，然后再发表任何声明。

paras.en: “This has been a complex project, involving international partnership and co-operation over nearly a decade,” Natalie Ward, an archaeologist for Peak District National Park, says in the statement. “It demonstrates the significance and continued relevance of our aircraft crash sites, not just as archaeological sites but as emotive places in our landscape.”
paras.zh: 峰区国家公园考古学家娜塔莉·沃德在声明中表示：“这是一个复杂的项目，涉及近十年来的国际伙伴关系和合作。” “它展示了我们飞机失事地点的重要性和持续相关性，不仅作为考古遗址，而且作为我们景观中的情感场所。”

articles.title: One of the World’s Largest Chinstrap Penguin Colonies Is Shrinking Fast

paras.en: Scientists are sounding the alarm after discovering that one of the world’s largest chinstrap penguin populations has collapsed.
paras.zh: 科学家们在发现世界上最大的帽带企鹅种群之一已经崩溃后发出了警报。

paras.en: Zavodovski Island, a remote, uninhabited volcanic island between South America and Antarctica, lost 63 percent of its chinstrap penguins between 2011 and 2025, according to a new study published October 7 in the journal Current Biology.
paras.zh: 根据 10 月 7 日发表在《当代生物学》杂志上的一项新研究，扎沃多夫斯基岛是南美洲和南极洲之间的一座偏远无人居住的火山岛，2011 年至 2025 年间，岛上的帽带企鹅减少了 63%。

paras.en: Researchers attribute the losses—which amount to half a million breeding individuals—to climate change, which they say is disrupting the birds’ food supply.
paras.zh: 研究人员将这些损失（相当于 50 万繁殖个体）归因于气候变化，他们认为气候变化正在扰乱鸟类的食物供应。

paras.en: “Imagine losing 60 percent of a country’s entire population in that timeframe,” Lucas Krüger García, an ecologist with the Chilean Antarctic Institute who was not involved with the research, tells National Geographic’s Avery Schuyler Nunn. “It’s really concerning. The fact that this single colony represented 30 percent of the global chinstrap population makes it even more concerning.”
paras.zh: “想象一下，在这段时间内，一个国家将失去 60% 的人口，”未参与这项研究的智利南极研究所生态学家卢卡斯·克鲁格·加西亚 (Lucas Krüger García) 告诉国家地理杂志的艾弗里·斯凯勒·纳恩 (Avery Schuyler Nunn)。 “这确实令人担忧。事实上，这个单一群体占全球帽带种群的 30%，这一事实更令人担忧。”

paras.en: Zavodovski Island, part of the South Sandwich Islands, was once home to the largest penguin colony on the planet, a combination of chinstrap and macaroni penguins. But, since 2011, as chinstrap numbers have plummeted, the island has lost more than a quarter of its total penguin population. Because of the declines, scientists say the island has now lost its world’s largest penguin colony title to the Adélie penguins living at Cape Adare in Antarctica’s Ross Sea.
paras.zh: 扎沃多夫斯基岛是南桑威奇群岛的一部分，曾经是地球上最大的企鹅栖息地，是帽带企鹅和马卡罗尼企鹅的结合体。但自 2011 年以来，随着帽带数量锐减，该岛企鹅数量已减少四分之一以上。科学家表示，由于企鹅数量的减少，该岛现在已经失去了世界上最大的企鹅栖息地的头衔，让给了居住在南极洲罗斯海阿代尔角的阿德利企鹅。

paras.en: Chinstrap penguins have been declining across the Antarctic Peninsula and surrounding islands since the 1980s. But, for years, the birds living on Zavodovski Island, located some 1,240 miles from the nearest permanent human settlement, appeared to be holding their own.
paras.zh: 自 20 世纪 80 年代以来，南极半岛及周边岛屿的帽带企鹅数量一直在减少。但是，多年来，生活在距最近的永久人类定居点约 1,240 英里的扎沃多夫斯基岛上的鸟类似乎一直坚守着自己的立场。

paras.en: In December 2023, scientists decided to check in on the Zavodovski chinstraps. They were in for a shock: Their analysis—conducted using a combination of drone surveys, aerial photography and satellite tracking data from individual birds—revealed that the island now has the highest rate of chinstrap population decline in the world.
paras.zh: 2023 年 12 月，科学家决定检查扎沃多夫斯基下巴带。他们感到震惊：他们结合无人机调查、航空摄影和卫星跟踪个体鸟类数据进行的分析显示，该岛现在是世界上帽带种群下降率最高的岛屿。

paras.en: In 2011, scientists counted nearly 543,000 breeding pairs of chinstrap penguins on the island. By 2025, that number had plummeted to roughly 201,000 breeding pairs, according to the paper.
paras.zh: 2011年，科学家统计了岛上繁殖的帽带企鹅近543,000对。据该论文称，到 2025 年，这一数字已骤降至约 201,000 对。

paras.en: The team ruled out a variety of explanations for the birds’ demise. The island has plenty of breeding habitat, so the chinstraps likely weren’t competing with their macaroni neighbors for space. Krill harvesting is banned in the waters surrounding the island, which eliminated local overfishing as a culprit. The March 2016 eruption of the island's Mount Curry might have killed some of the birds, but it doesn’t explain the chinstrap population’s steady decline since 2011.
paras.zh: 研究小组排除了对鸟类死亡的各种解释。岛上有充足的繁殖栖息地，因此帽带鱼很可能不会与它们的通心粉邻居争夺空间。该岛周围水域禁止捕捞磷虾，这消除了当地过度捕捞的罪魁祸首。 2016 年 3 月岛上库里山的喷发可能导致部分鸟类死亡，但这并不能解释帽带种群自 2011 年以来的稳步下降。

paras.en: Instead, the evidence points to climate-driven changes to the Southern Ocean that are affecting krill, the tiny crustaceans that make up the bulk of the chinstrap penguins’ diet. As the ocean warms and sea ice shrinks, krill are becoming increasingly scarce around Zavodovski—and chinstrap penguins are paying the price.
paras.zh: 相反，有证据表明，气候驱动的南大洋变化正在影响磷虾，这种微小的甲壳类动物构成了帽带企鹅的大部分食物。随着海洋变暖和海冰缩小，扎沃多夫斯基周围的磷虾变得越来越稀缺，而帽带企鹅正在为此付出代价。

paras.en: Tracking data shows the birds prefer to forage in the cooler waters northwest of the island, where they would normally find abundant krill. However, as ocean temperatures rise, the krill are increasingly moving south into the Weddell Sea.
paras.zh: 追踪数据显示，这些鸟类更喜欢在岛西北部较凉爽的水域觅食，通常在那里可以找到丰富的磷虾。然而，随着海洋温度上升，磷虾越来越多地向南移动到威德尔海。

paras.en: Since chinstrap penguins rely so heavily on krill, even small changes in its availability can have significant consequences for their survival. The chinstrap penguin is “quite a specialist species that’s got a very limited global range, and that range is getting squeezed,” lead author Norman Ratcliffe, an ecologist with the British Antarctic Survey, tells CNN’s Laura Paddison.
paras.zh: 由于帽带企鹅严重依赖磷虾，即使磷虾供应量发生微小变化，也会对它们的生存产生重大影响。帽带企鹅是“相当特殊的物种，其全球范围非常有限，而且这个范围正在受到挤压”，主要作者、英国南极调查局的生态学家诺曼·拉特克利夫告诉美国有线电视新闻网的劳拉·帕迪森。

paras.en: Did you know? Emperor penguins are also in trouble
paras.zh: 你可知道？帝企鹅也遇到了麻烦

paras.en: Earlier this year, the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) listed emperor penguins as “endangered.” Projections suggest the birds’ population could shrink by as much as half by the 2080s.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，国际自然保护联盟（IUCN）将帝企鹅列为“濒临灭绝”。预测表明，到 2080 年代，鸟类的数量可能会减少一半。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the island’s macaroni penguins are holding steady. The birds’ numbers increased by 28 percent between 2011 and 2016, and have remained stable at roughly 217,000 breeding pairs since then. Zavodovski Island now has a combined chinstrap and macaroni penguin population of roughly 419,000 pairs, per the paper.
paras.zh: 与此同时，岛上的通心粉企鹅数量保持稳定。 2011 年至 2016 年间，这些鸟类的数量增加了 28%，此后一直稳定在约 217,000 只繁殖对。据该报报道，扎沃多夫斯基岛现在的帽带企鹅和马卡罗尼企鹅总数约为 419,000 对。

paras.en: Scientists think macaroni penguins are faring better than chinstraps because their diet is broader and more flexible. They also like to eat krill, but can supplement with or switch to other food sources, such as fish and crustaceans, when necessary. Tracking data suggests they’re doing just that, heading to the warmer waters northeast of the island to forage for alternate prey.
paras.zh: 科学家认为通心粉企鹅比帽带企鹅生活得更好，因为它们的饮食更广泛、更灵活。他们也喜欢吃磷虾，但必要时可以补充或改用其他食物来源，例如鱼和甲壳类动物。跟踪数据表明它们正在这样做，前往岛东北部温暖的水域寻找替代猎物。

paras.en: Overall, it’s good news that Zavodovski’s macaroni penguins are flourishing. But researchers worry that the decline of chinstrap penguins could have broader ripple effects.
paras.zh: 总的来说，扎沃多夫斯基的通心粉企鹅蓬勃发展是个好消息。但研究人员担心帽带企鹅的减少可能会产生更广泛的连锁反应。

paras.en: “Each ecosystem could be regarded as like a giant Jenga set, and every component that you remove increases the risk of ecosystems collapsing completely,” Ratcliffe tells the Guardian’s Jonathan Watts.
paras.zh: “每个生态系统都可以被视为一个巨大的叠叠乐，移除的每个组件都会增加生态系统完全崩溃的风险，”拉特克利夫告诉《卫报》的乔纳森·瓦茨。

articles.title: A Family of Barn Owls Has Moved Into New York City's Upper West Side, Perhaps the First to Nest in Manhattan in Modern History

paras.en: The newest celebrity family in New York City isn’t a group of Hollywood stars or musicians, but a posse of barn owls that have made a water tower in the Upper West Side their home. Since the animals’ arrival in the neighborhood, birders have been flocking to catch a glimpse of the nocturnal residents.
paras.zh: 纽约市最新的名人家庭并不是一群好莱坞明星或音乐家，而是一群以上西区一座水塔为家的谷仓猫头鹰。自从这些动物抵达附近以来，观鸟者就蜂拥而至，想要一睹这些夜间活动的居民的风采。

paras.en: Experts say that these barn owls are the first in modern history known to have nested in Manhattan—a welcome event given the species’ rapid population decline in New York over the past few decades.
paras.zh: 专家表示，这些仓鸮是现代历史上已知的第一只在曼哈顿筑巢的猫头鹰——考虑到过去几十年来该物种在纽约的数量迅速下降，这是一件值得欢迎的事情。

paras.en: “The presence of a nest right in the middle of the country’s biggest city is really exciting,” says Jessica Wilson, the executive director of the NYC Bird Alliance, to Nick Caloway at CBS News New York.
paras.zh: 纽约市鸟类联盟执行董事杰西卡·威尔逊 (Jessica Wilson) 对纽约哥伦比亚广播公司新闻 (CBS News New York) 的尼克·卡洛韦 (Nick Caloway) 表示：“在美国最大的城市中心出现一个鸟巢确实令人兴奋。”

paras.en: It all began with a series of screeches in September, recalls resident Elisabeth Williams to Christopher Maag at the New York Times. For weeks, Williams and her husband heard the same sound from the patio of their apartment. “Its screeching is quite loud, and we were able to first identify the bird using the Merlin bird ID app,” she writes in an email to the West Side Rag’s Gus Saltonstall.
paras.zh: 居民伊丽莎白·威廉姆斯（Elisabeth Williams）向《纽约时报》的克里斯托弗·马格（Christopher Maag）回忆道，这一切都始于九月份的一系列尖叫声。几个星期以来，威廉姆斯和她的丈夫从他们公寓的露台上听到了同样的声音。 “它的尖叫声非常大，我们能够首先使用梅林鸟类 ID 应用程序识别这只鸟，”她在给 West Side Rag 的 Gus Saltonstall 的电子邮件中写道。

paras.en: Barn owls can look eerie, flying silently at night with their ghostly hues. They might nest in barns and abandoned buildings, and their vocalizations don’t sound like typical hoots—they make raspy, shrieking calls.
paras.zh: 谷仓猫头鹰看上去很怪异，它们在夜间以幽灵般的色调静静地飞翔。它们可能在谷仓和废弃的建筑物中筑巢，它们的声音听起来不像典型的叫声——它们发出刺耳的尖叫声。

paras.en: On October 3, Williams was finally able to snap a photo of the loud creature, confirming that it was a barn owl. She named it Scotty.
paras.zh: 10 月 3 日，威廉姆斯终于拍到了这只响亮生物的照片，确认它是一只仓鸮。她给它起名叫斯科蒂。

paras.en: It turned out that Scotty wasn’t flying solo. As many as eight barn owls—two adults and up to six juveniles—have now been spotted at a hole in a water tower, reports CBS News. “It’s a truly special experience ... that people can come out to a public space like this and look at these owls at night,” David Barrett, a birder who runs the social media account Manhattan Bird Alert, tells the outlet.
paras.zh: 事实证明，斯科蒂并不是单飞。据哥伦比亚广播公司新闻报道，目前在水塔的一个洞中发现了多达八只仓鸮，其中包括两只成年仓鸮和最多六只幼年仓鸮。 “这真是一次特别的体验……人们可以在晚上来到这样的公共空间观看这些猫头鹰，”社交媒体账户曼哈顿鸟类警报的运营者大卫·巴雷特 (David Barrett) 告诉媒体。

paras.en: The family’s arrival is great news, says Wilson to the Times. Barn owls are extremely rare sights in New York City, though there have been occasional sightings over the past few years. The state is at the northern limit of the species’ range, and their habitat has decreased dramatically due to land development. To Paul Sweet, an ornithologist and collection manager at the American Museum of Natural History, the Upper West Side owls are an indicator that “some environments in New York City are becoming more raptor-friendly,” he says to Hell Gate.
paras.zh: 威尔逊对《泰晤士报》表示，这家人的到来是个好消息。谷仓猫头鹰在纽约市极为罕见，尽管过去几年偶尔有人看到过。该州位于该物种分布范围的最北端，由于土地开发，它们的栖息地急剧减少。对于美国自然历史博物馆的鸟类学家兼收藏经理保罗·斯威特（Paul Sweet）来说，上西区的猫头鹰表明“纽约市的某些环境正变得对猛禽更加友好”，他对地狱之门说道。

paras.en: At the same time, birders and experts are worried that the owls are at risk of poisoning, because they feast on rodents. “Rats in New York City are often poisoned by rodenticide, meant to kill the rats. But actually, what it does is kill the predators that feed on those rats,” Wilson tells CBS News. “And if barn owls are eating several rats a day, they are likely to fall prey to this horrible death.”
paras.zh: 与此同时，观鸟者和专家担心猫头鹰有中毒的风险，因为它们以啮齿动物为食。 “纽约市的老鼠经常被杀鼠剂毒死，目的是杀死老鼠。但实际上，它的作用是杀死以这些老鼠为食的捕食者，”威尔逊告诉哥伦比亚广播公司新闻。 “如果仓鸮每天吃掉几只老鼠，它们很可能会死于这种可怕的死亡。”

paras.en: In 2024, Flaco, the beloved Eurasian eagle-owl that escaped the Central Park Zoo, died after hitting a building. Post-mortem examinations revealed that he had a severe case of pigeon herpesvirus and had ingested four different types of rodenticide that likely contributed to his fatal crash. The city later passed “Flaco’s Law,” which includes a pilot program to curb rat populations using contraceptive methods rather than rodenticide.
paras.zh: 2024 年，从中央公园动物园逃脱的受人喜爱的欧亚雕鸮弗拉科 (Flaco) 在撞上建筑物后死亡。尸检显示，他患有严重的鸽子疱疹病毒感染，并摄入了四种不同类型的灭鼠剂，这可能导致了他的致命事故。该市后来通过了“弗拉科法”，其中包括一项使用避孕方法而不是杀鼠剂来抑制老鼠数量的试点计划。

paras.en: Still, the latest owls to attain fame are a sign of the animals’ resilience despite the risks of urban environments, as wildlife photographer and author David Lei tells Hell Gate. “The fact that there is a barn owl nest in Manhattan is something to be celebrated,” he says. “It should also galvanize people to do more to protect our wildlife.”
paras.zh: 尽管如此，野生动物摄影师兼作家大卫·雷 (David Lei) 告诉《地狱之门》，最新成名的猫头鹰表明了这些动物尽管面临城市环境的风险，仍具有复原力。 “曼哈顿有一个仓鸮巢这一事实是值得庆祝的，”他说。 “它还应该激励人们采取更多措施来保护我们的野生动物。”

paras.en: For now, the barn owls are capturing the hearts of people around the city, who welcome the reprieve they offer from recent headlines.
paras.zh: 目前，谷仓猫头鹰正俘获全城人们的心，他们欢迎它们为最近的头条新闻带来的喘息之机。

paras.en: “You wake up in the morning and wonder what kind of new hell are we going to have today,” says resident Lydia Sugarman to the Times. “And now we have this wonderful distraction.”
paras.zh: 居民莉迪亚·休格曼 (Lydia Sugarman) 向《泰晤士报》表示：“你早上醒来，想知道今天我们会遇到什么样的新地狱。” “现在我们有了这个美妙的消遣。”

articles.title: The Apple HomeView Is Like a Giant Apple Watch for the Home
articles.author: Julian Chokkattu

paras.en: It’s a big year for Apple firsts. The company launched the first MacBook Neo, unveiled its first folding iPhone in September, and installed a new CEO for the first time in 15 years. Now comes the Apple HomeView, Apple’s first smart display.
paras.zh: 对于苹果公司来说，今年是重要的一年。该公司推出了首款 MacBook Neo，并于 9 月推出了首款折叠式 iPhone，并 15 年来首次任命了新首席执行官。现在，Apple HomeView 上市了，这是 Apple 的首款智能显示屏。

paras.en: Rivals like Google and Amazon have made countless screen-enabled smart speakers since voice assistants invaded the home a decade ago. But Apple stuck with a smaller smart home ecosystem centered on its HomePod speakers, even removing the iPad as a hub device a few years ago, which forced users to buy an Apple TV or HomePod to get started. Maybe that’s why it hasn’t found much success in the home.
paras.zh: 自从十年前语音助手侵入家庭以来，谷歌和亚马逊等竞争对手已经制造了无数带屏幕的智能扬声器。但苹果坚持以 HomePod 扬声器为中心的较小智能家居生态系统，甚至在几年前取消了 iPad 作为集线器设备的地位，这迫使用户购买 Apple TV 或 HomePod 来开始使用。也许这就是为什么它在家庭中没有取得太大成功的原因。

paras.en: Announced Tuesday at an event in New York City, the 7-inch smart display arrives alongside several other new smart home devices as part of Apple’s bid to revitalize its lagging ecosystem. The HomeView costs $299 and comes in two versions—a speaker base and a wall-mounted display—both priced the same. Preorders are live, with sales kicking off on November 13.
paras.zh: 周二在纽约市举行的一次活动中，这款 7 英寸智能显示屏与其他几款新型智能家居设备一起上市，这是苹果振兴其落后生态系统的一部分。 HomeView 售价 299 美元，有两个版本——扬声器底座和壁挂式显示器——两者价格相同。预购现已开始，销售将于 11 月 13 日开始。

paras.en: The first thing I thought of after seeing the Apple HomeView in action is that it looks like a blown-up Apple Watch. The 7-inch square screen has multiple “faces” you can swipe through, exactly like the smartwatch. You can even customize the face’s colors and add different complications for more glanceable information.
paras.zh: 看到 Apple HomeView 的运行效果后，我首先想到的就是它看起来像一个放大的 Apple Watch。 7英寸的方形屏幕有多个“面孔”，您可以滑动浏览，就像智能​​手表一样。您甚至可以自定义脸部颜色并添加不同的复杂功能以获得更多一目了然的信息。

paras.en: The faces can range from a clock, your favorite photos of friends, family, or pets (you can even use shared albums) to weather updates and, yes, Snoopy animations. Swipe up for the home screen, which is more like an iPhone or iPad, with apps neatly arranged alongside widgets. Except the HomeView doesn’t run iOS or iPadOS—it runs the generically named HomeView software.
paras.zh: 这些面孔的范围可以从时钟、您最喜欢的朋友、家人或宠物的照片（您甚至可以使用共享相册）到天气更新，当然还有史努比动画。向上滑动主屏幕，它更像是 iPhone 或 iPad，应用程序整齐地排列在小部件旁边。除了 HomeView 不运行 iOS 或 iPadOS 之外，它运行的是通用名称为 HomeView 的软件。

paras.en: It doesn’t have an App Store. Instead, Apple has a curated selection of apps, including FaceTime, Messages, and Safari. A handful of third-party media apps like Spotify are available, and developers can bring over existing CarPlay apps. If your iPhone already has one of these CarPlay apps installed, it can automatically appear on the HomeView after setup. (There are no video streaming apps like YouTube, Netflix, or Disney+, but if those companies choose to make their apps available on the CarPlay framework, they will show up on the HomeView; for now, you'll have to consume videos by using the Safari browser.)
paras.zh: 它没有应用程序商店。相反，Apple 提供了精选的应用程序，包括 FaceTime、Messages 和 Safari。有一些第三方媒体应用程序（例如 Spotify）可供使用，开发人员可以引入现有的 CarPlay 应用程序。如果您的 iPhone 已安装这些 CarPlay 应用程序之一，则它会在设置后自动显示在 HomeView 上。 （没有像 YouTube、Netflix 或 Disney+ 这样的视频流应用程序，但如果这些公司选择在 CarPlay 框架上提供其应用程序，它们将显示在 HomeView 上；目前，您必须使用 Safari 浏览器来观看视频。）

paras.en: To get the most out of the HomeView, you need an iPhone with Apple Intelligence support (an iPhone 15 Pro or newer)—you can’t set it up with an iPad. Apple says you can still set it up with an older iPhone and access some of Siri AI's smarts (like broad world knowledge), but smarter app actions and personal context queries require an iPhone with Apple Intelligence.
paras.zh: 要充分利用 HomeView，您需要一部支持 Apple Intelligence 的 iPhone（iPhone 15 Pro 或更新版本）——您无法使用 iPad 进行设置。苹果表示，你仍然可以使用较旧的 iPhone 进行设置并访问 Siri AI 的一些智能（例如广泛的世界知识），但更智能的应用程序操作和个人上下文查询需要具有 Apple Intelligence 的 iPhone。

paras.en: The aluminum hardware, powered by Apple’s A18 chip, comes in four colors: silver, starlight, rose pink, and space gray (Apple color-matches the woven cable, too). The standard HomeView has a speaker base with a screen that tilts manually up or down for angled viewing, but you can also buy a wall-mountable version. The latter offers three mounts to choose from, one of which is DIY-friendly and has a visible power cord that needs to run to an outlet. The other two are designed for professional installers, either hardwired or connected via Power over Ethernet (PoE).
paras.zh: 铝制硬件由 Apple 的 A18 芯片驱动，有四种颜色：银色、星光、玫瑰粉色和深空灰色（Apple 的颜色也与编织电缆相匹配）。标准 HomeView 配有扬声器底座，屏幕可手动向上或向下倾斜以实现一定角度的观看，但您也可以购买壁挂式版本。后者提供三种安装座可供选择，其中一种适合 DIY，并且具有可见的电源线，需要连接到插座。另外两个专为专业安装人员设计，可以是硬连线，也可以通过以太网供电 (PoE) 连接。

paras.en: Technically, the primary speakers—two full-range drivers—are built into the screen. But the standard HomeView has a base that houses a down-firing woofer and two force-canceling passive radiators for stronger bass. It sounds pretty good based on a very limited listening experience, and can fill a large room quite well. The wall-mounted variant won’t have that extra oomph but Apple claims it tunes the audio for wall placement.
paras.zh: 从技术上讲，主扬声器（两个全频驱动器）内置于屏幕中。但标准 HomeView 有一个底座，里面装有一个下发式低音扬声器和两个力消除无源辐射器，可提供更强的低音。基于非常有限的聆听体验，它听起来相当不错，并且可以很好地填充一个大房间。壁挂式版本不会有那么额外的魅力，但苹果声称它针对墙壁放置调整了音频。

paras.en: The 7-inch Liquid Retina display has familiar elements, like True Tone, which adjusts the screen’s color temperature to match the room’s lighting. The ambient light sensor can also reduce display brightness from 500 nits to 0.3 nits, which is the lowest brightness Apple has ever engineered on a screen. That’ll be helpful if you place the HomeView on the nightstand.
paras.zh: 7 英寸 Liquid Retina 显示屏具有熟悉的元素，例如 True Tone，它可以调整屏幕的色温以匹配房间的照明。环境光传感器还可以将显示屏亮度从 500 尼特降低至 0.3 尼特，这是苹果在屏幕上设计的最低亮度。如果您将 HomeView 放在床头柜上，这会很有帮助。

paras.en: That is, if you're comfortable placing a camera-equipped display in the bedroom. A 12-megapixel Center Stage camera and four-microphone array sit on the front, but they aren’t just for FaceTime calls. The camera handles facial recognition, allowing the software to adapt to whoever is looking at the screen. Apple says all of this data stays on device.
paras.zh: 也就是说，如果您愿意在卧室放置配备摄像头的显示器。 12兆像素的中央舞台摄像头和四个麦克风阵列位于正面，但它们不仅仅用于 FaceTime 通话。摄像头可以处理面部识别，让软件能够适应正在看屏幕的人。苹果表示所有这些数据都保留在设备上。

paras.en: “Trust is becoming increasingly important with rising consumer expectations around privacy and security,” writes Anshika Jain, principal analyst at Counterpoint, in an email to WIRED. “In fact, Apple could actually benefit from its privacy-first approach.”
paras.zh: Counterpoint 首席分析师 Anshika Jain 在给 WIRED 的电子邮件中写道：“随着消费者对隐私和安全的期望不断提高，信任变得越来越重要。” “事实上，苹果实际上可以从其隐私优先的方法中受益。”

paras.en: You can add up to six iCloud accounts, and the user interface will adapt to each person, like Google’s Pixel Tablet. That means your wife can tint every app icon green and have no widgets on her home screen, but if you stand in front of the HomeView, it’ll switch to your setup. You won’t be able to view other household members’ sensitive messages and personal information. For this personal content to show up, you don’t just have to stand in front of the HomeView—your iPhone needs to be on the same Wi-Fi network and must have been recently unlocked.
paras.zh: 你最多可以添加六个 iCloud 帐户，用户界面将适应每个人，就像谷歌的 Pixel 平板电脑一样。这意味着你的妻子可以将每个应用程序图标设置为绿色，并且主屏幕上没有小部件，但如果你站在 HomeView 前面，它会切换到你的设置。您将无法查看其他家庭成员的敏感消息和个人信息。要显示这些个人内容，您不仅需要站在 HomeView 前，您的 iPhone 需要位于同一 Wi-Fi 网络上并且最近必须已解锁。

paras.en: The HomeView can also recognize voices, which helps if Dad asks Siri AI to “Play music.” It will play from Dad’s music library and his preferred music app, rather than another iCloud user’s music. If you have multiple HomePods or HomeViews, you can manage your speaker groups in the HomeView’s interface.
paras.zh: HomeView 还可以识别声音，如果爸爸要求 Siri AI“播放音乐”，这会很有帮助。它将播放爸爸的音乐库和他喜欢的音乐应用程序，而不是其他 iCloud 用户的音乐。如果您有多个 HomePod 或 HomeView，您可以在 HomeView 界面中管理扬声器组。

paras.en: The HomeView also supports Apple’s Handoff tech, so you can bring your iPhone close to send a Safari recipe to the smart display, or have it continue the podcast you were listening to on your commute. In the middle of a FaceTime or phone call? Put your iPhone near the HomeView, and it’ll transfer it over.
paras.zh: HomeView 还支持 Apple 的 Handoff 技术，因此您可以将 iPhone 靠近，将 Safari 食谱发送到智能显示屏，或者让它继续您在通勤时收听的播客。在 FaceTime 通话或打电话时？将您的 iPhone 放在 HomeView 附近，它就会将其传输过来。

paras.en: Like any smart display or smart speaker, Siri AI powers the HomeView. It is, after all, the main way to interact with the device (though yes, there’s a keyboard you can pull up to type). Apple spent a great deal of time revamping Siri this year, finally launching a more capable assistant in iOS 27.
paras.zh: 与任何智能显示器或智能扬声器一样，Siri AI 为 HomeView 提供支持。毕竟，这是与设备交互的主要方式（尽管是的，有一个键盘可以拉起来打字）。苹果今年花费了大量时间改进 Siri，最终在 iOS 27 中推出了功能更强大的助手。

paras.en: Siri AI on the HomeView understands your personal context from your iPhone, so if you ask it to play a song your friend Eric recommended, it’ll know right away what you mean by looking at your Messages history. You can ask when your brother Jeff will likely arrive at your home from the airport on Thursday, then set a schedule for Siri to turn on the coffee maker 15 minutes before his estimated arrival. All of this can be done with natural language, meaning you don’t have to say specific commands for Siri AI to understand you.
paras.zh: HomeView 上的 Siri AI 可以通过 iPhone 了解您的个人背景，因此，如果您要求它播放朋友 Eric 推荐的歌曲，它会通过查看您的消息历史记录立即了解您的意思。您可以询问您的兄弟 Jeff 可能会在周四从机场到达您家，然后为 Siri 设置一个时间表，让其在预计到达前 15 分钟打开咖啡机。所有这些都可以通过自然语言来完成，这意味着您不必说出特定的命令，Siri AI 就能理解您的意思。

paras.en: One neat trick is the HomeView’s ability to convert recipe pages from Safari into digestible content. Load a recipe, and it will let you view the ingredients or “Start Cooking,” no need to read three paragraphs of the author’s relationship to the stew. It automatically converts the recipe into step-by-step instructions, even auto-populating timers for relevant steps so you can start individual timers as you progress.
paras.zh: 一个巧妙的技巧是 HomeView 能够将 Safari 中的食谱页面转换为易于理解的内容。加载食谱，它会让你查看配料或“开始烹饪”，无需阅读作者与炖菜的关系的三段。它会自动将食谱转换为分步说明，甚至自动填充相关步骤的计时器，以便您可以随着进度启动单独的计时器。

paras.en: Naturally, the HomeView is also designed to control all of your smart home devices, too. You can create a widget for any device you have added in the Home app to quickly control it on the HomeView. And if you swipe to the left from the home screen, you’ll see the “Camera” face, which shows a live stream of connected security cameras (you can view nine feeds at once).
paras.zh: 当然，HomeView 也设计用于控制所有智能家居设备。您可以为 Home 应用程序中添加的任何设备创建小部件，以便在 HomeView 上快速控制它。如果您从主屏幕向左滑动，您将看到“摄像头”面孔，其中显示了连接的安全摄像头的实时流（您可以同时查看九个源）。

paras.en: Much like the upcoming iPhone Duo folding phone, Apple is late to market. The company is betting on tight iPhone integration, glanceable Watch-like software, and a more context-aware Siri to make the HomeView feel more like a screen you’ll actually want on your counter. Everything hinges on whether Siri can hold up its end of the bargain—and the voice assistant doesn’t exactly have the best track record.
paras.zh: 就像即将推出的 iPhone Duo 折叠手机一样，苹果的上市时间也很晚。该公司押注于与 iPhone 的紧密集成、一目了然的类似手表的软件以及更具上下文感知能力的 Siri，以使 HomeView 感觉更像是您真正想要放在柜台上的屏幕。一切都取决于 Siri 能否兑现承诺——而语音助手并没有最好的记录。

paras.en: “The greater challenge is to make AI useful for everyday interactions,” Jain says. “Apple must provide a more capable Siri experience and ensure seamless control across its entire product range in order to stand out from the competition.”
paras.zh: “更大的挑战是让人工智能在日常互动中发挥作用，”杰恩说。 “苹果必须提供更强大的 Siri 体验，并确保整个产品系列的无缝控制，才能在竞争中脱颖而出。”

articles.title: The ‘Godzilla Minus Zero’ Filmmakers Terrified Bystanders With Their Monster Sounds
articles.author: Max Evry

paras.en: Actor Seth Green—yes, that one—has seen Godzilla Minus Zero and says it’s awesome.
paras.zh: 演员赛斯·格林（Seth Green）——是的，就是那个人——看过《哥斯拉减零》，并说这太棒了。

paras.en: While introducing the New York Comic Con panel for the 39th film in the Godzilla franchise, Green stressed that the filmmakers behind the movie “have created kaiju that feel physically real and, trust me, emotionally terrifying.”
paras.zh: 在纽约动漫展上介绍《哥斯拉》系列第 39 部影片时，格林强调，电影背后的电影制片人“创造了一种身体感觉真实、情感上令人恐惧的怪兽”。

paras.en: While a lot of that terror came from the work of Oscar-winning visual effects artist Tatsuji Nojima, some it came from the shrieking of Godzilla and his three-headed nemesis, King Ghidorah. Those roars were the work of sound designer Natsuko Inoue and her team, who created the monsters’ outsize vocalizations by rolling speakers to the top of an outdoor dam—much to the horror of people nearby.
paras.zh: 虽然这种恐怖大部分来自奥斯卡获奖视觉效果艺术家野岛龙二的作品，但也有一些来自哥斯拉和他的三头宿敌国王基多拉的尖叫声。这些咆哮声是声音设计师 Natsuko Inoue 和她的团队的杰作，他们通过将扬声器滚动到室外水坝的顶部来创造怪物的巨大声音，这让附近的人们感到恐惧。

paras.en: “There were people having a picnic, maybe people just taking a stroll,” Hisafumi Takeuchi, who also worked on sound for the film, said during the panel. “The person walking their dog, though—they had the worst time, because the dog was freaking out and barking back at us.”
paras.zh: “有人在野餐，也许只是散步，”同时为这部电影制作声音的竹内久文在小组讨论中说道。 “然而，遛狗的人却经历了最糟糕的时光，因为狗吓坏了，还向我们吠叫。”

paras.en: Since the creatures are imaginary, getting their screams to sound realistic is essential to making them seem believable—and genuinely scary—onscreen. At first, Inoue wasn’t sure if the idea of recording at the dam would work. Those fears were quickly put to rest.
paras.zh: 由于这些生物是虚构的，因此让它们的尖叫声听起来真实对于让它们在屏幕上看起来可信且真正可怕至关重要。起初，井上不确定在大坝录制的想法是否可行。这些恐惧很快就消失了。

paras.en: “The first time we sent that roar out on the speakers, I could see the relief and confidence in everyone's eyes,” Inoue said. “By using speakers and projecting it into the real world, capturing the reverb, the echo, the reflection of the sound back with the mic, it manifests it in our world.”
paras.zh: “当我们第一次通过扬声器发出咆哮声时，我可以看到每个人眼中的轻松和自信，”井上说。 “通过使用扬声器并将其投射到现实世界中，捕捉混响、回声、用麦克风反射回的声音，它会在我们的世界中体现出来。”

paras.en: For other kaiju sound effects, Inoue’s team took an analog foley approach. To simulate Ghidorah’s dragon-like wings, for example, they flapped a rubber fisherman’s suit and mixed that noise with the sounds of an accordion-like air duct.
paras.zh: 对于其他怪兽音效，井上团队采用了模拟拟音方法。例如，为了模拟基多拉龙般的翅膀，他们拍打橡胶渔夫服，并将这种噪音与手风琴般的空气管道的声音混合在一起。

paras.en: Getting two of Toho’s most famous monsters right was a huge undertaking, especially after the success of Zero’s predecessor, Godzilla Minus One, which brought home $114 million worldwide at the box office. Following that 2023 film’s harrowing mix of post–World War II malaise and bracing kaiju destruction will be tough, but a new trailer shown during the film’s panel at NYCC promised a sequel full of aerial dogfights and a punch-’em-up for the ages between Godzilla and Ghidorah.
paras.zh: 把东宝最著名的两只怪兽搞定是一项艰巨的任务，尤其是在《零》的前作《哥斯拉减一》取得成功之后，该片在全球获得了 1.14 亿美元的票房。在这部 2023 年上映的电影中，二战后的不安和怪兽毁灭的悲惨混合将是艰难的，但在纽约电影中心的电影小组上展示的新预告片承诺续集充满哥斯拉和基多拉之间的空中缠斗和拳打脚踢。

paras.en: Like the previous film, Godzilla Minus Zero is directed by Takashi Yamazaki and features visual effects from Tatsuji Nojima, whom Green called “the first Gen Z Oscar-winner” for his work on One.
paras.zh: 与前一部电影一样，《哥斯拉减零》由山崎隆执导，视觉效果由野岛达司担任，格林称其为“第一位 Z 世代奥斯卡奖获得者”。

paras.en: Nojima began doing visual effects as a hobby while he was still a teenager before joining animation house Shirogumi as a compositor. After Yamazaki noticed a crude animation of waves that Nojima was working on, the director tasked the budding animator with developing the idea. Nojima turned around a fully rendered shot of ocean water over rocks that looked indistinguishable from reality. After that, Nojima recalled, Yamazaki said, “OK, I think you’re ready to animate and do VFX for Godzilla now.”
paras.zh: 野岛在十几岁的时候就开始将视觉效果作为一种爱好，然后加入动画公司白组担任合成师。在山崎注意到野岛正在制作的一个粗糙的波浪动画后，导演责成这位崭露头角的动画师开发这个想法。野岛将一张完全渲染的海水越过岩石的镜头翻转过来，看起来与现实没有什么区别。野岛回忆道，在那之后，山崎说：“好吧，我想你现在已经准备好为哥斯拉制作动画和视觉特效了。”

paras.en: During the panel, Nojima broke down how he created a shot from the trailer showing Godzilla bursting out of the ocean while chasing a seaplane. “I simulated 200 million particles to get the whitewater effect correct in Godzilla Minus One,” he said. “With this shot in Godzilla Minus Zero, the scale is absolutely different with the new Imax aspect ratio, plus there was no live-action plate, so we're dealing with a lot of CG on screen. We required 2 billion particles.”
paras.zh: 在小组讨论中，野岛详细讲述了他如何从预告片中创作一个镜头，展示哥斯拉在追逐水上飞机时冲出海面的镜头。 “我模拟了 2 亿个粒子，以确保《哥斯拉减一号》中的白水效果正确，”他说。 “在《哥斯拉负零》中的这个镜头中，比例与新的 Imax 宽高比完全不同，而且没有真人版，所以我们要在屏幕上处理大量 CG。我们需要 20 亿个粒子。”

paras.en: Godzilla Minus Zero is set to hit US theaters on November 6 and Japanese theaters on November 3, which has become known as Godzilla’s birthday since it marks the date in 1954 that Ishirō Honda’s original film was released in Japan.
paras.zh: 《哥斯拉负零》将于 11 月 6 日在美国上映，11 月 3 日在日本上映，这一天也被称为哥斯拉的生日，因为这一天标志着 1954 年本多猪四郎的原创电影在日本上映。

articles.title: The 9 Best Movies to Stream This Month (October 2026)
articles.author: Matt Kamen

paras.en: Fall is here, and the autumnal turn marks a season of returns. Back to school, back to work—and when it comes to the best films on streaming services, back to some of the best films of yesteryear.
paras.zh: 秋天到了，秋天的到来标志着回归的季节。回到学校，回到工作岗位——当谈到流媒体服务上的最佳电影时，回到过去的一些最佳电影。

paras.en: September finds John Carpenter’s brilliant 1982 remake of The Thing crawling its way onto Prime Video, Luc Besson’s mind-bending and eye-popping The Fifth Element on Netflix, and an unexpected blast from the past coming to Hulu in the form of The X-Files: I Want to Believe—Vrach Frankenshteyn, an R-rated director’s cut of 2008’s second cinematic case for Mulder and Scully, now closer to creator Chris Carter’s original vision.
paras.zh: 9 月，约翰·卡彭特 (John Carpenter) 翻拍的 1982 年精彩电影《怪形》(The Thing) 登上 Prime Video，卢克·贝松 (Luc Besson) 的令人费解、令人瞠目结舌的《第五元素》(The Fifth Element) 在 Netflix 上播出，而 Hulu 上出人意料地以《X 档案：我想要相信》(The X-Files: I Want to Believe) 的形式出现在 Hulu 上——Vrach Frankenshteyn，这是 2008 年第二部《穆德与斯高利》电影案件的 R 级导演剪辑版。更接近创作者克里斯·卡特的最初愿景。

paras.en: Even the new arrivals have a vintage flair this month though. Star Wars spinoff The Mandalorian and Grogu brings the big-screen bounty hunters back to Disney+ for a retro-tinged adventure, Netflix’s Mobile Suit Gundam: Hathaway expands on the world of the classic 1970s anime series, and Edge of Tomorrow on Paramount+ shows the past can be hard to escape at the best of times.
paras.zh: 不过，本月的新品也带有复古气息。 《星球大战》衍生剧《曼达洛人和格罗古》将大银幕赏金猎人带回 Disney+，开启一场复古冒险之旅；Netflix 的《机动战士高达：海瑟薇》扩展了 1970 年代经典动漫系列的世界；派拉蒙 + 的《明日边缘》则展示了即使在最好的时期，过去也很难逃脱。

paras.en: Here are WIRED’s picks of the best movies to watch right now.
paras.zh: 以下是《连线》精选的当前最值得观看的电影。

paras.en: Sure, The Mandalorian and Grogu has the dubious distinction of being the lowest-grossing live-action Star Wars movie ever (only 2008’s animated Clone Wars performed worse). And yes, for fans of the Disney+ space western series, a full fourth season might have been more welcome (and the three seasons of homework beforehand may have put off wider audiences anyway). Yet this spinoff is, in its own way, the “purest” Star Wars movie in years, capturing the feel of the classic serials that originally inspired George Lucas all those decades ago.
paras.zh: 当然，《曼达洛人》和《格罗古》有一个令人怀疑的区别，那就是成为有史以来票房收入最低的真人星球大战电影（只有 2008 年的动画《克隆人战争》表现更差）。是的，对于迪士尼+太空西部系列的粉丝来说，完整的第四季可能会更受欢迎（而且之前的三季作业可能会让更多观众望而却步）。然而，这部衍生剧以自己的方式成为多年来“最纯粹的”星球大战电影，捕捉了几十年前最初启发乔治·卢卡斯的经典连续剧的感觉。

paras.en: This stand-alone adventure finds Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin (Pedro Pascal) and his apprentice-slash-adopted-son Grogu (aka Baby Yoda) running jobs for the New Republic but, after being sent on the trail of an Imperial officer turned warlord, getting swept up in a battle against twin Hutt crimelords, battling hordes of alien monsters, and shooting their way through a factory’s worth of droids. Best of all, though, is that while there are plenty of nods for hardcore Star Wars fans, this isn’t trying to establish a new “saga” or a pivotally important entry in the wider lore. It’s just two hours of solidly enjoyable swashbuckling adventure. Star Wars could do with more like this.
paras.zh: 在这个独立的冒险故事中，曼达洛赏金猎人丁·贾林（佩德罗·帕斯卡饰）和他的学徒斜杠养子格罗古（又名婴儿尤达饰）为新共和国工作，但在被派去追捕一名帝国军官变成军阀后，卷入了与双胞胎赫特犯罪头目的战斗，与成群的外星怪物作战，并射杀了工厂里的机器人。不过，最重要的是，虽然有很多星球大战铁杆粉丝的认可，但这并不是试图建立一个新的“传奇”或更广泛的传说中的一个至关重要的条目。这只是两个小时的令人愉快的虚张声势的冒险。 《星球大战》可以做更多这样的事情。

paras.en: Dreamworks Animation has had a solid streak recently, but The Wild Robot stands as one of the studio’s best films ever. A gorgeously animated ode to the power and importance of the natural world, it follows Universal Robots ROZZUM Unit 7134—soon shortened to “Roz” (Lupita Nyong’o)—who becomes the stand-in mother for baby gosling Brightbill (Kit Connor) after being stranded on an isolated island. Guided by the fox Fink (Pedro Pascal, again) and the opossum Pinktail (Catherine O’Hara), Roz struggles to raise the infant, desperately trying to teach him to fly in time for migration season—and before her manufacturers track her down.
paras.zh: 梦工厂动画最近表现强劲，但《狂野机器人》是该工作室有史以来最好的电影之一。这是一部对自然世界的力量和重要性的华丽动画颂歌，讲述了优傲机器人 ROZZUM 7134 号机组（很快简称为“Roz”（露皮塔·尼永奥饰））的故事，她在被困在一座孤岛上后成为小鹅布莱特比尔（基特·康纳饰）的替身母亲。在狐狸芬克（又是佩德罗·帕斯卡饰）和负鼠粉尾鱼（凯瑟琳·奥哈拉饰）的引导下，罗兹努力抚养婴儿，拼命地试图教他在迁徙季节及时飞行，并在她的制造商找到她之前。

paras.en: A blend of Studio Ghibli’s reverence for nature and The Iron Giant’s emotional heart, The Wild Robot earned a near-total clean sweep at the 2025 Annie Awards—animation’s Oscars. Once you’ve finished sobbing from watching this, you’ll understand why.
paras.zh: 《狂野机器人》融合了吉卜力工作室对自然的敬畏和钢铁巨人的情感之心，在 2025 年安妮奖（动画界的奥斯卡奖）上几乎横扫一切。当你看完这个之后哭泣之后，你就会明白为什么。

paras.en: “Be careful what you wish for” is such a beautifully simple concept for horror, but it’s rarely as well executed as in Obsession. When lovelorn Bear (Michael Johnston) makes a wish on the “One Wish Willow” for his friend and coworker Nikki (Inde Navarrette) to love him, he thinks it’s just a dumb toy. It works though, better than he dared hope. Or rather, worse—Nikki goes from besotted to bunny boiler faster than you can blink, stalking Bear’s every movement, reacting with increased hostility to anyone who comes near him, and going to brutal lengths to keep the man she “loves,” whether he likes it or not. Balancing some shockingly gory scenes with darkly comedic moments, Obsession was the breakout hit of the summer.
paras.zh: “小心你的愿望”对于恐怖片来说是一个非常简单的概念，但它很少像《痴迷》那样执行得很好。当失恋的熊（迈克尔·约翰斯顿饰）向“一愿柳”许愿，希望他的朋友兼同事尼基（因德·纳瓦雷特饰）爱他时，他认为这只是一个愚蠢的玩具。不过，这确实有效，比他敢于希望的还要好。或者更糟糕的是，尼基从痴迷变成兔子锅炉的速度快得让人眨不眨眼，跟踪贝尔的一举一动，对任何靠近他的人都表现出越来越大的敌意，并不遗余力地留住她“爱”的男人，无论他喜欢与否。 《痴迷》平衡了一些令人震惊的血腥场景和黑色喜剧时刻，成为今年夏天的突破性热门作品。

paras.en: Mobile Suit Gundam Hathaway: The Sorcery of Nymph Circe
paras.zh: 机动战士高达海瑟薇 女神喀耳刻的魔法

paras.en: Yes, the title is a mouthful, and no, it has nothing to do with sorcery or nymphs. Instead, this second in a planned trilogy of movies returns to the core “Universal Century” timeline of the Gundam franchise for blistering battles between military mecha, with a side of complex planetary politics to keep things cerebral.
paras.zh: 是的，这个标题很拗口，不，它与巫术或仙女无关。相反，计划中的电影三部曲中的第二部回到了高达系列的核心“宇宙世纪”时间线，讲述了军事机甲之间的激烈战斗，并以复杂的行星政治来让事情保持理智。

paras.en: The eponymous Hathaway Noa (Kenshō Ono in Japanese; Caleb Yen in English) is secretly Mafty, leader of a rebel group of fighters dedicated to overthrowing the corrupt Earth Federation Government. One man’s rebel is another’s terrorist, though, and Federation loyalist Kenneth Sleg (Junichi Suwabe; Aaron Philips) is finally on Mafty’s trail, having uncovered his true identity. Yet as the two head toward a clash over the skies of Adelaide, the visions of precognitive Gigi Andalucia (Reina Ueda; Megan Shipman) could change everyone’s fates. You’ll definitely want to catch the first Hathaway film (on Netflix, too) before jumping in here, but this captivating anime epic packs in plenty of emotional depth alongside the giant robot smackdowns. Fingers crossed the finale isn’t too far off.
paras.zh: 同名的海瑟薇·诺亚（日语为 Kenshō Ono；英语为 Caleb Yen）是秘密的马夫蒂，是一个致力于推翻腐败的地球联邦政府的叛乱战士组织的领导人。然而，一个人的反叛者就是另一个人的恐怖分子，而联邦忠诚者肯尼思·斯莱格（诹访部润一；亚伦·菲利普斯饰）终于开始追踪马夫蒂，并揭露了他的真实身份。然而，当两人在阿德莱德上空展开冲突时，具有预知能力的吉吉·安达卢西亚（上田蕾娜；梅根·希普曼饰）的幻象可能会改变每个人的命运。在跳到这里之前，您肯定会想先看一下海瑟薇的第一部电影（也可以在 Netflix 上观看），但这部引人入胜的动漫史诗除了巨大的机器人撞击之外，还充满了丰富的情感深度。祈祷结局已经不远了。

paras.en: John Carpenter’s remake of the 1951 classic The Thing From Another World was intended to be a more accurate adaptation of the original source material, author John W. Campbell Jr.’s 1938 novella Who Goes There? What he ended up creating was one of the most influential and enduringly brilliant pieces of sci-fi horror ever committed to celluloid.
paras.zh: 约翰·卡彭特 (John Carpenter) 对 1951 年经典作品《来自另一个世界的事物》(The Thing From Another World) 的翻拍旨在更准确地改编原著，即作者小约翰·W·坎贝尔 (John W. Campbell Jr.) 1938 年的中篇小说《谁去那儿？》(Who Goes There?)。他最终创作的作品是赛璐珞史上最有影响力、最经久不衰的精彩科幻恐怖片之一。

paras.en: In the sheer isolation of an Antarctic research station, a crew of scientists—a powerhouse cast including Kurt Russell and Keith David—find themselves facing a shapeshifting menace from the stars, with the paranoia mounting as they turn on each other, unsure of who among them is really human. It’s a masterclass in tension, all brought gruesomely to life with pioneering effects work.
