Almost paradoxically, it bombed on release, but audiences have seen the error of their ways in the decades since. Learn the same lesson now, if you’ve not seen it yet.
paras.zh: 在一个与世隔绝的南极研究站里，一群科学家——包括库尔特·拉塞尔和基思·大卫在内的强大阵容——发现自己面临着来自星星的变形威胁，当他们互相攻击时，偏执情绪不断增加，不确定他们当中谁是真正的人类。这是一堂充满紧张气氛的大师班，一切都通过开创性的特效作品栩栩如生地呈现出来。几乎自相矛盾的是，它一上映就惨遭失败，但从那以后的几十年里，观众已经看到了他们的错误。如果您还没有看过，请立即学习相同的课程。

paras.en: The X-Files: I Want to Believe—Vrach Frankenshteyn
paras.zh: X档案：我想相信——Vrach Frankenshteyn

paras.en: Originally released in 2008, this second feature length X-Files thriller was never anyone’s favorite chapter for the long-running sci-fi conspiracy franchise. It abandoned much of the mythology of the core series and instead charged returning leads Mulder (David Duchovny) and Scully (Gillian Anderson) with investigating a missing FBI agent, a rash of murders, and grisly organ harvesting. It all felt like an odd fit.
paras.zh: 《X 档案》惊悚片第二部长片于 2008 年首次上映，但对于这部长期上映的科幻阴谋系列来说，它从来都不是任何人最喜欢的章节。它放弃了核心系列的大部分神话，转而委托回归的主角穆德（大卫·杜楚尼饰）和斯卡利（吉莉安·安德森饰）调查失踪的联邦调查局特工、一系列谋杀和可怕的器官摘取。这一切感觉很奇怪。

paras.en: In hindsight, that might be down to the film being in development hell for years, then subject to studio interference, its release ultimately neutering creator-director Chris Carter’s vision. This Vrach Frankenshteyn edit corrects that, reinserting cut scenes and restoring the almost “folk horror meets body horror” approach that the original was aiming for, while trimming some other scenes for a tighter, better-paced experience. Longtime fans of The X-Files will appreciate this more authentic take on the film, while newcomers will find it a solid stand-alone horror—and perhaps a perfect introduction to the vibe of the series ahead of Ryan Coogler’s upcoming TV reboot.
paras.zh: 事后看来，这可能是因为这部电影多年来一直处于地狱般的开发状态，然后受到制片厂的干扰，它的上映最终削弱了创作者兼导演克里斯·卡特的愿景。弗拉赫·弗兰肯斯坦的剪辑纠正了这一点，重新插入过场动画，恢复了原作所追求的几乎“民间恐怖遇上身体恐怖”的方式，同时修剪了一些其他场景，以获得更紧凑、节奏更快的体验。 《X档案》的老粉丝会欣赏这部更真实的电影，而新来的人会发现它是一部坚实的独立恐怖片——也许是在瑞恩·库格勒即将重启的电视剧之前完美介绍该系列的氛围。

paras.en: Set in the 23rd century, but with a mythology spanning millennia, this wildly ambitious sci-fi adventure sees humble cab driver Korben Dallas (Bruce Willis) drawn into a battle to save Earth from impending doom when runaway Leeloo (Milla Jovovich) crashes into his life—literally, falling onto his flying taxi while escaping from the forces of the exquisitely evilly-named Jean-Baptiste Emanuel Zorg (Gary Oldman). Cut to: a race to find ancient elements, a cosmic opera diva, warring alien races, and a scene-stealing turn from Chris Tucker as the phenomenally flamboyant media mogul Ruby Rhod.
paras.zh: 这部雄心勃勃的科幻冒险故事背景设定在 23 世纪，但神话跨越千年，讲述了卑微的出租车司机科本·达拉斯（布鲁斯·威利斯饰）卷入了一场拯救地球免遭末日的战斗，但逃跑的李鲁（米拉·乔沃维奇饰）撞进了他的生活——准确地说，是在逃离名字邪恶的让-巴蒂斯特·伊曼纽尔·佐格（加里·加里饰）的势力时掉进了他的飞行出租车上。奥德曼）。镜头切入：寻找古代元素的竞赛、宇宙歌剧女主角、交战的外星种族，以及克里斯·塔克 (Chris Tucker) 饰演极其华丽的媒体大亨鲁比·罗德 (Ruby Rhod) 的抢镜镜头。

paras.en: Director Luc Besson’s gloriously weird, experimental outing was something of a sleeper hit in the US when it was released in 1997, but with its phenomenal practical effects, mind-bending world designs, and bizarre fashions dreamed up by Jean Paul Gaultier, it has more than earned its status as a bona fide cult classic. If you’ve never experienced it, prepare for sensory overload as you take in this vibrant vision of the future.
paras.zh: 导演吕克·贝松的这部光怪陆离、实验性的影片于 1997 年在美国上映时曾引起轰动，但凭借其惊人的实际效果、令人费解的世界设计以及让·保罗·高提耶 (Jean Paul Gaultier) 构想的奇异时尚，它已经赢得了名副其实的邪教经典的地位。如果您从未体验过，请在欣赏充满活力的未来愿景时做好感官超载的准备。

paras.en: It’s rare for a film’s tagline to outshine its actual name, but Edge of Tomorrow’s striking “Live. Die. Repeat.” so perfectly encapsulates this time-loop action epic that it has supplanted the title for many. Then again, you might also know it as All You Need Is Kill, the original Japanese light novel by Hiroshi Sakurazaka and Yoshitoshi Abe that it’s based on.
paras.zh: 电影的标语很少能超越其真实名称，但《明日边缘》的“Live.Die.Repeat”却引人注目。它如此完美地概括了这部时间循环动作史诗，以至于它已经取代了许多人的标题。话又说回来，你可能也知道它是《All You Need Is Kill》，这是根据樱坂宏和安倍芳俊的日本原创轻小说改编的。

paras.en: Director Doug Liman’s live-action take reframes humanity’s battle against seemingly unstoppable alien “Mimics” to grand cinematic scale, with Tom Cruise as Major William Cage, a cowardly public affairs officer in the United Defense Force, killed almost as soon as he’s forced onto the battlefield—only to wake right up and have to go through it all again and again. His only hope is to learn from Sergeant Rita Vrataski (Emily Blunt), a legendary soldier who’s been caught in her own cycle of violent death and rebirth. An explosive take on Groundhog Day, the film packs in a surprising amount of heart alongside the thrilling clashes against alien monsters.
paras.zh: 导演道格·利曼的真人电影将人类与看似势不可挡的外星“模仿者”的战斗重新塑造成宏大的电影规模，汤姆·克鲁斯饰演威廉·凯奇少校，他是联合国防军中一位胆怯的公共事务官员，他几乎一被迫上战场就被杀了，但醒来后却不得不一次又一次地经历这一切。他唯一的希望就是向丽塔·弗拉塔斯基中士（艾米莉·布朗特饰）学习，她是一位传奇士兵，陷入了暴力死亡和重生的循环之中。这部电影对《土拨鼠之日》进行了爆炸性的演绎，在与外星怪物的惊心动魄的冲突中，充满了令人惊讶的情感。

articles.title: 'Narnia: The Magician's Nephew' trailer unveils Greta Gerwig's vision

paras.en: Oct. 13 (UPI) -- Netflix released the trailer for Narnia: The Magician's Nephew on Tuesday. The film opens in theaters, including IMAX, on Feb. 12.
paras.zh: 10 月 13 日（UPI）——Netflix 周二发布了《纳尼亚传奇：魔术师的侄子》的预告片。该片将于 2 月 12 日在包括 IMAX 在内的影院上映。

paras.en: In The Magician's Nephew, Digory Kirke (David McKenna) and Polly Plummer (Beatrice Campbell) stay with their Uncle Andrew Ketterly (Daniel Craig). Uncle Andrew reveals he is a magician and introduces them to the worlds of Narnia.
paras.zh: 在《魔术师的侄子》中，迪戈里·柯克（大卫·麦肯纳饰）和波莉·普拉默（比阿特丽斯·坎贝尔饰）和他们的叔叔安德鲁·凯特利（丹尼尔·克雷格饰）住在一起。安德鲁叔叔透露自己是一名魔术师，并向他们介绍了纳尼亚的世界。

paras.en: The kids visit a mossy forest and ride on a flying pegasus. They meet the lion, Aslan, who roars. Meryl Streep will voice Aslan in the movie.
paras.zh: 孩子们参观了一片长满青苔的森林，并乘坐飞马。他们遇到了咆哮的狮子阿斯兰。梅丽尔·斯特里普将在电影中为阿斯兰配音。

paras.en: The Magician's Nephew is the sixth book C.S. Lewis wrote in the series but is set before The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe. That book, Prince Caspian and The Voyage of the Dawn Treader were previously adapted as movies.
paras.zh: 《魔术师的侄子》是 C.S. 刘易斯在该系列中写的第六本书，但背景设定在《狮子、女巫和魔衣橱》之前。该书《凯斯宾王子》和《黎明踏浪号》此前曾被改编成电影。

paras.en: Narnia is Gerwig's follow-up to Barbie. Emma Mackey, Carey Mulligan, Ciarán Hinds, Kobna Holdbrook-Smith, Denise Gough and Susan Wokoma also star.
paras.zh: 纳尼亚传奇是葛韦格的芭比娃娃的后续作品。艾玛·麦基、凯瑞·穆里根、塞伦·希德、科布纳·霍尔德布鲁克-史密斯、丹妮丝·高夫和苏珊·沃科玛也出演。

articles.title: Jury sworn in for Russell Brand rape, sexual assault trial

paras.en: Oct. 13 (UPI) -- A jury was selected Tuesday in the trial of comedian Russell Brand, who has been accused of rape and sexual assault.
paras.zh: 10 月 13 日（UPI）——周二，喜剧演员拉塞尔·布兰德（Russell Brand）被指控强奸和性侵犯，陪审团选出。

paras.en: Brand, 51, faces three charges of rape, three charges of sexual assault and one charge of indecent assault against six women. The allegations span from 1999 to 2009. He denies all charges.
paras.zh: 51 岁的布兰德面临三项强奸指控、三项性侵犯指控和一项针对六名女性的猥亵指控。这些指控从 1999 年到 2009 年。他否认所有指控。

paras.en: Justice Joel Bennathan told the potential jurors to ignore past reporting about Brand and the allegations against him. He also said to not talk to anyone about the trial or conduct any research.
paras.zh: 乔尔·本纳森法官告诉潜在的陪审员不要理会过去有关布兰德的报道和针对他的指控。他还表示不要与任何人谈论该试验或进行任何研究。

paras.en: "Heaven knows what's out there," Bennathan said. "If you want to, you could go and have a look -- but only once you have returned your verdicts."
paras.zh: “天知道那里有什么，”本纳森说。 “如果你愿意的话，你可以去看看——但前提是你已经做出了裁决。”

paras.en: The trial is at Southwark Criminal Court and is expected to last six to eight weeks. The jury consists of eight men and four women, with one reserve juror. They were sent home and will return Wednesday when prosecutor Riel Karmy-Jones is scheduled to begin the proceedings.
paras.zh: 审判在南华克刑事法院进行，预计将持续六到八周。陪审团由八名男性和四名女性组成，还有一名后备陪审员。他们被送回家，并将于周三返回，届时检察官里尔·卡米-琼斯计划开始诉讼。

paras.en: Brand's wife, Laura Gallacher Brand, was by his side for the first day on Monday, but didn't come to the trial on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 布兰德的妻子劳拉·加拉赫·布兰德(Laura Gallacher Brand)周一第一天就在他身边，但周二没有出庭。

paras.en: Soon after the initial allegations, YouTube stopped monetizing Brand's channels.
paras.zh: 在最初的指控发生后不久，YouTube 就停止了通过布兰德的频道获利。

paras.en: Brand is also a defendant in a civil case that alleges he sexually assaulted an anonymous Jane Doe plaintiff on the set of the remake movie Arthur in 2010.
paras.zh: 布兰德也是一起民事案件的被告，该案件指控他于 2010 年在翻拍电影《亚瑟》的片场对一位匿名的无名氏原告进行了性侵犯。

articles.title: Company recalls thousands of bottles of Amazon acetaminophen

paras.en: Oct. 13 (UPI) -- A company is recalling more than 112,000 bottles of the Amazon brand of extra-strength acetaminophen after reports that consumers found discolored tablets in their bottles.
paras.zh: 10 月 13 日 (UPI)——有报道称，消费者在瓶子中发现了变色的药片，一家公司正在召回超过 112,000 瓶亚马逊品牌的特强对乙酰氨基酚。

paras.en: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration recently issued a notice on the voluntary recall by Aurobindo Pharma USA Inc., which took place Sept. 18. The recall involves 500-milligram extra-strength acetaminophen sold in 200-, 500- and 1,000-count bottles, including:
paras.zh: 美国食品和药物管理局最近发布了关于 Aurobindo Pharma USA Inc. 于 9 月 18 日进行自愿召回的通知。此次召回涉及以 200、500 和 1,000 瓶装销售的 500 毫克特强对乙酰氨基酚，其中包括：

paras.en: -- 14,640 200-count bottles with lot number ACD125040A and an expiration date of Sept. 30, 2027
-- 90,456 500-count bottles with multiple lotnumbers and expiration dates, all in 2027 and 2028
paras.zh: -- 90,456 瓶 500 瓶，具有多个批号和有效期，全部在 2027 年和 2028 年

paras.en: -- 7,836 1,000-count bottles with lot number ACD124048A and an expiration date of Nov. 30, 2027
paras.zh: --批号为ACD124048A、有效期为2027年11月30日的7836瓶1000瓶

paras.en: The FDA has not given a classification rating based on the level of health risk to the recall. Amazon issued a statement to USA Today that the recall was "in coordination with the manufacturer, Aurohealth, and the FDA."
paras.zh: FDA 尚未根据召回的健康风险程度给出分类评级。亚马逊向《今日美国》发表声明称，此次召回是“与制造商、Aurohealth 和 FDA 协调的”。

paras.en: Aurobindo issued a similar recall in 2025 for 325-milligram acetaminophen tablets also sold on Amazon due to discoloration.
paras.zh: Aurobindo 于 2025 年对同样在亚马逊上销售的 325 毫克对乙酰氨基酚片剂因变色问题进行了类似召回。

articles.title: A ‘Spectacle’ Is Coming: Michael Jackson’s Iconic Super Bowl Performance Is Getting a Documentary
articles.author: Alicia Urrea

paras.en: Michael Jackson‘s legendary Super Bowl halftime performance is getting a closer look.
paras.zh: 迈克尔·杰克逊传奇的超级碗中场表演正在得到近距离观察。

paras.en: More than three decades after the King of Pop took the stage at Super Bowl XXVII, Hulu and ESPN are revisiting the making of the groundbreaking 1993 performance in a new documentary titled Spectacle: Michael Jackson at the Super Bowl, arriving in February 2027.
paras.zh: 在这位流行音乐之王登上第 27 届超级碗舞台三十多年后，Hulu 和 ESPN 正在拍摄一部名为《壮观：迈克尔·杰克逊在超级碗》的新纪录片，重新审视 1993 年这一开创性表演的制作过程，该纪录片将于 2027 年 2 月上映。

paras.en: Directed by Bao Nguyen, whose previous credits include Netflix’s The Greatest Night in Pop, the feature-length documentary will explore the behind-the-scenes journey that brought Jackson’s halftime show to life. The film will also include never-before-seen footage of the pop superstar and his team, giving fans a new perspective on a performance that helped reshape one of television’s biggest annual events.
paras.zh: 这部长篇纪录片由鲍·阮 (Bao Nguyen) 执导，他之前的作品包括 Netflix 的《流行音乐中最伟大的夜晚》，这部纪录片将探索使杰克逊的中场表演栩栩如生的幕后旅程。这部电影还将包括这位流行巨星和他的团队从未公开过的镜头，让粉丝们以新的视角来看待这场帮助重塑电视界最大的年度盛事之一的表演。

paras.en: A newly released teaser shows a glimpse of the spectacle, with footage of Jackson commanding the stage at the Rose Bowl in Pasadena, Calif., in his signature military-inspired outfit as thousands of fans fill the venue, chanting his name. The clip also previews the documentary’s title before revealing its February premiere on Hulu and ESPN.
paras.zh: 新发布的预告片展示了这一奇观，视频中杰克逊穿着他标志性的军事风格服装，在加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳玫瑰碗体育场的舞台上指挥着舞台，成千上万的粉丝挤满了场地，高喊着他的名字。该剪辑还预览了该纪录片的标题，然后在 Hulu 和 ESPN 上公布了该纪录片 2 月份的首映。

paras.en: Jackson’s appearance at Super Bowl XXVII on Jan. 31, 1993, marked a turning point for the halftime show. Instead of a typical intermission between the game’s two halves, the performance was an event of its own. It helped establish the halftime stage as a destination for some of the biggest names in music.
paras.zh: 1993 年 1 月 31 日，杰克逊出现在第 27 届超级碗比赛中，标志着中场表演的转折点。与典型的两半场中场休息不同，这场表演本身就是一场盛会。它帮助中场舞台成为一些音乐界大腕的聚集地。

paras.en: Jackson was already a force on the charts long before he even took the Super Bowl stage. As a solo artist, he scored 13 No. 1 hits over the course of his career on the Billboard Hot 100, including classics such as “Billie Jean,” “Beat It” and “Black or White.” His album Thriller was also monumental. The 1982 blockbuster spent 37 weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard 200, producing seven Hot 100 top 10 hits — an extraordinary run that helped cement Jackson’s status as one of pop’s most influential hitmakers.
paras.zh: 早在登上超级碗舞台之前，杰克逊就已经是排行榜上的一股力量了。作为一名独唱歌手，他在职业生涯中 13 次登上公告牌百强单曲榜第一名，其中包括《Billie Jean》、《Beat It》和《Black or White》等经典歌曲。他的专辑《Thriller》也具有里程碑意义。这部 1982 年的大片在 Billboard 200 排行榜上连续 37 周位居第一，其中七首歌曲进入 Hot 100 排行榜前 10 名——这一非凡的表现帮助巩固了杰克逊作为流行乐界最具影响力的热门歌曲制作人之一的地位。

paras.en: Watch the teaser for Spectacle: Michael Jackson at the Super Bowl below.
paras.zh: 请观看下面的《奇观：迈克尔·杰克逊在超级碗》的预告片。

articles.title: Tupac Killer Duane Davis Sentenced to 40 Years To Life in Prison for Murdering Rap Icon
articles.author: Bill Donahue

paras.en: Duane “Keffe D” Davis, the man convicted of murdering Tupac Shakur, was sentenced to 40 years to life in prison Tuesday (Oct. 13) for orchestrating the 1996 killing of the rap legend.
paras.zh: 周二（10 月 13 日），因谋杀图派克·夏库尔 (Tupac Shakur) 而被定罪的杜安·“凯夫·D”·戴维斯 (Duane “Keffe D” Davis) 因策划 1996 年谋杀这位说唱传奇人物而被判处 40 年至终身监禁。

paras.en: Davis, 63, was found guilty in August of masterminding the Las Vegas drive-by shooting that left the iconic rapper dead at the age of 25. Prosecutors say the former Los Angeles gang leader ordered the killing in revenge for Tupac beating up his nephew — and then repeatedly admitted it in the years after.
paras.zh: 63 岁的戴维斯于 8 月被判策划拉斯维加斯驾车枪击事件，导致这位标志性说唱歌手在 25 岁时死亡。检察官称，这位前洛杉矶帮派头目下令杀人，是为了报复图帕克殴打他的侄子，然后在之后的几年里多次承认了这一点。

paras.en: At a court hearing Tuesday (Oct. 13), Judge Carli Kierny sentenced Davis to 40 years to life in prison for that crime, telling him, as Shakur’s family looked on, that “the world never forgot about Tupac” and that he must pay for his killing.
paras.zh: 在周二（10 月 13 日）的法庭听证会上，卡利·基尔尼法官因这一罪行判处戴维斯 40 年至无期徒刑，并在沙库尔家人的注视下告诉他，“世界永远不会忘记图帕克”，他必须为他的杀戮付出代价。

paras.en: “You don’t get to take a man from his family, you don’t get to take his very life, his whole future from him and just walk away from it. Especially when that man is Tupac Shakur,” the judge said. “It took us 30 years, but at this time you are going to face justice for what you did on Sept. 7, 1996.”
paras.zh: “你不能夺走一个人的家人，你不能夺走他的生命，夺走他的整个未来，然后就走开。特别是当那个人是图帕克·沙库尔时，”法官说。 “我们花了30年的时间，但此时你将因1996年9月7日的所作所为而面临正义。”

paras.en: The sentence came after members of Shakur’s family had testified to the harm the killing had caused them: “That day, the loss of Tupac, for a long time, crippled my entire family emotionally and mentally,” said Sekyiwa Shakur, the late artist’s sister. “I miss my brother. I do, I do, I do.”
paras.zh: 判决是在沙库尔的家人证实这起杀戮给他们造成的伤害之后做出的：“那天，图帕克的去世，在很长一段时间内，让我整个家庭在情感和精神上都受到了损害，”已故艺术家的妹妹塞基瓦·沙库尔 (Sekyiwa Shakur) 说。 “我想念我的兄弟。我想，我想，我想。”

paras.en: Shakur, then a rising superstar in the rap world, was fatally wounded in a drive-by shooting following a Mike Tyson boxing match in Las Vegas. His death, which came amid the infamous East Coast-West Coast hip-hop feud, was followed months later by the shooting of rival The Notorious B.I.G. No one was charged with either killing, and the pair of cold cases became a fixture in American cultural history.
paras.zh: 沙库尔当时是说唱界冉冉升起的超级巨星，在拉斯维加斯举行的迈克·泰森拳击比赛后，他在一次驾车枪击事件中身受重伤。他的死发生在臭名昭著的东海岸和西海岸嘻哈争斗之中，几个月后，他的竞争对手 The Notorious B.I.G. 也被枪杀。这两起谋杀案都没有人被指控，这两起悬案成为美国文化史上的固定事件。

paras.en: But in September 2023, prosecutors finally unveiled a murder indictment against Davis, a Crips gang leader in 1990s Los Angeles, claiming he had ordered the killing as revenge after Shakur’s entourage beat up his nephew earlier that night — part of a long-running local gang beef that had come to overlap with the East-West music rivalry.
paras.zh: 但在 2023 年 9 月，检察官最终公布了对 90 年代洛杉矶 Crips 帮派头目戴维斯的谋杀起诉书，声称戴维斯是在当晚早些时候沙库尔的随从殴打他的侄子后下令杀人的，这是当地长期存在的帮派冲突的一部分，与东西方音乐竞争重叠。

paras.en: In bringing that case, prosecutors relied primarily on Davis’ own words as evidence, including a 2019 tell-all memoir and podcast interviews in which he candidly described his role in the famous crime. Davis’ defense attorneys argued that those statements were essentially just fictional, aimed at helping to boost his notoriety and sell books.
paras.zh: 在提起此案时，检察官主要依靠戴维斯自己的话作为证据，包括 2019 年的回忆录和播客采访，他在其中坦率地描述了自己在这起著名犯罪中所扮演的角色。戴维斯的辩护律师辩称，这些言论本质上只是虚构的，旨在帮助提高他的恶名和销售书籍。

paras.en: Across two weeks of trial, prosecutors called 24 witnesses and played more than eight hours of recordings, mostly of Davis himself discussing his role in the killing. Defense attorney Michael Sanft presented only a brief defense, but told jurors that prosecutors had failed to present any hard proof tying his client to the shooting.
paras.zh: 在两周的审判中，检察官传唤了 24 名证人，并播放了超过 8 个小时的录音，其中大部分是戴维斯本人讨论他在谋杀中所扮演的角色。辩护律师迈克尔·桑夫特仅提出了简短的辩护，但告诉陪审员，检察官未能提供任何确凿的证据证明他的当事人与枪击事件有关。

paras.en: When the jury began to deliberate, it took just a few hours for them to find Davis guilty of murder. He has vowed to appeal the verdict, a process that could take years to reach a final decision.
paras.zh: 当陪审团开始审议时，他们只用了几个小时就判定戴维斯犯有谋杀罪。他发誓要对判决提出上诉，这一过程可能需要数年时间才能做出最终决定。

paras.en: At Tuesday’s hearing, prosecutors urged the judge to impose a harsh sentence, telling her that Davis had caused a “uniquely painful situation for this family.”
paras.zh: 在周二的听证会上，检察官敦促法官判处重刑，并告诉她戴维斯“给这个家庭带来了独特的痛苦局面”。

paras.en: “It is unique in the criminal justice system for somebody like Mr. Davis to inflict continued punishment … by publicly grandstanding in the death of Tupac Shakur,” one prosecutor told the judge, urging the “maximum possible sentence.”
paras.zh: 一名检察官告诉法官，“像戴维斯先生这样的人通过公开哗众取宠地宣扬图帕克·沙库尔之死来施加持续的惩罚，这在刑事司法系统中是独一无二的”，并敦促“判处尽可能重的刑罚”。

articles.title: Dolly Parton’s Nephew Fights Restraining Order, Says Estate Is Twisting ‘Friendly Exchange’
articles.author: Rachel Scharf

paras.en: Dolly Parton’s nephew is urging a judge to dissolve the restraining order against him, arguing he never made serious threats of violence against anyone connected to the late star’s estate.
paras.zh: 多莉·帕顿的侄子敦促法官解除对他的限制令，称他从未对与这位已故明星遗产有关的任何人发出过严重的暴力威胁。

paras.en: Bryan Seaver, the son of Parton’s sister and former head of security for the singer, was hit with a temporary restraining order last month after the estate flagged a slew of allegedly violent messages sent after her August death at age 80. A Nashville court hearing is scheduled for next week to determine whether that restraint should be extended into a longer-term injunction.
paras.zh: 帕顿姐姐的儿子、这位歌手的前保安主管布莱恩·西弗 (Bryan Seaver) 上个月受到临时限制令的打击，因为遗产管理机构标记了帕顿 80 岁去世后发送的一系列涉嫌暴力的信息。纳什维尔法庭定于下周举行听证会，以确定是否应将这种限制延长为长期禁令。

paras.en: Seaver submitted his first written response to the estate’s version of events in a Tuesday (Oct. 13) court filing, obtained and reported by Billboard. His lawyers argue that She’s Alive LLC (SAL), the entity managing Parton’s posthumous affairs, has “turned a private, profane and ultimately friendly exchange between two longtime friends into a claim of terror that the exchanges themselves refute.”
paras.zh: 西弗在周二（10 月 13 日）的一份法庭文件中提交了他对遗产委​​员会事件版本的第一份书面回应，《公告牌》获得并报道了该文件。他的律师辩称，管理帕顿死后事务的实体“She's Alive LLC”（SAL）“将两个老朋友之间的私人、亵渎、最终友好的交流变成了一种恐怖的说法，而这些交流本身却反驳了这一说法。”

paras.en: Many of the messages in question are between Seaver and Danny Nozell, Parton’s longtime manager who now is running SAL. Seaver says the unedited text thread shows that Nozell, who was his “close friend,” reacted with a “heart” and “haha” to his messages calling himself an “international arms dealer and mercenary” and writing “all I do is warfare.”
paras.zh: 许多有问题的消息都是 Seaver 和丹尼·诺泽尔 (Danny Nozell) 之间的，丹尼·诺泽尔是帕顿的长期经理，现在负责 SAL 的运营。西弗说，未经编辑的短信显示，他的“亲密朋友”诺泽尔对他称自己为“国际军火商和雇佣兵”并写道“我所做的一切就是战争”的信息做出了“真心”和“哈哈”的反应。

paras.en: Seaver says his use of the term “ratf—k,” while “vulgar,” was slang referencing plans to “undercut or outmaneuver someone in business or politics, not to cause physical harm.” And Seaver argues that when he used the phrase “I’m a killer” in an email to a lawyer, he was merely contrasting his military background with the rest of the entertainment industry.
paras.zh: 西弗说，他使用的“ratf-k”一词虽然“粗俗”，但实际上是俚语，指的是“在商业或政治上削弱或战胜某人，而不是造成人身伤害”的计划。西弗辩称，当他在给律师的电子邮件中使用“我是杀手”这句话时，他只是将自己的军事背景与娱乐业的其他人进行对比。

paras.en: According to Seaver, he’s been nothing but “peaceful” since his security company was terminated by the estate last month. He says their only real dispute was about a $250,000 debt he was owed for previous security services, which has now been paid.
paras.zh: 据西弗说，自从上个月他的保安公司被庄园终止后，他一直“平静”。他说，他们唯一真正的争议是关于他因之前的安全服务而欠下的 25 万美元债务，目前已经偿还。

paras.en: “What SAL actually fears is speech: Mr. Seaver’s stated wish to tell his family’s story on a podcast, to go to Billboard Magazine, and to ‘embarrass’ a business partner he believed was mistreating his family,” write Seaver’s lawyers, Dominic Leonardo and James Collier. “Those are not threats of violence. They are expressions protected by the First Amendment.”
paras.zh: “SAL 实际上担心的是言论：西弗先生声称希望在播客上讲述他家人的故事，上《告示牌》杂志，并让他认为虐待他家人的商业伙伴‘难堪’，”西弗的律师多米尼克·莱昂纳多 (Dominic Leonardo) 和詹姆斯·科利尔 (James Collier) 写道。 “这些不是暴力威胁。它们是受第一修正案保护的表达方式。”

paras.en: Seaver’s lawyers say that in addition to trampling his free speech rights, the restraining order that’s currently in place unfairly bars him from communicating with his own mother or the trust attorneys who are distributing his inheritance from Parton. They argue that rather than extending that order, the judge should end it entirely.
paras.zh: 西弗的律师表示，除了践踏他的言论自由权之外，目前实施的限制令还不公平地禁止他与自己的母亲或分配他从帕顿继承的遗产的信托律师沟通。他们认为，法官不应延长该命令，而应完全终止该命令。

paras.en: Reps for Parton’s estate did not immediately return a request for comment on Tuesday. They are due to file a written reply to Seaver by Friday (Oct. 16) before meeting him in court for the hearing next Tuesday (Oct. 20).
paras.zh: 帕顿庄园的代表周二没有立即回复置评请求。他们将于周五（10 月 16 日）之前向 Seaver 提交书面答复，然后在下周二（10 月 20 日）在法庭上与他会面参加听证会。

articles.title: Banned in Iran, Denied a U.K. Visa: Mohsen Amiryousefi’s Film About Banned Films Heads to London
articles.author: Georg Szalai

paras.en: Iranian director Mohsen Amiryousefi (Fire Keeper, Lovely Trashes) discusses his past work and career with none other than the Angel of Death in his new film, The Banning Curse (Nefrin-e Toghif), a piece of “cinematic autofiction about the highs and lows of radical filmmaking,” as the BFI London Film Festival puts it.
paras.zh: 伊朗导演 Mohsen Amiryousefi（《火卫士》、《可爱的垃圾》）在他的新片《班宁诅咒》（Nefrin-e Toghif）中与死亡天使讨论了他过去的工作和职业生涯，正如 BFI 伦敦电影节所说，这是一部“关于激进电影制作的高潮和低谷的电影自传”。

paras.en: The film, written and directed by the auteur, will world premiere in the program of the 70th edition of the festival on Wednesday. The director and his editor, Kamy Saffari, saw the U.K. reject their visa applications, according to a representative, so they won’t be able to travel to London to experience the audience reaction to the film. But Amiryousefi is used to facing all sorts of hurdles, which is just what his new film is about.
paras.zh: 这部由作者编剧和导演的影片将于周三在第 70 届电影节的节目中进行全球首映。据一位代表称，导演和剪辑师卡米·萨法里 (Kamy Saffari) 看到英国拒绝了他们的签证申请，因此他们无法前往伦敦体验观众对这部电影的反应。但阿米尤塞菲习惯于面对各种障碍，这正是他的新电影的主题。

paras.en: “After the critical success of his first film at Cannes [where the black comedy Bitter Dream won a Golden Camera for best first feature film special mention], Amiryousefi returned to Iran to find it banned by state authorities,” teases a synopsis of his new film on the LFF website. “It’s a pattern that continued through his entire career, which the seasoned director looks back on in this imaginative, satirical portrait. A balance of biography and constructed fiction, the filmmaker’s own life and Iran’s turbulent political, social and cultural history are entwined via a rich trove of archive footage.”
paras.zh: “在他的第一部电影在戛纳电影节取得巨大成功后（黑色喜剧《苦梦》赢得了金摄影机奖最佳首部故事片特别提及奖），阿米尤塞菲回到伊朗，发现该片已被国家当局禁止，”LFF 网站上的他的新电影概要介绍道。 “这种模式贯穿了他的整个职业生涯，这位经验丰富的导演在这部富有想象力的讽刺肖像中回顾了这一模式。传记和虚构的小说、电影制片人自己的生活以及伊朗动荡的政治、社会和文化历史之间的平衡通过丰富的档案素材交织在一起。”

paras.en: Film history is also a recurring theme in the film. A trailer for The Banning Curse, which you can watch below, mentions a legendary Iranian actor, for example, while the film also mentions the works of such famous directors as Federico Fellini and Christopher Nolan.
paras.zh: 电影历史也是影片中反复出现的主题。例如，您可以在下面观看的《禁止诅咒》的预告片中提到了一位传奇伊朗演员，而影片还提到了费德里科·费里尼和克里斯托弗·诺兰等著名导演的作品。

paras.en: By Zoom and via an interpreter, Amiryousefi talked to THR about The Banning Curse and its creation.
paras.zh: 阿米尤塞菲通过 Zoom 和翻译向《好莱坞报道》讲述了《禁令咒》及其创作。

paras.en: The film was shot indoors without shooting permits and without the need for a big budget. “It was not a very complicated thing for us, as it is something that I and many other filmmakers in Iran have done before,” the director shares with THR via his translator. “But the main point that was different was that I was in front of the camera this time. That was my first experience [acting], and I tried to be very honest and share all reflections on the subject in front of the camera.”
paras.zh: 这部电影是在室内拍摄的，没有拍摄许可，也不需要大量的预算。 “这对我们来说并不是一件非常复杂的事情，因为这是我和许多其他伊朗电影制作人以前做过的事情，”导演通过翻译向《好莱坞报道》透露。 “但主要的不同之处在于，这次我站在镜头前。那是我第一次[表演]经历，我试图非常诚实地分享对镜头前主题的所有思考。”

paras.en: The Angel of Death is a character that Amiryousefi’s films have featured before. “From my very first film, there has been some kind of angel of death present, and this time, it is again,” the filmmaker explains. And audiences in his home country are familiar with the idea. “It is very regular for Iranian people to feel the Angel of Death beside them. I tried to make it change into something else in the middle of the film, where we can see that it is rather the double of the filmmaker. But the Angel of Death represents death as it is viewed and believed in Iranian society.”
paras.zh: 死亡天使是阿米尤瑟菲电影中曾经出现过的角色。 “从我的第一部电影开始，就有某种死亡天使出现，这一次，又出现了，”电影制片人解释道。他的祖国的观众也熟悉这个想法。 “伊朗人经常感觉到死亡天使就在他们身边。我试图在电影中间把它变成其他东西，我们可以看到它更像是电影制片人的替身。但死亡天使代表了伊朗社会所看待和相信的死亡。”

paras.en: Does the Iranian filmmaker have any hopes for how The Banning Curse will be received by audiences at the LFF? “I don’t know how the audience will react, but I’m very happy that the film will be screened, I hope that this look at life, full of funny moments, full of anger, full of sorrow, can connect with the audience.”
paras.zh: 这位伊朗电影制片人对伦敦电影节观众对《禁咒》的反响有什么希望吗？ “我不知道观众会有什么反应，但我很高兴这部电影能够上映，我希望这种看待生活的方式，充满搞笑的时刻，充满愤怒，充满悲伤，能够与观众产生共鸣。”

paras.en: Amiryousefi’s films have long been banned in his home country, but he also expects The Banning Curse to be seen there. “Luckily, nowadays there are so many ways to show films to the people,” he says. “There are a lot of spaces, and virtual screenings and streaming, so you can see people following Iranian films in those ways.”
paras.zh: 阿米尤塞菲的电影在他的祖国早已被禁，但他也希望《禁咒咒》能在那里上映。 “幸运的是，现在有很多方式向人们展示电影，”他说。 “有很多空间、虚拟放映和流媒体，所以你可以看到人们以这些方式关注伊朗电影。”

paras.en: Whether Iran’s restrictions will ever loosen is another matter, but Amiryousefi is hopeful. “Anything can happen, and I’m optimistic,” shares Amiryousefi. “I’d hope that there would be no problem for anyone, including me, to release films in Iran.”
paras.zh: 伊朗的限制是否会放松是另一回事，但阿米尤塞菲对此充满希望。 “任何事情都有可能发生，我很乐观，”Amiryousefi 分享道。 “我希望包括我在内的任何人在伊朗发行电影都没有问题。”

paras.en: The film’s references run from Italian classics to Hollywood blockbusters to Iranian cinema, and the director says they’re deliberate: “For me, Fellini is the greatest filmmaker in film history, and his films, especially La Strada and Amarcord, have a special place in my heart. But when it comes to Nolan, I was trying to connect to the filmmaking of today. And there are also some references to Iranian filmmakers, [such as] paying tribute to Abbas Kiarostami [and others].”
paras.zh: 这部电影参考了意大利经典、好莱坞大片和伊朗电影，导演说这些都是经过深思熟虑的：“对我来说，费里尼是电影史上最伟大的电影制作人，他的电影，尤其是《拉斯特拉达》和《阿玛柯德》，在我心中占有特殊的地位。但说到诺兰，我试图将其与当今的电影制作联系起来。还有一些参考伊朗电影制作人的内容，例如向阿巴斯·基亚罗斯塔米致敬[和]其他人]”。

paras.en: For Iranian directors, prison is a real risk, and Mohammad Rasoulof is among those who have served time. Does Amiryousefi worry about the same fate? “When I was young, I was much more fearless,” quips Amiryousefi, who is 54. “Now that my hair is turning gray, I am somehow more conservative.”
paras.zh: 对于伊朗导演来说，坐牢是一个真正的风险，穆罕默德·拉索洛夫就是其中之一。阿米尤瑟菲是否担心同样的命运？ “当我年轻的时候，我更加无所畏惧，”54 岁的阿米尤瑟菲打趣道，“现在我的头发已经变白了，我不知何故更加保守了。”

paras.en: The director wraps up our chat with another joke about his age: “When going through the archival footage, I saw someone who looked very familiar, and I told the editor to rewind. And I saw myself much younger with black, longer hair. It was me, but now, I feel I’m so different from that version.”
paras.zh: 导演用另一个关于他年龄的笑话结束了我们的谈话：“在浏览档案片段时，我看到一个看起来很熟悉的人，我让剪辑师倒带。我看到自己年轻得多，有一头黑色的长发。那是我，但现在，我觉得我和那个版本很不一样。”

articles.title: ‘Love Trapped,’ Fake Twins and the Paternity Scandal That Outcrazied ‘The Bachelor’
articles.author: Jackie Strause

paras.en: Love Trapped host Stephani Young was wedding dress shopping in Arizona in September 2023 when she first read about the headline-making case against Clayton Echard, former star of The Bachelor. The article in the U.S. Sun, blaring the headline “Baby Mama Drama?,” detailed how an anonymous ex-girlfriend of Echard was claiming she was pregnant with his twins and demanding he take a paternity test in court documents.
paras.zh: 2023 年 9 月，《爱情陷阱》的主持人斯蒂芬妮·杨 (Stephani Young) 在亚利桑那州购买婚纱时，第一次读到了针对《单身汉》前明星克莱顿·埃查德 (Clayton Echard) 的头条新闻。 《美国太阳报》的这篇文章以“宝贝妈妈戏剧？”为标题，详细描述了埃查德的一位匿名前女友如何在法庭文件中声称自己怀上了他的双胞胎，并要求他进行亲子鉴定。

paras.en: “I remember thinking — and I’ve said this to Clayton’s face since — ‘Oh, that sounds about right,'” Young tells The Hollywood Reporter. “I didn’t watch his season. I had just seen clips online, and his reputation as the Bachelor preceded him.”
paras.zh: “我记得我在想——从那时起我就当着克莱顿的面说过这句话——‘哦，听起来不错，’”杨告诉《好莱坞报道》。 “我没有看过他的赛季。我只是在网上看过一些片段，他的单身汉名声就在他之前。”

paras.en: Echard, then 28 and a former NFL athlete, had ended his season 26 run on the popular ABC series as an unfavorable lead, to say the least. After telling his final three contestants that he loved all of them and that he slept with two of them — a big no-no on the decades-old franchise — he walked away from the show single, and fans didn’t hold back their feelings on social media.
paras.zh: 埃查德当时 28 岁，曾是一名 NFL 运动员，至少可以说，他以不利的领先优势结束了他在 ABC 热门系列节目中的第 26 季比赛。在告诉最后三名参赛者他爱他们所有人，并且他和其中两人睡过之后（这对于拥有数十年历史的特许经营权来说是一个大禁忌），他退出了节目单曲，粉丝们在社交媒体上毫不掩饰他们的感情。

paras.en: “If you look online and they ask, ‘Who are the most-hated Bachelors?’ — I’m always on the list,” Echard, who starred on the reality dating series in 2022, admits when chatting with THR earlier this summer. “I got death threats and people tearing into me by the thousands. There was a point where I really blamed the show for everything. But I have to take accountability,” he says. “The version of me that people saw on TV was a version I had manufactured, who I thought everyone wanted me to be.”
paras.zh: “如果你在网上查看，他们会问，‘谁是最讨厌的单身汉？’——我总是在名单上，”埃查德在 2022 年出演真人秀约会系列节目，今年夏天早些时候在接受《好莱坞报道》采访时承认。 “我收到了死亡威胁，还有成千上万的人对我进行撕扯。有一次，我真的把一切都归咎于这部剧。但我必须承担责任，”他说。 “人们在电视上看到的我的版本是我制造的版本，我认为每个人都希望我成为这样的人。”

paras.en: No one would blame Young for her reaction at that time, not even Echard. But that headline was just the beginning of a bizarre, three-year legal saga that remains ongoing. It’s a story every bit as wild as any episode of The Bachelor, and it’s attracted an even bigger audience with Young’s megahit podcast from iHeartPodcasts and Glass Podcasts pulling in over 25 million views to date.
paras.zh: 没有人会因为杨当时的反应而责怪她，甚至埃查德也不会。但这个头条新闻只是一个奇怪的、持续三年的法律传奇的开始，该传奇仍在继续。这是一个与《单身汉》中的任何一集一样疯狂的故事，并且吸引了更多的观众，Young 在 iHeartPodcasts 和 Glass Podcasts 上的热门播客迄今为止已获得超过 2500 万次观看。

paras.en: Love Trapped details the investigation that eventually unraveled how that unnamed ex-girlfriend — later identified as Laura Owens — attempted to entrap Echard into a relationship by altering an ultrasound image and other medical records, and fabricating a pregnancy video. According to one early ruling, she lied multiple times while under oath during hearings in the paternity and related protective order cases. In one court proceeding, now infamous online, she is seen adjusting what appears to be a fake pregnancy belly and drinking from a large Monster Energy can.
paras.zh: 《爱情被困》详细介绍了调查结果，最终揭开了那位未透露姓名的前女友（后来被确认为劳拉·欧文斯）如何试图通过更改超声波图像和其他医疗记录以及伪造怀孕视频来诱使埃查德陷入一段关系。根据一项早期裁决，她在亲子鉴定和相关保护令案件的听证会上宣誓时多次撒谎。在一项现已在网上臭名昭著的法庭诉讼中，人们看到她正在调整似乎是假怀孕的肚子，并用一个大怪物能量罐喝水。

paras.en: Echard isn’t denying a relationship with Owens, even if it was extremely brief. Back in 2022, after finishing his Bachelor turn, he moved to Arizona to begin a career as a real estate broker. That’s when he met Owens, the daughter of longtime San Francisco radio host Ronn Owens, and engaged in what he describes as a one-night stand, during which they had oral sex. “Laura initially reached out to me via LinkedIn,” Echard recalls. “If I wasn’t the Bachelor, I don’t think I would have popped on her radar.”
paras.zh: 埃查德并不否认与欧文斯的关系，即使这种关系非常短暂。早在 2022 年，完成学士学位后，他搬到了亚利桑那州，开始了房地产经纪人的职业生涯。就在那时，他遇到了旧金山电台长期主持人罗恩·欧文斯的女儿欧文斯，并发生了他所说的一夜情，期间他们进行了口交。 “劳拉最初通过 LinkedIn 联系我，”埃查德回忆道。 “如果我不是单身汉，我想我不会出现在她的雷达上。”

paras.en: After the dalliance, Echard says he never had sexual contact with Owens again. Although she attempted to continue the relationship, he had moved on — until, several months later, when she filed the paternity claim. “I sat down and was like ‘Who is this girl?’” he says. “We pulled up her Instagram, and the last 20 guys she followed were either athletes or local guys who were super successful. All good looking. She was targeting successful men in the area.”
paras.zh: 调情之后，埃查德说他再也没有与欧文斯发生过性接触。尽管她试图继续这段关系，但他已经继续前进——直到几个月后，她提出了亲子鉴定要求。 “我坐下来问‘这个女孩是谁？’”他说。 “我们打开她的 Instagram，发现她关注的最后 20 位男士要么是运动员，要么是超级成功的当地男士。他们都长得很帅。她的目标客户是该地区的成功男士。”

paras.en: Nearly two years after that paternity accusation was made public, radio journalist Young was approached by Glass Entertainment in May 2025 about hosting what would become the Love Trapped limited series podcast.
paras.zh: 在那起亲子关系指控公开近两年后，Glass Entertainment 于 2025 年 5 月与电台记者 Young 接洽，希望主持《Love Trapped》限量系列播客。

paras.en: “I remembered hearing about this story. I love the intersection of true crime and pop culture, and I was like, ‘Sign me up. I’m in,'” says Young of hosting what started out as a 10-episode weekly release that soon became the No. 1 podcast on Apple after launching Feb. 26, 2026. Love Trapped stayed in the Top 10 series of Apple Podcasts for over 30 weeks. It peaked at No. 1 in Top Series and No. 3 in True Crime and, in July, the series was named one of the best of 2026 so far on Apple Podcasts. It’s now eligible for a 2027 Golden Globes nomination.
paras.zh: “我记得听过这个故事。我喜欢真实犯罪与流行文化的交集，我想，‘给我注册吧。我加入了’”，Young 说道，他主持了最初每周发布 10 集的节目，该节目在 2026 年 2 月 26 日推出后很快成为 Apple 播客第一名。Love Trapped 在 Apple 播客前 10 系列中停留了 30 多周。该剧在热门剧集中排名第一，在真实犯罪中排名第三，并于 7 月被苹果播客评为 2026 年迄今为止最佳剧集之一。它现在有资格获得 2027 年金球奖提名。

paras.en: Young had a background in radio, storytelling and podcasting, but admits she was in uncharted waters hosting a project of this magnitude that required such a significant amount of research.
paras.zh: 杨拥有广播、讲故事和播客方面的背景，但她承认自己正处于未知领域，正在主持一个如此规模的项目，需要进行大量研究。

paras.en: Her prep, which began in June 2025, consisted of pre-interviews with content creators like The Rush Hour host and comedian Dave Neal, whom Young calls one of the “torchbearers in this story,” along with Bachelor franchise blogger “Reality Steve” Carbone and YouTuber Schnitzel Ninja, all of whom are participating voices on the podcast, which has since expanded to 27 episodes that include “Bonus” listens to track the ongoing Owens case. A new episode will hit the week of Oct. 19, with one final episode planned for after that.
paras.zh: 她的准备工作从 2025 年 6 月开始，包括对《尖峰时刻》主持人和喜剧演员戴夫·尼尔（杨称其为这个故事中的“火炬手”之一）等内容创作者的预采访，以及单身汉系列博主“Reality Steve”Carbone 和 YouTuber Schnitzel Ninja，他们都参与了播客的配音，此后播客已扩展到 27 集，其中包括跟踪正在进行的“Bonus”收听欧文斯案。新一集将于 10 月 19 日这一周播出，最后一集计划在那之后播出。

paras.en: Young also clocked 40-plus hours of conversations and interviews with Echard, who had already signed on to Love Trapped by the time Glass approached Young. “He was ready to tell his story. I was just the lucky one who got to do it,” says Young. “The person that I know Clayton to be today is not the person that I saw on TV.”
paras.zh: Young 还与 Echard 进行了 40 多个小时的对话和采访，当 Glass 接触 Young 时，Echard 已经签约了《Love Trapped》。 “他已经准备好讲述他的故事了。我是那个能够做到这一点的幸运者，”杨说。 “我今天认识的克莱顿不是我在电视上看到的那个人。”

paras.en: When Glass first came to Echard, the former reality star was struggling to reclaim his own narrative. When the paternity case made headline news, Echard started receiving emails from production companies interested in telling his story, but they didn’t pan out. “At first I was getting a lot of companies I just wasn’t impressed with, who backed out because they were concerned about getting sued by Laura,” he says. “Then Glass came around and said, ‘Hey, we would like to do a podcast and a documentary.’ A storytelling podcast.”
paras.zh: 当格拉斯第一次来到埃查德时，这位前真人秀明星正在努力恢复自己的叙述。当亲子鉴定案成为头条新闻时，埃查德开始收到制片公司发来的电子邮件，有兴趣讲述他的故事，但没有成功。 “一开始，我对很多公司都不满意，他们退出了，因为他们担心被劳拉起诉，”他说。 “然后格拉斯走过来说，‘嘿，我们想做一个播客和一部纪录片。’一个讲故事的播客。”

paras.en: Echard was drawn to the idea of a longform, investigative podcast that was produced at a high level. Glass Podcasts, which launched in 2019, is a division of Glass Entertainment Group, which has been producing award-winning unscripted TV and films for over 20 years. Founder and CEO Nancy Glass has had a string of successes in recent years, ever since pivoting to the true-crime genre, with adapting their true-crime podcasts into docuseries — Betrayal, Burden of Guilt and Curse of America’s Next Top Model among them.
paras.zh: Echard 被高水平制作的长篇调查性播客的想法所吸引。 Glass Podcasts 于 2019 年推出，是 Glass Entertainment Group 的一个部门，该集团 20 多年来一直制作屡获殊荣的无剧本电视和电影。创始人兼首席执行官南希·格拉斯(Nancy Glass)近年来取得了一系列成功，自从转向真实犯罪类型以来，将他们的真实犯罪播客改编成纪录片系列——其中包括《背叛》、《内疚负担》和《美国超模新秀大赛的诅咒》。

paras.en: An investigative journalist and true-crime obsessive herself (she was the last person to interview notorious serial killer Jeffrey Dahmer in the early ’90s before his death), Glass says she and her award-winning producing team, which includes her heads of podcasts Andrea Gunning and Ben Fetterman, know a good story when they see one.
paras.zh: 格拉斯是一名调查记者，也是一名真实犯罪迷（她是上世纪 90 年代初最后一个采访臭名昭著的连环杀手杰弗里·达默（Jeffrey Dahmer）生前的人），她说，她和她的获奖制作团队（其中包括她的播客负责人安德里亚·冈宁 (Andrea Gunning) 和本·费特曼 (Ben Fetterman)），一看到故事就知道好故事。

paras.en: “Podcasts are theater of the mind. They’re evocative and really get to your emotions. None of our crime stories involve a murder — they always involve emotions,” Glass tells THR of their slate.
paras.zh: “播客是心灵的剧场。它们能唤起人们的情感，真正触动你的情感。我们的犯罪故事都不涉及谋杀——它们总是涉及情感，”格拉斯向《好莱坞报道》讲述他们的名单。

paras.en: And there was a reason she was interested in telling Echard’s story. “There was no doubt in my mind that Clayton was telling the truth all the way along,” she says. “He’s incapable of making stuff up. It’s what got him in trouble on The Bachelor. This is a guy who always tells the truth, for better or for worse.”
paras.zh: 她对讲述埃查德的故事感兴趣是有原因的。 “毫无疑问，克莱顿自始至终都说的是实话，”她说。 “他不会编造故事。这就是他在《单身汉》中遇到麻烦的原因。这个人总是说实话，无论好坏。”

paras.en: Echard wasn’t trepidatious about opening up, but he was wary of trusting another set of producers after his experience on The Bachelor. Once Young was brought on, Echard reached out. “I said, ‘I’m going to be honest with you. You’re going to have your work cut out for you. There’s a lot here,'” he recalls of their first conversation. “‘You’re going to really have to want to do this and also, I have trust issues with producers because of my prior experiences. I would really like to believe that you’re going to be a producer who treats me more in a way that I would want to be treated.'”
paras.zh: 埃查德并不害怕开放，但在经历了《单身汉》的经历后，他对信任另一组制片人持谨慎态度。杨上场后，埃查德伸出了援手。 “我说，‘我要对你说实话。你的工作将会为你做好。这里有很多事情，’”他回忆起他们的第一次谈话。 “‘你真的必须想要这样做，而且，由于我之前的经历，我与制片人之间存在信任问题。我真的很愿意相信你会成为一名制片人，以我希望得到的方式对待我。’”

paras.en: The result was their 40 hours of recorded audio, “and she’s probably talked to me for another 30 hours,” he says of their collaboration.
paras.zh: 结果是他们录制了 40 个小时的音频，“她可能又和我聊了 30 个小时，”他谈到他们的合作时说道。

paras.en: “Clayton was extremely vulnerable and available,” says Young. “Anytime I had a question, I could reach out to him and I’d have an answer. Anytime I wanted him to do another interview, he was available. Knowing this story, imagine the awkward conversations we had to have? It was hard conversations and he was incredibly vulnerable.”
paras.zh: “克莱顿非常脆弱，也很容易被利用，”杨说。 “每当我有问题时，我都可以联系他并得到答案。每当我想让他再次接受采访时，他都会有空。了解了这个故事，想象一下我们必须进行的尴尬对话吗？这是艰难的对话，而且他非常脆弱。”

paras.en: When Young began her work on Love Trapped, Owens had just been indicted on seven criminal charges in the state of Arizona related to her relationship with Echard. After a June 2024 trial, a Maricopa County, Arizona, family court adjudicated that Owens was never pregnant with Echard’s twins as she had falsely claimed. The judge in that case, Judge Julie Ann Mata, saw a pattern of behavior and referred Owens for further criminal investigation, which eventually resulted in her 2025 criminal indictments and subsequent guilty plea on Aug. 28, after several delays, avoiding a trial that had initially been set for January 2026.
paras.zh: 当杨开始拍摄《爱情陷阱》时，欧文斯刚刚在亚利桑那州被指控与她和埃查德的关系有关的七项刑事指控。经过 2024 年 6 月的审判后，亚利桑那州马里科帕县家庭法院裁定欧文斯从未像她谎称的那样怀上了埃查德的双胞胎。该案的法官朱莉·安·马塔（Julie Ann Mata）法官看到了欧文斯的行为模式，并转介欧文斯进行进一步的刑事调查，最终导致她于 2025 年被起诉，并在几次拖延后于 8 月 28 日认罪，避免了最初定于 2026 年 1 月进行的审判。

paras.en: “The judge in that case was like, ‘Hey, I think this is something bigger. You might want to look into this.’ It was then the Maricopa County Attorney’s Office who eventually charged Laura with the felony indictment,” recaps Young.
paras.zh: “那个案子的法官说，‘嘿，我认为这件事更大。你可能想调查一下。’最终是马里科帕县检察官办公室对劳拉提出了重罪起诉，”杨回忆道。

paras.en: Young had reached out to Owens before the podcast launched, via their respective teams, and she says the “understanding was she would think about it and wanted to do it.” But when the host reached back out in early 2026 before the podcast launched, Owens sent back an email indicating she had no desire to participate. (THR has reached out to Owens’ current attorney, Christian Lueders.)
paras.zh: 在播客推出之前，杨通过各自的团队联系了欧文斯，她说“我们的理解是她会考虑并愿意这样做。”但当主持人在 2026 年初播客启动前再次联系时，欧文斯发回了一封电子邮件，表示她无意参与。 （《好莱坞报道》已经联系了欧文斯现任律师克里斯蒂安·鲁德斯。）

paras.en: “We had a little more correspondence throughout the course of the podcast,” says Young, but Owens never speaks on record. “I do detail some direct quotes in episode 12,” she adds of what was planned to be the final episode, titled “All the Best.” Episodes have since continued, with the most recent bonus episode, “Guilty,” covering the Aug. 28 plea deal hearing. “[Laura] had no intention of participating based on the responses that I received from her,” says Young, who still hopes for the chance to connect. “I’d still like to interview her.”
paras.zh: “在整个播客过程中，我们有更多的通信，”杨说，但欧文斯从未公开发言。 “我在第 12 集中详细介绍了一些直接引用，”她补充道，计划将其作为最后一集，标题为“一切顺利”。此后剧集继续播出，最新一集“Guilty”报道了 8 月 28 日的认罪协议听证会。 “根据我从劳拉那里收到的答复，她无意参与，”杨说，她仍然希望有机会联系。 “我还是想采访她。”

paras.en: Winning the 2024 paternity case was “a good day,” Echard recalls. But it wasn’t over. “It’s like a double-edged sword because on one end, you win. On the other end, you’re like, ‘Why am I in this in the first place?'” Echard’s role in the Owens case would continue, as he remained a victim in her criminal case and is set to share a victim-impact statement at her upcoming sentencing, which is scheduled for Oct. 23 in Maricopa County Superior Court in Phoenix, Arizona.
paras.zh: 埃查德回忆道，赢得 2024 年亲子鉴定案件是“美好的一天”。但事情还没有结束。 “这就像一把双刃剑，因为一方面，你会赢。另一方面，你会想，‘我一开始为什么会参与其中？’”埃查德在欧文斯案中的角色将继续下去，因为他仍然是欧文斯刑事案件的受害者，并将在她即将于 10 月 23 日在亚利桑那州凤凰城马里科帕县高等法院举行的宣判中分享受害者影响声明。

paras.en: “For me, it’s over when everyone stops talking about it,” Echard says, recounting what he’s lost, both financially, in brand deals and speaking engagements, and personally, with his reputation. “I was at the time hoping to get more into mental health speaking to youth because that’s what I needed when I was a kid, and I was on the path towards doing that. And then, of course, when she came out with this, it was an accusation that was very heavy and so I lost all my speaking engagements.
paras.zh: “对我来说，当每个人都不再谈论它时，一切就结束了，”埃查德说道，他讲述了自己在品牌交易和演讲活动中的经济损失，以及个人声誉方面的损失。 “当时我希​​望更多地与年轻人谈论心理健康问题，因为这就是我小时候所需要的，而且我正在朝着这个目标迈进。当然，当她提出这一点时，这是一个非常沉重的指控，所以我失去了所有的演讲活动。

paras.en: Young and her Love Trapped team continue to update listeners on the case, with the most recent extra episode covering the 36-year-old Owens entering her guilty plea. Under her agreement, she pleaded guilty to four felony counts, including two counts of fraudulent schemes and artifices, one count of taking the identity of another and one count of perjury.
paras.zh: 杨和她的“爱情困顿”团队继续向听众通报此案的最新情况，最新一集讲述了 36 岁的欧文斯认罪的情况。根据她的协议，她承认四项重罪，包括两项欺诈计划和诡计罪、一项冒用他人身份罪和一项伪证罪。

paras.en: “When the very first article came out, much like me, a lot of people wanted to believe Laura. They wanted to believe this woman was telling the truth — and people had their pitchforks out for Clayton because of his reputation. But the narrative changed pretty quickly,” says Young of how fans and franchise voices helped break open the case, ultimately leading to a plea deal that Young, Echard and others doubted would come.
paras.zh: “当第一篇文章发表时，就像我一样，很多人都想相信劳拉。他们想相信这个女人说的是实话——人们因为克莱顿的名声而对克莱顿表示支持。但故事很快就发生了变化，”杨在谈到粉丝和特许经营的声音如何帮助破案时说道，最终导致杨、埃查德和其他人怀疑是否会达成认罪协议。

paras.en: Back when this began, in September 2023, Owens had shared on The Bachelor subreddit a since-deleted Medium.com post identifying herself as the anonymous woman who was suing Echard. She also shared a Dropbox link with evidence, which is when a devoted population of armchair detectives, a community called “Justice for Clayton,” first started dissecting Owens’ claim and siding with Echard. It’s that community, and their GoFundMe page, that led to Echard gaining legal representation, which includes his lead attorney Gregg Woodnick. What started as a subreddit has grown to communities across Instagram, X and Facebook.
paras.zh: 早在 2023 年 9 月，事情开始时，欧文斯就在 Reddit 单身汉子版块上分享了 Medium.com 上的一篇帖子，该帖子后来被删除，自称是起诉埃查德的匿名女性。她还分享了一个带有证据的 Dropbox 链接，当时一群热心的纸上谈兵的侦探，一个名为“克莱顿正义”的社区，第一次开始剖析欧文斯的主张并站在埃查德一边。正是这个社区和他们的 GoFundMe 页面，让 Echard 获得了法律代理，其中包括他的首席律师 Gregg Woodnick。最初是一个 Reddit 子版块，现已发展成为 Instagram、X 和 Facebook 等社区。

paras.en: “The armchair investigators and internet detectives got involved because stuff happened to them like Laura said happened to her, and they knew what she was saying wasn’t right or didn’t make sense: That’s not how pregnancy works,” says Young. “A lot of people have experienced pregnancy loss or having to make the difficult decision to have an abortion; and they didn’t feel she was being truthful about things Laura claimed happened to her. Red flags were waving, and that’s why a lot of people got invested.”
paras.zh: “纸上谈兵的调查人员和网络侦探之所以介入，是因为他们身上发生的事情就像劳拉所说的发生在她身上一样，而且他们知道她所说的不正确或没有意义：怀孕不是这样的，”杨说。 “很多人都经历过流产或不得不做出堕胎的艰难决定；他们觉得劳拉所说的发生在她身上的事情并不真实。危险信号正在飘扬，这就是为什么很多人投资的原因。”

paras.en: In July 2023, Echard scored that major legal victory when he won the paternity suit. But not until Owens accepted the plea deal did Echard begin to get closure.
paras.zh: 2023 年 7 月，埃查德赢得了亲子鉴定诉讼，取得了重大法律胜利。但直到欧文斯接受认罪协议，埃查德才开始了结。

paras.en: “It’s the first time that we’ve seen Laura take any accountability,” said Echard in a reaction video shared to his Instagram after her guilty plea. (THR spoke to Echard for this story before Aug. 28.) “Laura was never able to take an ounce of accountability until [Aug. 28], and that’s not lost upon me how huge that was. I believe she needs to go to prison to be separated from her environment so that she can hopefully heal from there and give her a second chance to come out to the real world and prove that she can be a better person.”
paras.zh: “这是我们第一次看到劳拉承担任何责任，”埃查德在认罪后分享到他的 Instagram 上的反应视频中说道。 （《好莱坞报道》在 8 月 28 日之前就这个故事采访了埃查德。）“直到 [8 月 28 日]，劳拉才能够承担起一丁点责任，我并没有忘记这有多大。我相信她需要进监狱，与周围的环境隔离，这样她才有希望从那里痊愈，并给她第二次机会，回到现实世界，证明她可以成为一个更好的人。”

paras.en: Up until that moment, Echard didn’t feel capable of predicting what Owens would do. “This entire time when I’ve tried to guess her next move, I’ve been wrong every time,” he said leading up to Aug. 28. Young, who was in the courtroom that day, says she was shocked when she heard Owens accept.
paras.zh: 直到那一刻，埃查德都觉得自己无法预测欧文斯会做什么。 8 月 28 日之前，他说道：“一直以来，当我试图猜测她的下一步行动时，我每次都错了。”当天在法庭上的杨说，当她听到欧文斯接受时，她感到很震惊。

paras.en: “I was absolutely floored when the judge came out and said that she had signed the plea agreement,” says Young. “Then the judge asked her if she was pleading guilty or not guilty to each of the counts. There were four different counts, and she had to say guilty to each one. And that, to me, was a big moment. It was a big moment in covering this case, hearing the word ‘guilty’ come out of her mouth.”
paras.zh: “当法官出来说她已经签署了认罪协议时，我完全震惊了，”杨说。 “然后法官问她是否对每一项罪名认罪或无罪。有四种不同的罪名，她必须对每一项罪名认罪。对我来说，这是一个重要的时刻。听到她嘴里说出‘有罪’这个词，这是报道这个案件的一个重要时刻。”

paras.en: Owens faces a maximum of 12.5 years in prison at her sentencing. Echard will attend the hearing and he, along with another man she had falsely accused, Greg Gillespie, will get the opportunity to share victim-impact statements.
paras.zh: 欧文斯在被宣判时将面临最高 12.5 年的监禁。埃查德将出席听证会，他和她错误指控的另一名男子格雷格·吉莱斯皮将有机会分享受害者影响陈述。

paras.en: Owens had also been appealing a domestic violence restraining order against Mike Marraccini in California that was dismissed Sept. 4; Marraccini is not a listed victim in the Arizona prosecution, since the alleged fraud involving him occurred in California, where there is a fourth man who also claimed to be a victim of Owens. Marraccini also participates on the podcast.
paras.zh: 欧文斯还曾对加州针对迈克·马拉西尼的家庭暴力限制令提出上诉，但该令于 9 月 4 日被驳回；马拉奇尼并未被列入亚利桑那州检方的受害者名单，因为涉及他的涉嫌欺诈事件发生在加利福尼亚州，那里还有第四名男子也自称是欧文斯的受害者。马拉奇尼也参与了播客。

paras.en: “I feel confident enough to be able to give it on the spot,” Echard says of his statement. “I could make it in the moment because my belief is that whatever I’m meant to say is what I always will say. And there really is nothing better than to speak on the spot — not produced, just raw, and let the emotions out. Standing there in front of that judge, they need to feel how painful it’s been.”
paras.zh: “我有足够的信心能够当场发表，”埃查德谈到他的声明时说道。 “我能在当下做到这一点，因为我相信我想说的都是我一直会说的。而且真的没有什么比当场发言更好的了——不是制作的，只是原始的，然后把情绪发泄出来。站在法官面前，他们需要感受到这有多么痛苦。”

paras.en: Woodnick, Echard’s attorney along with DeAndra Arena, tells THR he thinks Owens made the “smart choice” by accepting the plea deal, instead of going to trial. “Laura had blazed a path that she was committed to taking this to trial and after she had said she would fiercely defend herself — but she was in a corner and facing significant prison and overwhelming evidence. Her attorney did excellent work by encouraging the plea, but he will have his hands full at sentencing. Laura is looking at years in prison. The way for her to minimize her exposure is with full and contrite acknowledgement of the damage she has caused. I think that’s going to be tough for Laura. We’ll find out.”
paras.zh: 埃查德的律师伍德尼克和德安德拉·阿里纳告诉《好莱坞报道》，他认为欧文斯接受认罪协议而不是接受审判是“明智的选择”。 “劳拉已经开辟了一条道路，她承诺将这件事送上法庭，在她表示将强烈为自己辩护之后，但她已陷入困境，面临着重大牢狱之灾和压倒性的证据。她的律师在鼓励认罪方面做得非常出色，但他在量刑方面将忙得不可开交。劳拉正在考虑入狱数年。她最大程度地减少暴露的方法是充分而悔恨地承认她所造成的损害。我认为这对劳拉来说将是艰难的。我们会找出来。”

paras.en: Justice may look different for each of the men involved, notes Young, but at the end of the day, some sort of accountability for what they’ve been through is what they are asking. “I want her to get put behind bars so that she stops. Not only for me, but so she doesn’t do it for anybody else in the future,” says Echard.
paras.zh: 杨指出，对于每个参与其中的人来说，正义可能看起来有所不同，但归根结底，他们所要求的就是对他们所经历的事情承担某种责任。 “我希望她被关进监狱，这样她就可以停下来了。不仅是为了我，而且她将来也不会为了其他人这样做，”埃查德说。

paras.en: The Love Trapped team, including Young, will be there for sentencing. “We’re going to see it through to the finish line,” Young promises.
paras.zh: 包括杨在内的《爱情陷阱》团队将到场接受宣判。 “我们将坚持到底，”杨保证道。

paras.en: Love Trapped will return for a second season with a new story, one still to be determined by Glass and the team. Young will also return as host.
paras.zh: 《爱情陷阱》第二季将带着新故事回归，具体故事仍有待格拉斯和团队决定。杨也将作为主持人回归。

paras.en: In the meantime, Glass Podcasts is in talks for its next TV adaptation. “Let’s say we’ve been approached,” says Glass of speaking to networks and streamers about bringing Love Trapped season one to the screen. “There’s more interest in this one. Did I think it was special? Yes, because it involves pop culture. You can’t beat that.”
paras.zh: 与此同时，Glass Podcasts 正在洽谈下一部电视改编作品。 “假设有人联系了我们，”格拉斯在与网络和主播谈论将《爱情陷阱》第一季搬上银幕时说道。 “人们对这个更感兴趣。我认为它很特别吗？是的，因为它涉及流行文化。你无法超越这一点。”

paras.en: Both Echard and Young are hopeful that Love Trapped could take on a second storytelling form. As talks are ongoing, Young says, “I think the goal would probably be documentary first, with the actual people. The story is so entertaining and juicy, but at the end of the day, this really happened. This is people’s real lives. I think that’s super important. I’m so incredibly proud of what this podcast has done, and I’m mostly proud that we were able to share the stories of the people who experienced this. I believe their stories deserve to be told.”
paras.zh: 埃查德和杨都希望《爱情被困》能够采用第二种讲故事的形式。会谈正在进行中，杨说：“我认为我们的目标可能首先是纪录片，与真实的人一起。这个故事是如此有趣和有趣，但最终，这真的发生了。这是人们的真实生活。我认为这非常重要。我为这个播客所做的事情感到非常自豪，而且我最自豪的是我们能够分享经历过这一切的人的故事。我相信他们的故事值得被讲述。”

paras.en: Echard is inching back into the spotlight — he says he’s receiving more dancing requests on Cameo now than he was on The Bachelor, a hobby he launched on TikTok. So while he muses about an A-lister like Chris Hemsworth or The Rock playing him if the adaptation were to be scripted, he’s also open to audition to play himself. “I’ve had discussions with Glass about if there is a way that I can be part of this moving forward. So we have some other things we’re discussing,” he says. But “I think a lot of streamers are like, ‘How does it end? We can’t tell a story without an ending.'”
paras.zh: Echard 正在慢慢回到聚光灯下——他说，现在他在 Cameo 上收到的跳舞请求比他在 TikTok 上推出的一项业余爱好 The Bachelor 上还要多。因此，当他考虑如果改编剧本时，克里斯·海姆斯沃斯（Chris Hemsworth）或巨石强森（The Rock）这样的一线明星来扮演他时，他也愿意接受试镜来扮演自己。 “我和 Glass 讨论过是否有办法让我参与到这一进程中。所以我们正在讨论其他一些事情，”他说。但“我认为很多主播都会想，‘它是如何结束的？我们不能讲一个没有结局的故事。’”

paras.en: Right now, he’s just thankful to be a part of something bigger than him.
paras.zh: 现在，他很感激能成为比他更伟大的事业的一部分。

paras.en: “I was just a catalyst,” he says. “I was just a person who had a public reputation and that was the initial interest. If I didn’t have that, there would have been no community. Now the podcast is a top podcast of 2026. People are listening. I feel like I’ve done something, right?”
paras.zh: “I was just a catalyst,” he says. “我只是一个有公众声誉的人，这就是最初的兴趣。如果我没有这个，就不会有社区。现在播客是2026年的顶级播客。人们在听。我觉得我做了一些事情，对吗？”

paras.en: All episodes and bonus content of Love Trapped are available on the iHeartRadio app, Apple Podcasts or wherever podcasts are available. A new episode drops next week, with a final episode to be announced. All Glass podcasts including Love Trapped drop at midnight on Thursdays.
paras.zh: Love Trapped 的所有剧集和奖励内容均可在 iHeartRadio 应用程序、Apple 播客或任何提供播客的地方观看。新一集将于下周推出，最后一集也将公布。所有 Glass 播客（包括 Love Trapped）均在周四午夜播出。

articles.title: Tupac Murder Trial: Duane “Keffe D” Davis Sentenced  40 Years to Life in Prison
articles.author: Ethan Millman

paras.en: The man found guilty of helping orchestrate the murder of hip-hop legend Tupac Shakur over 30 years ago was sentenced to 40 years to life in prison on Tuesday, ABC News reported.
paras.zh: 据美国广播公司新闻报道，这名男子因 30 多年前协助策划谋杀嘻哈传奇人物图帕克·沙库尔 (Tupac Shakur) 而被判有罪，周二被判处 40 年至终身监禁。

paras.en: Duane “Keffe D” Davis is the first and only person to have been convicted over Shakur’s death, with the former Southside Crips gang leader found guilty of murder, not on allegations of pulling the trigger himself, but as operating as the “shot caller” in the ordeal. Shakur’s murder was one of the most infamous crimes in pop culture history, and while Davis had long been associated with the incident — he had said in old interviews and a 2019 memoir that he provided the gun — he was arrested in 2023. The book itself had served as a key piece of evidence in the investigation and trial.
paras.zh: 杜安·“凯夫·D”·戴维斯 (Duane “Keffe D” Davis) 是第一个也是唯一一个因沙库尔之死而被定罪的人，这位前 Southside Crips 帮派头目被判犯有谋杀罪，不是因为他本人扣动扳机，而是因为他在这场磨难中充当了“指挥者”。沙库尔的谋杀案是流行文化史上最臭名昭著的罪行之一，虽然戴维斯长期以来与这起事件有关——他在旧的采访和 2019 年的回忆录中表示，他提供了这把枪——但他于 2023 年被捕。这本书本身是调查和审判的关键证据。

paras.en: Davis himself had pleaded not guilty on the murder charge, and days after his conviction, he’d spoken with The Hollywood Reporter, maintaining his innoncence and saying that “I’m not no fucking killer.”
paras.zh: 戴维斯本人对谋杀指控表示不认罪，定罪几天后，他接受了《好莱坞报道》的采访，坚称自己无罪，并表示“我他妈的不是杀手。”

paras.en: During the trial, Davis’ legal team sought to establish that Davis was lying in his memoir and previous interviews, with his lawyers calling his previous claims “bullshit.” Davis himself told THR that he “never read that book.”
paras.zh: 在审判期间，戴维斯的法律团队试图证实戴维斯在回忆录和之前的采访中撒谎，他的律师称他之前的说法是“胡说八道”。戴维斯本人告诉《好莱坞报道》，他“从未读过那本书”。

paras.en: Shakur’s death has been particularly associated with gang violence, and how it had gotten entwined with the East Coast/West Coast rap rivalry of the ’90s. Shakur’s label Death Row, lead by Suge Knight, was associated with the bloods. Sean “Diddy” Combs’ Bad Boy Records had purportedly linked itself to the crips, and Davis had previously said Combs had offered up $1 million for Shakur’s death.
paras.zh: 沙库尔的死与帮派暴力以及它如何与 90 年代东海岸/西海岸说唱竞争交织在一起尤其相关。沙库尔的厂牌“Death Row”（由 Suge Knight 领导）与血统有关。据称，“吹牛老爹”肖恩·库姆斯的坏男孩唱片公司与跛子乐队有联系，戴维斯此前曾表示，库姆斯愿意为沙库尔的死提供 100 万美元。

paras.en: Combs, currently in prison and recently hospitalized over a head injury, has long denied the claims. Davis himself had told THR after his conviction that Combs never offered him the money, and when asked what he would want to tell Combs, he said “help me out in here. Look out for my family.”
paras.zh: 库姆斯目前正在监狱服刑，最近因头部受伤住院，他长期以来一直否认这一说法。戴维斯本人在被定罪后告诉《好莱坞报道》，库姆斯从未给过他钱，当被问及他想告诉库姆斯什么时，他说“帮帮我。照顾我的家人。”

articles.title: Bank earnings takeaways: Here's how JPMorgan, Goldman, Wells Fargo and Citi performed in Q3

paras.en: Four of the largest U.S. banks reported third-quarter results on Tuesday: JPMorgan Chase, Wells Fargo, Goldman Sachs and Citigroup.
paras.zh: 美国四大银行周二公布了第三季度业绩：摩根大通、富国银行、高盛和花旗集团。

paras.en: Bank of America and Morgan Stanley will post earnings on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 美国银行和摩根士丹利将于周三公布财报。

paras.en: The quarter was dominated by headlines around artificial intelligence, IPO uncertainty, high fuel prices and rising borrowing costs.
paras.zh: 该季度的头条新闻主要涉及人工智能、首次公开募股的不确定性、高油价和不断上涨的借贷成本。

paras.en: The banks that reported Tuesday put up mixed results. JPMorgan, the biggest U.S. bank by assets and the largest in the world by market capitalization, posted a rare miss. Goldman Sachs, meanwhile, blew past estimates for revenue and earnings per share, led by strong equities trading.
paras.zh: 周二公布财报的银行业绩好坏参半。摩根大通（JPMorgan）是美国资产最大的银行，也是全球市值最大的银行，但其业绩却出现了罕见的失误。与此同时，在股市交易强劲的带动下，高盛的营收和每股收益超出了预期。

paras.en: Analyst calls for all four banks touched on the opportunities and risks associated with AI, citing robust financing demand and operational advantages, but also the threat of rogue agents.
paras.zh: 分析师对所有四家银行的呼吁都谈到了与人工智能相关的机遇和风险，指出了强劲的融资需求和运营优势，但也提到了流氓代理的威胁。

paras.en: Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon also addressed recent reports of a CEO transition plan, and Wells Fargo CFO Mike Santomassimo joined CNBC to discuss the firm's growth and the state of the consumer.
paras.zh: 高盛 (Goldman Sachs) 首席执行官大卫·所罗门 (David Solomon) 还谈到了最近有关首席执行官过渡计划的报道，富国银行 (Wells Fargo) 首席财务官迈克·桑托马西莫 (Mike Santomassimo) 加入 CNBC 讨论公司的增长和消费者状况。

articles.title: Paul Tudor Jones says 2027 could be a really challenging year for the stock market

paras.en: Legendary hedge fund manager Paul Tudor Jones told CNBC that next year could be a tough one for the stock market because of increased equity supply from big tech initial public offerings coming down the pipe as well as a potential reckoning from the ballooning U.S. fiscal deficit.
paras.zh: 传奇对冲基金经理保罗·都铎·琼斯 (Paul Tudor Jones) 告诉 CNBC，明年对股市来说可能是艰难的一年，因为大型科技公司首次公开募股 (IPO) 的股票供应量增加，而且美国不断膨胀的财政赤字可能带来清算。

paras.en: "2027 is going to be really, really challenging for the stock market," Jones told "Squawk Box" on Tuesday. "You've probably got the most negative flow picture for the U.S. stock market that we've had, say, since 2002."
paras.zh: 琼斯周二对“Squawk Box”表示：“2027 年对股市来说将是非常非常具有挑战性的。” “你可能看到了美国股市自 2002 年以来最负面的流量图。”

paras.en: The founder and chief investment officer of Tudor Investment said that corporate buybacks, along with mergers and acquisitions, have been a tail wind for the stock market for most of this four-year bull market as they decreased the equity supply.
paras.zh: 都铎投资公司的创始人兼首席投资官表示，在这四年牛市的大部分时间里，企业回购以及并购一直是股市的顺风，因为它们减少了股票供应。

paras.en: That tide is now turning against the market with major offerings ahead in the AI space from Anthropic and OpenAI, along with one just finished for SpaceX. There will also likely be more secondary offerings from companies in order to raise money for the AI build-out, said Jones. It all adds up to an increased equity supply picture that could weigh on prices.
paras.zh: 现在，这种趋势正在逆转市场，Anthropic 和 OpenAI 在 AI 领域的主要产品即将推出，SpaceX 刚刚完成了一项产品。琼斯表示，公司也可能会进行更多的二次发行，以便为人工智能建设筹集资金。所有这些都导致股票供应量增加，可能会对价格造成压力。

paras.en: The billionaire hedge fund manager's comments come as investors worry that a bull market now in its fourth year could start to dwindle and run out of steam as concerns grow around mounting inflation, higher bond yields and a more hawkish Federal Reserve.
paras.zh: 这位亿万富翁对冲基金经理发表上述言论之际，投资者担心，随着人们对通胀加剧、债券收益率上升和美联储立场更加强硬的担忧加剧，进入第四个年头的牛市可能会开始萎缩并失去动力。

paras.en: Jones repeated that the current period in the market is akin to 1999, just about a year before the dot-com bubble burst in 2000. He noted the bifurcation in the current market between those companies benefiting from the AI boom and those that aren't.
paras.zh: 琼斯重申，目前的市场时期类似于 1999 年，大约是 2000 年互联网泡沫破裂的前一年。他指出，当前市场中受益于人工智能繁荣的公司和未受益于人工智能繁荣的公司之间存在分歧。

paras.en: He also added that a ballooning fiscal deficit is among the dangers for the current stock market, for which he thinks there could be a reckoning.
paras.zh: 他还补充说，不断膨胀的财政赤字是当前股市面临的危险之一，他认为可能需要对此进行清算。

paras.en: "We're never going to fix these deficits until the market makes us to. It's going to be just like 2008 and TARP [Troubled Asset Relief Program]. So that's the reality. No politician is going to voluntarily raise taxes or cut spending. They're going to be forced to," he said.
paras.zh: “除非市场要求我们解决这些赤字，否则我们永远不会解决这些赤字。这将像2008年和TARP（问题资产救助计划）一样。这就是现实。没有政客会自愿提高税收或削减支出。他们将被迫这样做，”他说。

paras.en: "And the only question is, are we now at that tipping point where the market's about to do that? And if you put a gun to my head, I'd say 60-40, we're down that path," Jones said.
paras.zh: “唯一的问题是，我们现在是否正处于市场即将发生这种情况的临界点？如果你用枪指着我的头，我会说 60-40，我们就走上了这条路，”琼斯说。

paras.en: Oil, which he is long, is another headwind for the market, according to the hedge fund manager. He contended that prices could rally another $20 to $25 after the midterms, a scenario that the stock market will "hate" if it comes to pass.
paras.zh: 这位对冲基金经理表示，他做多的石油是市场的另一个阻力。他认为，中期选举后价格可能会再上涨 20 至 25 美元，如果这种情况发生，股市将“讨厌”这种情况。

paras.en: "I'll be short the whole year. There just — there's little value," Jones said. "You had all this issuance, all these IPOs in '98 and '99, and really 2000, 2001, 2002. Those were the easiest years to be short because you kept having these unlocks that just kept adding supply to the market."
paras.zh: “我会全年做空。这没什么价值，”琼斯说。 “98 年和 99 年，甚至是 2000 年、2001 年、2002 年，你都进行了所有这些发行、IPO。那些是最容易做空的年份，因为你不断地释放这些股票，从而不断增加市场的供应。”

articles.title: Apple releases HomeView smart home hub with screen as showcase for Siri AI

paras.en: Apple on Tuesday announced a home hub called HomeView, marking CEO John Ternus' first launch outside of iPhones since he took over from Tim Cook at the start of September.
paras.zh: 苹果周二宣布推出名为 HomeView 的家庭中心，这是首席执行官 John Ternus 自 9 月初接替蒂姆·库克以来首次在 iPhone 之外推出产品。

paras.en: Apple said the device with a 7-inch screen was designed to be mounted on a wall or placed on a table. It's designed for multiple people in a household, and will recognize the user by their face to display pertinent information. It starts at $299 and ships on Nov. 13.
paras.zh: 苹果表示，这款配备 7 英寸屏幕的设备设计用于安装在墙上或放在桌子上。它是为家庭中的多人设计的，可以通过面部识别用户来显示相关信息。起价 299 美元，11 月 13 日发货。

paras.en: Tuesday's launch event is the second under Ternus, who was the company's longtime hardware boss before being promoted to CEO. Last month, Apple announced new models of its most important product, the iPhone, including a foldable model called the Duo that retails for nearly $2,000.
paras.zh: 周二的发布会是 Ternus 领导下的第二次发布会，Ternus 在晋升为首席执行官之前曾担任该公司的长期硬件主管。上个月，苹果公司发布了其最重要产品 iPhone 的新型号，其中包括一款名为 Duo 的可折叠型号，零售价近 2,000 美元。

paras.en: Apple also announced new Apple TV and HomePod hardware on Tuesday. The new Apple TV 4K costs $299 and has a redesigned remote that can play a sound if it is lost. Apple's HomePod Mini speaker comes in new colors and costs $149, a slight increase over its previous $129 price.
paras.zh: 苹果周二还发布了新的 Apple TV 和 HomePod 硬件。新款 Apple TV 4K 售价 299 美元，并配有重新设计的遥控器，如果丢失，可以播放声音。 Apple 的 HomePod Mini 扬声器有新颜色，售价 149 美元，比之前的 129 美元价格略有上涨。

paras.en: The products announced Tuesday are less critical for Apple than the iPhone, and investors remain focused on iPhone sales, but the accessories were positioned on Tuesday as a showcase for the company's new Siri abilities released last month.
paras.zh: 周二宣布的产品对苹果来说不如 iPhone 那么重要，投资者仍然关注 iPhone 的销售，但周二发布的配件被定位为展示该公司上个月发布的新 Siri 功能。

paras.en: Apple said HomeView features Siri AI, which can answer a broad range of questions. Users will be able to converse with Siri, and their conversations will continue on their iPhone or iPad. It has a built-in speaker for playing music.
paras.zh: 苹果表示 HomeView 具有 Siri AI 功能，可以回答广泛的问题。用户将能够与 Siri 交谈，并且他们的对话将在 iPhone 或 iPad 上继续。它有一个内置扬声器，用于播放音乐。

paras.en: "It recognizes your face to shift from a household screen to your own experience, fills the room with incredible sound, keeps you connected to the people who matter most with FaceTime, and makes it easy to control your smart home," Apple's marketing head Greg Joswiak said in a statement.
paras.zh: 苹果营销主管格雷格·乔斯维亚克 (Greg Joswiak) 在一份声明中表示：“它可以识别你的脸部，从家庭屏幕切换到你自己的体验，让房间充满令人难以置信的声音，让你通过 FaceTime 与最重要的人保持联系，并让你轻松控制你的智能家居。”

paras.en: Apple said that HomeView will show information from the Messages, Photos, Calendar, and Reminders apps based on who is using the device, powered by Apple Intelligence. It can also be used to make FaceTime calls and as a digital photo frame. It's equipped with an Apple A18 chip. It supports up to six users.
paras.zh: 苹果表示，HomeView 将根据使用该设备的用户显示消息、照片、日历和提醒应用程序中的信息，并由 Apple Intelligence 提供支持。它还可用于进行 FaceTime 通话并用作数码相框。它配备了Apple A18芯片。它最多支持六个用户。

paras.en: Apple TV, HomePods, and HomeView are included in Apple's Wearables, Home, and Accessories category, which reported $7.88 billion in sales in the most recent quarter ended June, which was about 7% of the company's total revenue. The category also includes wireless headphones like AirPods and the Apple Watch.
paras.zh: Apple TV、HomePods 和 HomeView 属于 Apple 的可穿戴设备、家居和配件类别，该类别在截至 6 月的最近一个季度的销售额为 78.8 亿美元，约占该公司总收入的 7%。该类别还包括 AirPods 和 Apple Watch 等无线耳机。

paras.en: But while Apple has dabbled in home products and platforms in the past, Tuesday's announcement shows Apple is making its home products a higher priority under Ternus.
paras.zh: 不过，尽管苹果过去曾涉足家用产品和平台，但周二的公告显示，在特纳斯的领导下，苹果正在将其家用产品置于更优先的位置。

paras.en: "Apple always waits for an ecosystem to develop first until they are positive they can provide a stellar user experience," said Jennifer Kent, principal analyst at Parks Associates, which conducts research on the connected home.
paras.zh: Parks Associates 首席分析师詹妮弗·肯特 (Jennifer Kent) 表示：“苹果总是等待生态系统首先发展起来，直到他们确信自己能够提供出色的用户体验。”该公司负责联网家庭的研究。

paras.en: Apple said its new products, including HomeView, can be used as a smart home hub, coordinating notifications and actions in the home and working with a range of products, including new locks, doorbells, and cameras from LG Electronics and Schneider Electric.
paras.zh: 苹果表示，HomeView 等新产品可用作智能家居中心，协调家中的通知和操作，并与 LG 电子和施耐德电气的新锁、门铃和摄像头等一系列产品配合使用。

paras.en: Apple is emphasizing privacy, and said on Tuesday that its Apple Home Collection accessories encrypt data so that only the user and people they share with can see it. Other smart home cameras, for example, maintain limited access to user video, or store it on servers.
paras.zh: 苹果强调隐私，并于周二表示，其 Apple Home Collection 配件会对数据进行加密，以便只有用户和与之共享的人才能看到这些数据。例如，其他智能家居摄像机保留对用户视频的有限访问，或将其存储在服务器上。

paras.en: "They are going above and beyond what a lot of other companies do when it comes to privacy and security protections," Kent said.
paras.zh: 肯特说：“在隐私和安全保护方面，他们超越了许多其他公司。”

paras.en: Apple's integration with the smart home is not just about sales, but also helps further lock customers into its ecosystem. People who use multiple Apple products and connections are less likely to switch to an Android phone.
paras.zh: 苹果与智能家居的融合不仅仅是为了销量，还有助于进一步将客户锁定在其生态系统中。使用多种苹果产品和连接的人不太可能改用安卓手机。

paras.en: HomeView can also become a smart home dashboard, Apple said. It can be used to view camera feeds, adjust the thermostat, or lock connected doors around the house.
paras.zh: 苹果表示，HomeView 还可以成为智能家居仪表板。它可用于查看摄像头图像、调节恒温器或锁定房屋周围连接的门。

paras.en: Apple said that setting up a new smart home device takes one tap from the user's iPhone.
paras.zh: 苹果表示，用户只需在 iPhone 上轻轻一按即可设置新的智能家居设备。

paras.en: Tuesday's launch shows Apple's confidence as it launches new product categories. But the broader consumer electronics industry has been dealing with price increases and demand deterioration related to component shortages in memory and storage. It also comes as Ternus has reportedly pushed the company to release products faster.
paras.zh: 周二的发布会显示了苹果公司对推出新产品类别的信心。但更广泛的消费电子行业一直在应对与内存和存储元件短缺相关的价格上涨和需求恶化。据报道，Ternus 正在推动该公司更快地发布产品。

paras.en: Apple's new Apple TV 4K got a price hike from $199 to $299, and follows a similar price increase earlier this year, after Cook said that memory costs for Apple were unsustainable.
paras.zh: 苹果新款 Apple TV 4K 的价格从 199 美元上涨至 299 美元，今年早些时候，在库克表示苹果的内存成本不可持续之后，苹果也进行了类似的价格上涨。

articles.title: What happens to the body during menopause? New research hints at a biological ‘cliff’

paras.en: Menopause, despite being a fact of life for most women, is something of a scientific enigma. We know it occurs when the ovaries stop releasing new eggs and estrogen production drops. But the biological consequences of this change beyond reproduction are murky at best. Now new research raises questions about a “physiological cliff” at menopause.
paras.zh: 尽管更年期是大多数女性生活中的一个事实，但它却是一个科学之谜。我们知道，当卵巢停止释放新卵子并且雌激素产量下降时，就会发生这种情况。但这种除了繁殖之外的变化的生物学后果充其量是模糊的。现在，新的研究提出了关于更年期“生理悬崖”的问题。

paras.en: In a recent study published in Nature Medicine, researchers analyzed health data from more than one million women in the U.S. and Israel and found certain “jumps” in physiological traits such as bone density, liver health and other markers at the onset of menopause.
paras.zh: 在《自然医学》最近发表的一项研究中，研究人员分析了美国和以色列超过 100 万女性的健康数据，发现更年期开始时，骨密度、肝脏健康和其他标志物等生理特征出现了某些“跳跃”。

paras.en: “Menopause is not a slow part of aging. It’s an abrupt, body-wide transition across bone, liver, kidney, blood chemistry, fats, and more,” says Uri Alon, the study’s senior author and a professor at the Weizmann Institute of Science in Rehovot, Israel. “That makes sense since estrogen has receptors in almost every cell in the body.”
paras.zh: “更年期并不是衰老过程中缓慢的一部分。它是骨骼、肝脏、肾脏、血液化学、脂肪等方面的突然的、全身性的转变，”该研究的资深作者、以色列雷霍沃特魏茨曼科学研究所的教授乌里·阿隆说。 “这是有道理的，因为雌激素在体内几乎每个细胞都有受体。”

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: The study analyzed trends in menopause using a population-wide analysis that averaged hundreds of millions of health tests.
paras.zh: 该研究通过对数亿次健康测试进行平均的全人群分析来分析更年期的趋势。

paras.en: Alon and his colleagues pinpointed certain “jumps” in health markers: in the case of bone health, they found a “jump in the direction of bone loss,” Alon says. They also observed sudden changes in tests related to kidney function, liver health, and more. Some of these leaps were positive—such as for iron and hemoglobin levels, likely because monthly bleeding stops, Alon says.
paras.zh: 阿隆和他的同事们精确地指出了健康指标中的某些“跳跃”：在骨骼健康方面，他们发现“朝着骨质流失的方向跳跃”，阿隆说。他们还观察到与肾功能、肝脏健康等相关的测试的突然变化。阿隆说，其中一些飞跃是积极的，例如铁和血红蛋白水平，可能是因为每月出血停止了。

paras.en: The results were surprising, he says: previous work had suggested menopause’s physiological changes were more gradual. When Alon and his team saw the “cliff” in the data, “the hair on the back of our necks stood up,” he says. “So we tested it hard.”
paras.zh: 他说，结果令人惊讶：之前的研究表明更年期的生理变化是渐进的。当阿隆和他的团队看到数据中的“悬崖”时，“我们脖子后面的汗毛都竖起来了，”他说。 “所以我们进行了艰苦的测试。”

paras.en: “We ran it on men with the same age distribution and saw no jumps,” he says. Location also didn’t seem to matter—medical records from women in the U.S. and in Israel revealed similar “jumps” across health tests.
paras.zh: “我们对年龄分布相同的男性进行了测试，没有发现任何跳跃，”他说。地点似乎也并不重要——美国和以色列女性的医疗记录显示，健康测试中存在类似的“跳跃”。

paras.en: Women who were on hormone therapy tended to see smaller jumps in some tests, “especially in bone, liver and kidney,” Alon says. The findings suggest some women might benefit from starting this therapy earlier in life, before menopause—but more research is needed to understand how hormone therapy might help.
paras.zh: 阿隆说，接受激素治疗的女性在某些测试中往往会出现较小的跳跃，“尤其是在骨骼、肝脏和肾脏方面”。研究结果表明，一些女性可能会从更年期之前的早期开始这种疗法中受益，但需要更多的研究来了解激素疗法如何发挥作用。

articles.title: OpenAI’s blockbuster Navier-Stokes proof isn’t what we thought it was

paras.en: Mathematicians are finally making sense of the biggest event in decades for their field—and it’s stranger than anyone thought.
paras.zh: 数学家们终于理解了他们领域几十年来最重大的事件——而且它比任何人想象的都要奇怪。

paras.en: In early September OpenAI posted an inscrutable 166-page solution to the Navier-Stokes problem, one of math’s famed “million-dollar problems.” Initial accounts—including from the company itself—suggested that the proof, produced by an internal large language model (LLM), followed an approach devised by two Spanish mathematicians, Diego Córdoba and Luis Martínez-Zoroa.
paras.zh: 9 月初，OpenAI 发布了一个长达 166 页的神秘解决方案，解决了纳维-斯托克斯问题，这是数学界著名的“百万美元问题”之一。最初的报道（包括来自公司本身的报道）表明，由内部大语言模型（LLM）产生的证明遵循了两位西班牙数学家迭戈·科尔多瓦（Diego Córdoba）和路易斯·马丁内斯-索罗亚（Luis Martínez-Zoroa）设计的方法。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: The model’s purported reliance on this “Spanish program” sparked a very public conflict between the company and Tristan Buckmaster, a mathematician at New York University. Buckmaster had spent much of the past year using LLMs to carry out that program alongside Levent Alpöge, an employee of OpenAI’s archrival, Anthropic. The pair cried foul after OpenAI—whose public models Buckmaster and Alpöge had been using—announced a Navier-Stokes proof that seemed to build upon and then leapfrog over their hard-won progress. But the resemblance between the two groups’ methods now seems merely skin-deep.
paras.zh: 该模型据称依赖于这个“西班牙程序”，引发了该公司与纽约大学数学家特里斯坦·巴克马斯特之间的公开冲突。巴克马斯特去年大部分时间都在利用法学硕士与 OpenAI 的主要竞争对手 Anthropic 的员工 Levent Alpöge 一起实施该项目。在 OpenAI（其公共模型巴克马斯特和 Alpöge 一直在使用）宣布纳维-斯托克斯证明后，两人大喊大叫，该证明似乎是在他们来之不易的进步的基础上发展起来的，然后又超越了他们。但现在看来，这两个小组的方法之间的相似之处只是表面的。

paras.en: “When you go to the details, it is a different approach,” says Gonzalo Cao-Labora, a mathematician at EPFL, the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne. Scientific American spoke with several groups of experts working through the OpenAI paper. All said that it’s increasingly clear that the company’s proof does not follow the Spanish program.
paras.zh: “当你深入细节时，你会发现这是一种不同的方法，”洛桑瑞士联邦理工学院洛桑联邦理工学院的数学家贡萨洛·曹-拉博拉 (Gonzalo Cao-Labora) 说。 《科学美国人》采访了几位研究 OpenAI 论文的专家组。所有人都表示，越来越明显的是，该公司的证明不符合西班牙的计划。

paras.en: The Navier-Stokes equations are the math behind every fluid. OpenAI solved the million-dollar problem by uncovering a flaw in the equations. The company’s artificial intelligence concocted a situation in which the equations declared that the speed of a fluid’s flow should be infinite—a so-called blowup that can’t happen in real life.
paras.zh: 纳维-斯托克斯方程是每种流体背后的数学原理。 OpenAI 通过发现方程中的缺陷解决了这个价值数百万美元的问题。该公司的人工智能炮制了一种情况，其中方程表明流体的流动速度应该是无限的，即所谓的爆炸，这在现实生活中是不可能发生的。

paras.en: OpenAI solved the problem with an “agent swarm,” some 10,000 copies of its new, math-adept LLM, which spent about 88 hours of computing time and 130 billion tokens collectively constructing a blowup. The company’s math team threw all its resources at the problem after learning of significant progress made by Buckmaster and Alpöge. Buckmaster has alleged that OpenAI then attempted to bribe and threaten him to prevent him going public with insinuations of malfeasance, which he ultimately did.
paras.zh: OpenAI 通过“代理群”解决了这个问题，即大约 10,000 个新的、擅长数学的 LLM 副本，花费了大约 88 小时的计算时间和 1300 亿个代币共同构建了一个爆炸。在得知 Buckmaster 和 Alpöge 取得的重大进展后，该公司的数学团队投入了所有资源来解决这个问题。巴克马斯特声称，OpenAI 随后试图贿赂并威胁他，以阻止他公开暗示其渎职行为，但他最终还是这么做了。

paras.en: Even top experts have found OpenAI’s proof of blowup to be completely impenetrable. But the agents coded their arguments into Lean, a programming language used to automatically verify that the logical steps toward a conclusion in a given sequence are all valid. Several prominent research groups are now using both the Lean code and the paper, with the help of other LLMs, to get a simplified, bird’s-eye view of the math involved.
paras.zh: 即使是顶级专家也发现 OpenAI 的爆炸证明是完全难以理解的。但代理们将他们的论点编码为 Lean，这是一种编程语言，用于自动验证给定序列中得出结论的逻辑步骤是否都是有效的。在其他法学硕士的帮助下，几个著名的研究小组现在正在使用精益代码和论文，以获得所涉及数学的简化鸟瞰图。

paras.en: The proof does somewhat resemble the Spanish program in that both exploit the same “loophole” in the official framing of the Navier-Stokes problem that was given by the Clay Mathematics Institute. It permits a mathematician to coax the equations into blowing up by constructing a weird, unphysical force that “stirs” the fluid just right. But closer examination reveals that OpenAI’s proof builds its unnatural force in a totally distinct way. The proof’s similarities to Buckmaster and Alpöge’s progress are superficial.
paras.zh: 这个证明确实有点类似于西班牙的程序，因为两者都利用了克莱数学研究所给出的纳维-斯托克斯问题的官方框架中的相同“漏洞”。它允许数学家通过构造一种奇怪的、非物理的力来恰到好处地“搅拌”流体，从而使方程爆炸。但更仔细的检查表明，OpenAI 的证明以一种完全不同的方式构建了其非自然力量。该证明与 Buckmaster 和 Alpöge 的进展的相似之处只是表面的。

paras.en: Of course, the OpenAI result’s novelty doesn’t mean it wasn’t influenced by the Spanish program. In fact, OpenAI initially used a smaller team of agents to prove an intermediate result, and some experts say that this more modest squad did follow the program. But the 10,000-agent swarm apparently realized a different path was required to finish the job. Of course, regardless of OpenAI’s insistence that its model couldn’t have seen Buckmaster’s specific user data, the “black box” nature of LLMs means we’ll likely never know the swarm’s exact chain of reasoning.
